seat.zh: 咸阳（秦）· 洛阳（周）· 七雄都城

summary.zh: 公元前403年周威烈王册命韩、赵、魏为诸侯（《资治通鉴》开篇），前386年田氏代齐，战国七雄（秦、楚、齐、燕、赵、魏、韩）并立争雄。各国推行变法、修筑长城、兴修水利，百家争鸣；秦经商鞅变法与并巴蜀后崛起，秦王嬴政自前230年至前221年十年间次第攻灭韩、赵、魏、楚、燕、齐，终结列国纷争（拖动滑块可看十四阶段版图演变、鲁周越中山兴替与秦灭六国进程）。
summary.en: Beginning in 403 BCE when King Weilie of Zhou recognized Han, Zhao, and Wei as feudal lords (the opening year of Sima Guang’s Zizhi Tongjian), the Seven Warring States (Qin, Chu, Qi, Yan, Zhao, Wei, Han) vied for supremacy alongside older states such as Lu, Yue, Ba-Shu, and Zhongshan. Strengthened by Shang Yang’s reforms and the conquest of Ba-Shu, King Zheng of Qin annexed all six rival states between 230 and 221 BCE (drag across 14 stages).

summary.zh: 秦灭六国，首次建立大一统的中央集权帝国。推行郡县制、书同文、车同轨，北筑长城，南征百越。
summary.en: Qin conquered the six rival states to found China’s first centralized empire, standardizing script, coinage, weights, and axles, linking the northern Great Wall, and pushing south into Lingnan.

summary.zh: 汉初郡国并行、与匈奴和亲；武帝北击匈奴，开河西走廊与丝绸之路，南平南越，东置朝鲜四郡，宣帝时设西域都护府。8 年王莽代汉建新，23 年新亡。拖动底部时间轴可查看各阶段疆域演变。
summary.en: Early Han combined commanderies with princedoms and used marriage alliances with the Xiongnu. Emperor Wu drove the Xiongnu north, opened the Hexi Corridor and the Silk Road, annexed Nanyue and Gojoseon, and in 60 BCE established the Protectorate of the Western Regions. Wang Mang’s Xin interregnum lasted 8–23 CE. Drag across three stages.

summary.zh: 光武中兴后定都洛阳。班超经营西域，窦宪勒石燕然，北匈奴西迁；蔡伦改进造纸术。中后期外戚宦官交替专权，党锢之祸后黄巾起义，董卓入京，群雄割据。
summary.en: Restored by Emperor Guangwu with Luoyang as capital. Ban Chao secured the Tarim Basin, Dou Xian routed the Northern Xiongnu, and Cai Lun refined papermaking. Factional struggles and the Yellow Turban Rebellion ushered in an age of warlords.

seat.zh: 洛阳 / 成都 / 建业

summary.zh: 魏、蜀、吴三足鼎立。曹魏据中原与西北，蜀汉据巴蜀，孙吴据江东与岭南。
summary.en: A tripartite balance between Cao Wei in the North China Plain and northwest, Shu Han in Sichuan, and Eastern Wu along the lower Yangtze and Lingnan.

summary.zh: 司马炎代魏建晋，280 年灭吴重归一统。分封宗室引发八王之乱，内迁诸族起兵，311 年永嘉之乱洛阳陷落，316 年长安失守西晋亡。图示约公元 300 年，并标出 304 年起割据并州的匈奴汉赵。
summary.en: Sima Yan supplanted Wei and conquered Wu in 280, briefly reunifying China. The War of the Eight Princes and uprisings of non-Han peoples led to the Disaster of Yongjia (311) and the fall of Chang’an (316). Shown c. 300 CE with the Xiongnu state of Han-Zhao in Shanxi.

summary.zh: 衣冠南渡，司马睿在建康重建晋室；北方先后出现十六国。初期石勒建立后赵，329 年灭前赵统一北方大部；后赵崩溃后形成前秦与前燕东西对峙；376 年前秦苻坚统一整个北方，383 年南征在淝水之战被谢玄北府兵击败，北方再度分裂，鲜卑拓跋氏北魏随即在代北崛起。拖动底部时间轴可查看各阶段疆域演变。
summary.en: Northern elites fled south and rebuilt the Jin court at Jiankang while Sixteen Kingdoms rose and fell across the north: Shi Le’s Later Zhao unified most of the north (329); Former Qin and Former Yan then faced off east to west; Fu Jian’s Former Qin unified the entire north in 376 but collapsed after the Battle of Fei River (383), and Tuoba’s Northern Wei rose on the northern frontier. Drag across four stages.

seat.zh: 平城→洛阳（北朝）/ 建康（南朝）

summary.zh: 420 年刘裕代晋建宋，南朝历宋、齐、梁、陈；北方北魏太武帝拓跋焘先后灭胡夏（431）、北燕（436）、北凉（439），于 439 年正式统一北方，结束五胡十六国。534 年北魏分裂为东魏、西魏，又分别为北齐、北周所代。拖动底部时间轴可查看各阶段疆域演变。
summary.en: In the south, Liu Song, Qi, Liang, and Chen succeeded one another at Jiankang. In the north, Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei conquered Xia (431), Northern Yan (436), and Northern Liang (439) to unify northern China, ending the Sixteen Kingdoms era; Northern Wei later split into Eastern/Western Wei (534), replaced by Northern Qi and Northern Zhou. Drag across six stages.

summary.zh: 隋结束三百年分裂，重建统一。开凿大运河，创立科举制，营建东都洛阳。
summary.en: Sui ended nearly three centuries of division, excavated the Grand Canal linking the Yellow River and Yangtze, instituted the imperial examination system, and built the eastern capital at Luoyang.

summary.zh: 盛唐设安西、北庭、安北、安东、安南等都护府，长安是当时世界最大的都市。755 年安史之乱后，河西、陇右与西域先后陷于吐蕃，藩镇割据，直至 907 年朱温代唐。拖动底部时间轴可查看各阶段疆域演变。
summary.en: High Tang established protectorates across the Tarim Basin, Zungharia, Mongolia, Liaodong, and Annam, making Chang’an the world’s largest metropolis. After the An Lushan Rebellion (755), Hexi and the Western Regions fell to the Tibetan Empire and regional military governors dominated until 907.

summary.zh: 907 年朱温代唐，中原五十余年间后梁、后唐、后晋、后汉、后周五代更迭，南方及河东先后出现前蜀、后蜀、吴、南唐、吴越、闽、楚、南汉、荆南、北汉十国。936 年石敬瑭割燕云十六州予契丹，939 年安南脱离，为此后数百年边疆格局埋下伏笔。
summary.en: Between 907 and 960 five short-lived dynasties succeeded one another in the Central Plains while ten regional kingdoms held the south and Shanxi. In 936 Shi Jingtang ceded the Sixteen Prefectures to the Khitan, and in 939 Annam broke away.

summary.zh: 陈桥兵变后用近二十年平定荆湖、后蜀、南汉、南唐、吴越、北汉，结束五代十国；两次北伐失利，燕云十六州终为辽有，与辽、西夏、大理长期并立。经济文化高度繁荣。拖动底部时间轴可查看各阶段疆域演变。
summary.en: After the Chenqiao mutiny (960), Song reunified the southern kingdoms and Northern Han within two decades, but failed to recover the Sixteen Prefectures from Liao, coexisting with Khitan Liao, Tangut Western Xia, and Dali amid an economic and cultural boom.

summary.zh: 宋室南渡，以临安为行在，与金以淮河—大散关为界。北方蒙古崛起，1234 年宋蒙联军灭金后，蒙古连灭大理、吐蕃归附，南宋独支四十余年，终于崖山。拖动底部时间轴可查看各阶段疆域演变。
summary.en: Forced south of the Huai River–Dasan Pass line by Jurchen Jin, the Song court made Lin’an its provisional capital. After the Mongol–Song alliance destroyed Jin in 1234, Southern Song resisted the Mongols for four more decades until Yashan (1279).

summary.zh: 元朝首次将西藏、云南、漠北、东北纳入同一中央政权，创立行省制度。大都是欧亚贸易与文化交流中心。
summary.en: Kublai Khan’s Yuan dynasty brought Tibet, Yunnan, the Mongolian steppe, and Manchuria under a single administration for the first time and created the provincial system, with Dadu at the crossroads of Eurasia.

summary.zh: 洪武、永乐时设奴儿干都司、哈密卫、交趾布政司，郑和七下西洋；土木堡之变后收缩至长城、辽东，北御蒙古、东南抗倭；1616 年后金崛起，萨尔浒之战后辽东尽失。拖动底部时间轴可查看各阶段疆域演变。
summary.en: Early Ming established the Nurgan Commandery, Hami Guard, and Jiaozhi Province and sent Zheng He on seven Indian Ocean voyages. After the Tumu Crisis (1449) Ming pulled back to the Great Wall; in 1616 Later Jin rose in Manchuria.

summary.zh: 1644 年入关后，历康熙、雍正、乾隆三朝逐步奠定版图：收台湾、定漠北、平青海、设驻藏大臣、平定天山南北。1840 年后屡遭列强侵略，外东北与伊犁西境割让。拖动底部时间轴可查看各阶段疆域演变。
summary.en: Entering Shanhai Pass in 1644, the Kangxi, Yongzheng, and Qianlong emperors incorporated Taiwan, Outer Mongolia, Qinghai, Tibet, and Xinjiang. After the Opium War (1840), Outer Manchuria and western Ili were ceded to Russia. Drag across six stages.

summary.zh: 帝制终结，共和肇始。军阀混战、北伐、抗日战争与解放战争相继发生。图示 1936 年：东北为日本扶植的伪满洲国占据。
summary.en: The imperial system ended in 1912, followed by the Warlord Era, the Northern Expedition, the War of Resistance against Japan, and the Civil War. Shown in 1936 with Japanese-occupied Manchukuo in the northeast.

summary.zh: 1949 年成立。改革开放以来经济高速发展，香港、澳门回归，成为世界第二大经济体。
summary.en: Founded in 1949. Rapid economic growth since Reform and Opening in 1978, with the return of Hong Kong (1997) and Macau (1999).

title.zh: 战国初期（约前350年 · 三家分晋与七雄并立）
title.en: Early Warring States (c. 350 BCE · Partition of Jin & Seven Powers)

note.zh: 前403年周威烈王册命韩、赵、魏为诸侯（《资治通鉴》开篇），前386年田氏代齐，战国七雄格局确立；魏文侯、武侯任李悝、吴起率先称雄中原，巴、蜀、越、中山与东周王畿并存。
note.en: In 403 BCE King Weilie of Zhou recognized Han, Zhao, and Wei as feudal lords (opening Zizhi Tongjian), and in 386 BCE the Tian house became Marquis of Qi. Wei initially dominated the Central Plains while Ba, Shu, Yue, Zhongshan, and Royal Zhou coexisted.

title.zh: 战国中期之初（前340 — 前317 · 商鞅收河西与五国相王）
title.en: Early Mid-Warring States (340–317 BCE · Qin Retakes Hexi & Five-State Royal Accord)

note.zh: 前340年商鞅破魏收复河西，魏惠王东迁大梁并献上郡于秦；前323年公孙衍发起“五国相王”。此时巴、蜀、越、中山与义渠诸国皆尚独立存续。
note.en: In 340 BCE Shang Yang defeated Wei to retake Hexi, forcing King Hui of Wei to move his capital east to Daliang and cede Shangjun to Qin; in 323 BCE Gongsun Yan initiated the Five-State Royal Accord. Ba, Shu, Yue, Zhongshan, and Yiqu all remained independent.

title.zh: 战国中期前叶（前316 — 前307 · 秦灭巴蜀与丹阳之战取汉中）
title.en: Mid-Warring States (316–307 BCE · Qin Conquest of Ba–Shu & Hanzhong)

note.zh: 前316年秦惠文王遣司马错灭巴、蜀置巴郡与蜀郡，前312年丹阳、蓝田之战大破楚军取汉中郡；此时江南越国、河北中山国及陇东义渠尚存。
note.en: In 316 BCE King Huiwen of Qin sent Sima Cuo to conquer Ba and Shu, and in 312 BCE Qin defeated Chu at Danyang to take Hanzhong Commandery; Yue in the southeast, Zhongshan in Hebei, and Yiqu in the northwest still remained.

title.zh: 战国中期（前306 — 前301 · 楚怀王灭越与胡服骑射）
title.en: Mid-Warring States (306–301 BCE · Chu Annexation of Yue & Zhao Cavalry Reforms)

note.zh: 前306年楚怀王乘越国内乱攻灭越国，尽取旧吴之地并置江东；北方赵武灵王推行胡服骑射，中山与义渠尚存，燕国尚未东辟辽东。
note.en: In 306 BCE King Huai of Chu conquered Yue and absorbed the former Wu-Yue lands; in the north King Wuling of Zhao pursued cavalry archery reforms while Zhongshan and Yiqu persisted and Yan had not yet expanded into Liaodong.

title.zh: 战国中期后叶（前300 — 前297 · 燕将秦开辟燕北五郡与赵略中山）
title.en: Late Mid-Warring States (300–297 BCE · Yan General Qin Kai Expands into Liaodong)

note.zh: 前300年燕将秦开大破东胡却地千里，筑北长城置上谷、渔阳、右北平、辽西、燕北五郡；赵武灵王辟云中、雁门，中山国仅余灵寿一隅。
note.en: In 300 BCE Yan general Qin Kai pushed back the Donghu by a thousand li and established five northern commanderies into Liaodong; King Wuling of Zhao established Yunzhong and Yanmen while Zhongshan held onto Lingshou.

title.zh: 战国中后期（前296 — 前279 · 赵灭中山与乐毅破齐）
title.en: Late Mid-Warring States (296–279 BCE · Zhao Conquest of Zhongshan & Yue Yi’s Campaign Against Qi)

note.zh: 前296年赵惠文王彻底攻灭中山国，北境连成一片；前284年燕昭王拜乐毅统五国联军大破齐军。此时白起尚未拔郢，楚都仍在江陵郢都，陇东义渠尚存。
note.en: In 296 BCE King Huiwen of Zhao extinguished Zhongshan, uniting northern Hebei; in 284 BCE Yue Yi led a five-state coalition to rout Qi. Prior to Bai Qi’s 278 BCE campaign, the Chu capital remained at Ying (Jiangling) and Yiqu still stood in Longdong.

title.zh: 战国后期（前260年 · 白起拔郢与长平之战）
title.en: Late Warring States (260 BCE · Capture of Ying & Battle of Changping)

note.zh: 前284年乐毅率五国联军破齐；前278年秦将白起拔楚都郢置南郡，楚东迁陈郢；前260年秦赵长平决战，白起坑赵卒四十万，山东六国再难独力抗秦。
note.en: In 284 BCE Yue Yi led a five-state coalition to rout Qi; in 278 BCE Bai Qi captured the Chu capital Ying, forcing Chu east to Chen; in 260 BCE Bai Qi destroyed 400,000 Zhao troops at Changping, leaving no eastern state able to match Qin alone.

title.zh: 战国晚期（前249年 · 楚考烈王灭鲁与秦灭两周置三川郡）
title.en: Late Warring States (249 BCE · Chu Annexes Lu & Qin Establishes Sanchuan Commandery)

note.zh: 前256—前249年秦灭西周国与东周公国置三川郡；前249年楚考烈王伐鲁灭之、迁鲁顷公于莒，春申君黄歇徙封兰陵，礼乐宗邦鲁国并入楚境。
note.en: Between 256 and 249 BCE Qin extinguished Western and Eastern Zhou to establish Sanchuan Commandery; in 249 BCE King Kaolie of Chu annexed the ancient ritual state of Lu at Qufu, relocating Duke Qing to Ju while Lord Chunshen took Lanling as his fief.

title.zh: 秦王政亲政前夕（前238年 · 灭周置三川、东郡与六国合纵终结）
title.en: Eve of Unification (238 BCE · King Zheng Assumes Personal Rule)

note.zh: 前256—前249年秦灭两周置三川郡，前247年置太原郡，前242年置东郡与齐接界，彻底腰斩六国南北合纵通道；前238年秦王政亲政，部署十年灭六国之战。
note.en: Qin annexed the Eastern Zhou domain (256–249 BCE), established Taiyuan (247 BCE) and Dongjun (242 BCE) to sever the north-south coalition corridor, and in 238 BCE King Zheng assumed personal rule to launch the unification campaigns.

title.zh: 秦王扫六合 · 首灭韩国（前230年 · 内史腾俘韩王安，置颍川郡）
title.en: Qin Unification · Conquest of Han (230 BCE · Yingchuan Commandery Established)

note.zh: 前230年（秦王政十七年），秦内史腾攻韩，俘韩王安，尽纳其地置颍川郡。韩国成为六国中第一个覆灭的诸侯国。
note.en: In 230 BCE Qin Governor Teng captured King An of Han at Xinzheng and established Yingchuan Commandery, making Han the first of the six states to fall.

title.zh: 秦王扫六合 · 攻克邯郸灭赵（前228年 · 王翦破赵，公子嘉奔代）
title.en: Qin Unification · Fall of Handan & Conquest of Zhao (228 BCE)

note.zh: 前228年（秦王政十九年），王翦大破赵军攻克邯郸，俘赵王迁；赵公子嘉率宗族奔代称代王，与燕联兵拒秦。
note.en: In 228 BCE Wang Jian captured Handan and King Qian of Zhao; Prince Jia fled north to Dai to continue resistance alongside Yan.

title.zh: 秦王扫六合 · 易水破燕拔蓟城（前226年 · 燕王喜东保辽东）
title.en: Qin Unification · Capture of Jicheng in Yan (226 BCE)

note.zh: 前227年荆轲刺秦不果，王翦、辛胜大破燕代联军于易水之西，前226年十月攻拔燕都蓟城，燕王喜斩太子丹首级献秦，退保辽东襄平。
note.en: Following Jing Ke’s failed assassination attempt (227 BCE), Wang Jian routed the Yan-Dai army west of the Yi River and captured Jicheng in 226 BCE, forcing King Xi of Yan to retreat to Liaodong.

title.zh: 秦王扫六合 · 水灌大梁灭魏（前225年 · 三晋尽入于秦）
title.en: Qin Unification · Flooding of Daliang & Conquest of Wei (225 BCE)

note.zh: 前225年（秦王政二十二年），王贲引黄河、鸿沟之水灌魏都大梁，三月城坏，魏王假出降，魏国灭亡，三晋故地尽归于秦。
note.en: In 225 BCE Wang Ben diverted the Yellow River and Honggou Canal to flood Daliang for three months; King Jia surrendered, completing Qin’s conquest of the Three Jins.

title.zh: 秦王扫六合 · 灭楚平燕代，唯余齐国（前223—前222年）
title.en: Qin Unification · Conquest of Chu, Yan & Dai; Only Qi Remains (223–222 BCE)

note.zh: 前223年王翦、蒙武统六十万大军破楚拔寿春，俘楚王负刍；前222年王贲攻灭辽东燕王喜与代王嘉，王翦悉定江南置会稽郡，六国唯余东海之滨的齐国孤悬。
note.en: In 223 BCE Wang Jian and Meng Wu conquered Chu at Shouchun; in 222 BCE Wang Ben extinguished Yan in Liaodong and Dai while Wang Jian pacified Jiangnan, leaving Qi isolated on the eastern coast.

title.zh: 前 221 — 前 215 · 秦灭六国初年：北未收河套，南未平百越
title.en: 221–215 BCE · Early Qin Unification (Before Ordos & Lingnan Campaigns)

title.zh: 189—195 年 · 董卓入京与关东诸侯并起
title.en: 189–195 CE · Dong Zhuo in the Capital & Rise of the Guandong Coalition

note.zh: 189 年董卓入洛阳废立少帝，190 年袁绍、曹操等关东诸侯联兵讨董，董卓挟献帝西迁长安；192 年董卓诛后李傕、郭汜把持长安朝政，北方袁绍据冀州与幽州公孙瓒争河北，凉州马腾韩遂割据，曹操崛起兖豫，南方刘表据荆州、刘焉据益州、孙坚等起兵江东。
note.en: In 189 Dong Zhuo seized Luoyang and deposed the young emperor; in 190 the Guandong coalition rose against him and Dong Zhuo moved Emperor Xian west to Chang'an. In the north Yuan Shao in Jizhou contested Hebei against Gongsun Zan in Youzhou, Ma Teng and Han Sui held Liangzhou, Cao Cao rose in Yanzhou and Yuzhou, Liu Biao held Jingzhou, Liu Yan held Yizhou, and Sun Jian rose in Jiangdong.

title.zh: 196—199 年 · 曹操迎献帝迁许与袁绍南北争衡
title.en: 196–199 CE · Cao Cao Escorts Emperor Xian to Xuchang vs. Yuan Shao in Hebei

note.zh: 196 年汉献帝东归洛阳，曹操迎天子迁都许昌，“奉天子以令不臣”，据有河南、兖、豫、徐州；北方袁绍灭公孙瓒尽统冀、青、幽、并四州，与曹操隔黄河对峙；凉州及关西由马腾、韩遂等割据，江东孙策渡江平定吴会六郡。
note.en: In 196 Cao Cao escorted Emperor Xian to Xuchang, holding Henan, Yanzhou, Yuzhou, and Xuzhou in the imperial name; north of the Yellow River, Yuan Shao eliminated Gongsun Zan to unite the four provinces of Jizhou, Qingzhou, Youzhou, and Bingzhou; Ma Teng and Han Sui held Liangzhou and Guanxi, while Sun Ce conquered Jiangdong.

title.zh: 200—207 年 · 官渡之战与曹操统一北方
title.en: 200–207 CE · Battle of Guandu & Cao Cao Unifying the North

note.zh: 200 年曹操于官渡之战以少胜多击败袁绍主力，随后平定冀、青、幽、并四州及乌桓，基本统一北方；南方刘表据荆州、刘璋据益州、孙权嗣位统事江东。
note.en: In 200 Cao Cao defeated Yuan Shao against the odds at the Battle of Guandu and went on to pacify Jizhou, Qingzhou, Youzhou, Bingzhou, and the Wuhuan, unifying northern China while Liu Biao held Jingzhou, Liu Zhang held Yizhou, and Sun Quan consolidated Jiangdong.

title.zh: 208—213 年 · 赤壁之战：孙刘破曹与刘备据荆州
title.en: 208–213 CE · Battle of Red Cliffs: Sun–Liu Alliance & Liu Bei in Jingzhou

note.zh: 208 年曹操南下荆州，孙权、刘备联军于赤壁大破曹军；战后刘备收江南荆州四郡并向孙权“借荆州”（南郡），据有荆州，此时巴蜀益州仍由刘璋割据，直至 214 年刘备入成都。
note.en: In 208 the allied forces of Sun Quan and Liu Bei defeated Cao Cao at the Battle of Red Cliffs; Liu Bei secured southern Jingzhou and Nanjun to hold Jingzhou, while Yizhou (Sichuan) remained under Liu Zhang until 214.

title.zh: 214—218 年 · 刘备入成都，跨有荆、益二州
title.en: 214–218 CE · Liu Bei Takes Chengdu, Spanning Jingzhou and Yizhou

note.zh: 214 年刘备率军入成都迫降刘璋，正式领益州牧，实践《隆中对》“跨有荆、益”战略，与北方曹操、江东孙权形成三方鼎立之势。
note.en: In 214 Liu Bei entered Chengdu and received Liu Zhang's surrender to become Governor of Yizhou, fulfilling the Longzhong Plan by holding both Jingzhou and Yizhou opposite Cao Cao in the north and Sun Quan in Jiangdong.

title.zh: 219—220 年 · 刘备取汉中与吕蒙白衣渡江袭荆州
title.en: 219–220 CE · Liu Bei Takes Hanzhong & Lü Meng Seizes Jingzhou

note.zh: 219 年刘备定军山破夏侯渊取得汉中，进位汉中王；同年冬孙权遣吕蒙白衣渡江袭取荆州，关羽败走麦城，荆州尽归孙权，刘备退保益州与汉中。
note.en: In 219 Liu Bei took Hanzhong and became King of Hanzhong; that winter Sun Quan sent Lü Meng to seize Jingzhou in a stealth crossing, Guan Yu fell at Maicheng, and Liu Bei was confined to Yizhou and Hanzhong.

note.zh: 炀帝三征高句丽引发天下大乱：瓦岗李密围逼东都洛阳，窦建德据河北，杜伏威控江淮，萧铣起兵荆襄，薛举据陇西，617 年李渊自太原起兵入据长安。
note.en: Emperor Yang’s three Goguryeo campaigns sparked nationwide rebellions: Li Mi’s Wagang Army besieged Luoyang, Dou Jiande held Hebei, Du Fuwei controlled Jianghuai, Xiao Xian rose in Jingxiang, Xue Ju held Longxi, and in 617 Li Yuan marched from Taiyuan to capture Chang’an.

title.zh: 618—621 年 · 武德建唐与统一战争初期
title.en: 618–621 CE · Founding of Tang & Early Reunification Wars

note.zh: 618 年李渊于长安称帝建唐，先平陇西薛仁杲、河西李轨、河东刘武周，巩固关中、河东与巴蜀根据地，与洛阳王世充、河北窦建德、江陵萧铣对峙。
note.en: In 618 Li Yuan proclaimed the Tang Dynasty in Chang’an, pacifying Xue Rengao in Longxi, Li Gui in Hexi, and Liu Wuzhou in Hedong to secure Guanzhong, Hedong, and Bashu while facing Wang Shichong in Luoyang, Dou Jiande in Hebei, and Xiao Xian in Jiangling.

note.zh: 621 年李世民于虎牢之战一举擒窦建德、降王世充，李孝恭、李靖平定江南萧铣，唐朝基本统一全国，北与东突厥对峙于阴山一线。
note.en: In 621 Li Shimin captured Dou Jiande and forced Wang Shichong’s surrender at the Battle of Hulao while Li Xiaogong and Li Jing pacified Xiao Xian in the south, reuniting China and facing the Eastern Turks along the Yin Mountains.

title.en: 1351–1363 CE · Late Yuan Red Turban Uprisings & Rival Warlords

note.zh: 1351 年韩山童、刘福通发动红巾军起义；徐寿辉、陈友谅据湖广江西，张士诚据平江（浙西），朱元璋渡江取集庆（应天），明玉珍入据巴蜀。
note.en: In 1351 Han Shantong and Liu Futong launched the Red Turban rebellion; Xu Shouhui and Chen Youliang held Huguang and Jiangxi, Zhang Shicheng held Suzhou, Zhu Yuanzhang crossed the Yangtze to take Nanjing, and Ming Yuzhen entered Sichuan.

title.zh: 1363—1368 年 · 鄱阳湖决战后朱元璋一统江南
title.en: 1363–1368 CE · Battle of Lake Poyang & Zhu Yuanzhang Unifying Jiangnan

note.zh: 1363 年朱元璋于鄱阳湖大败陈友谅，尽有湖广江西，1364 年进封吴王；1367 年攻灭平江张士诚、迫降浙东方国珍，随即誓师北伐大都、南征闽广。
note.en: In 1363 Zhu Yuanzhang defeated Chen Youliang at Lake Poyang to secure Huguang and Jiangxi, took the title King of Wu in 1364, conquered Zhang Shicheng and Fang Guozhen in 1367, and launched the Northern and Southern Expeditions.

title.zh: 1368—1369 年 · 朱元璋建明与徐达北伐克大都
title.en: 1368–1369 CE · Founding of Ming & Xu Da’s Northern Expedition Capturing Dadu

note.zh: 1368 年正月朱元璋于应天称帝建明，南征闽广、北取山东河南；八月徐达攻克元大都（改北平府），元顺帝北走上都。此时晋陕陇右、辽东、四川明夏与云南梁王尚待平定。
note.en: In January 1368 Zhu Yuanzhang proclaimed the Ming Dynasty in Yingtian (Nanjing), securing Fujian, Guangdong, Shandong, and Henan; in August Xu Da captured Yuan Dadu (renamed Beiping) as the Yuan emperor fled to Shangdu, while Shanxi-Shaanxi, Liaodong, Sichuan Ming Xia, and Yunnan remained to be unified.

title.zh: 1369—1371 年 · 徐达克定晋陕与北元南北对峙
title.en: 1369–1371 CE · Pacifying Shanxi-Shaanxi & Standoff with Northern Yuan

note.zh: 徐达、常遇春西下太原、关中与陇右，李文忠克应昌；元廷退居漠北史称“北元”，故元平章纳哈出仍盘踞辽东，西南四川为明夏政权、云南为元梁王据守。
note.en: Xu Da and Chang Yuchun conquered Taiyuan, Guanzhong, and Longyou while Li Wenzhong took Yingchang; the Yuan court retreated to the steppe as Northern Yuan while Naghachu held Liaodong, Ming Xia held Sichuan, and the Yuan Prince of Liang held Yunnan.

title.zh: 1371—1382 年 · 平定四川明夏与经营西番
title.en: 1371–1382 CE · Conquest of Sichuan Ming Xia & Administration of Tibet

note.zh: 1371 年汤和、傅友德水陆并进灭四川明夏，巴蜀并入明廷并设乌斯藏都司；北方北元与辽东纳哈出尚存，西南云南仍由元梁王把匝剌瓦尔密割据。
note.en: In 1371 Tang He and Fu Youde conquered Ming Xia in Sichuan and established the Ü-Tsang Commission, while Northern Yuan and Naghachu held the north and Liaodong, and the Yuan Prince of Liang still held Yunnan.

title.zh: 1382—1388 年 · 平定云南与北伐辽东前夕
title.en: 1382–1388 CE · Pacification of Yunnan & Eve of the Liaodong Campaign

note.zh: 1382 年傅友德、蓝玉、沐英平定云南元梁王与大理段氏，西南一统；东北辽东仍由北元纳哈出所部据守，直至 1387 年纳哈出降明、1388 年捕鱼儿海大捷。
note.en: In 1382 Fu Youde, Lan Yu, and Mu Ying pacified the Yuan Prince of Liang and the Duan clan in Yunnan; Naghachu held Liaodong for Northern Yuan until his surrender in 1387 and the Battle of Buir Lake in 1388.

title.zh: 1388—1407 年 · 洪武一统版图与北元（鞑靼·瓦剌）并立
title.en: 1388–1407 CE · Complete Hongwu Unification & Northern Yuan (Tatars & Oirats)

note.zh: 1387 年收复辽东置辽东都司，1388 年蓝玉于捕鱼儿海大破北元汗廷，洪武两京十三省核心版图最终完成；漠北北元（1402 年后称鞑靼、瓦剌）与明廷隔长城南北对峙。
note.en: After recovering Liaodong (1387) and crushing the Northern Yuan court at Lake Buir (1388), the Hongwu core realm was complete, facing Northern Yuan (Tatars and Oirats after 1402) across the Great Wall.

title.zh: 1407—1427 年 · 永乐极盛疆域（设交趾布政司与奴儿干都司）
title.en: 1407–1427 CE · Yongle Zenith (Jiaozhi Province & Nurgan Commission)

note.zh: 永乐五年（1407）张辅平定安南胡朝，置交趾承宣布政使司；1409 年于黑龙江口特林设奴儿干都司，西设哈密卫，北五征漠北，1421 年正式迁都北京。
note.en: In 1407 Zhang Fu pacified the Ho Dynasty in Vietnam to establish Jiaozhi Province; in 1409 Ming established the Nurgan Commission on the lower Amur, set up Hami Guard in the west, led five steppe campaigns, and moved the capital to Beijing in 1421.

title.zh: 1427—1449 年 · 仁宣之治与罢交趾布政使司
title.en: 1427–1449 CE · Rule of Ren and Xuan & Withdrawal from Jiaozhi (Vietnam)

note.zh: 宣德二年（1427）柳升援军于支棱失利，明宣宗采纳杨士奇、杨荣建议，诏罢交趾布政使司撤军还朝，安南黎利建立后黎朝；东北仍维持奴儿干都司羁縻。
note.en: After Liu Sheng fell at Chi Lang in 1427, Emperor Xuanzong abolished the Jiaozhi Provincial Administration and withdrew Ming troops from Vietnam as Le Loi founded the Later Le Dynasty.

title.zh: 邯郸之战：魏信陵君“窃符救赵”合楚春申君大破秦军

title.en: Hydraulic engineer Zheng Guo builds the 300-li Zheng Guo Canal, turning Guanzhong fertile

title.zh: 五国最后合纵攻秦败于蕞；楚畏秦自陈东迁寿春
title.en: Final five-state coalition against Qin fails at Zui; Chu moves its capital east to Shouchun

title.zh: 秦王政亲政，平嫪毐、罢吕不韦，部署灭六国方略
title.en: King Zheng of Qin assumes rule, crushes Lao Ai, ousts Lü Buwei, and plans unification

title.zh: 王翦、桓齮攻赵邺城取九城，拉开秦灭六国序幕
title.en: Wang Jian and Huan Yi take nine cities around Ye, opening Qin’s wars of unification

title.zh: 秦灭韩：内史腾急袭新郑俘韩王安，置颍川郡
title.en: Conquest of Han: Qin Governor Teng captures King An at Xinzheng and sets Yingchuan Commandery

title.zh: 秦灭赵：王翦克邯郸俘赵王迁，公子嘉奔代自立
title.en: Conquest of Zhao: Wang Jian captures Handan and King Qian; Prince Jia flees to proclaim Dai

title.zh: 荆轲刺秦不中；王翦破燕拔蓟城，燕王喜走辽东
title.en: After Jing Ke’s failed assassination, Wang Jian captures Jicheng; King Xi flees to Liaodong

title.zh: 秦灭魏：王贲引河沟水灌大梁，魏王假降，魏亡
title.en: Conquest of Wei: Wang Ben floods Daliang with Yellow River waters; King Jia surrenders

title.zh: 秦灭楚：王翦统军六十万斩项燕、克寿春俘楚王
title.en: Conquest of Chu: Wang Jian leads 600,000 troops to defeat Xiang Yan and capture Shouchun

title.zh: 王贲灭燕与代，王翦定江南置会稽郡，唯余齐国
title.en: Wang Ben conquers Yan and Dai while Wang Jian pacifies Jiangnan; only Qi remains

title.zh: 秦王嬴政统一六国，称“始皇帝”
title.en: King Ying Zheng unifies the six states as the First Emperor

title.zh: 蒙恬北击匈奴，收复河套，连接长城
title.en: Meng Tian drives the Xiongnu from the Ordos Loop and links the Great Wall

title.zh: 开凿灵渠通湘漓，平定岭南置桂林、象、南海三郡
title.en: Qin digs the Lingqu Canal and pacifies Lingnan, establishing Guilin, Xiang, and Nanhai

title.zh: 秦始皇采李斯议下“焚书令”，次年于咸阳坑杀方士儒生
title.en: First Emperor decrees the Burning of Books on Li Si advice, executing scholars next year

title.zh: 命蒙恬修筑秦直道（咸阳至九原）
title.en: Meng Tian builds the 700 km Qin Direct Road from Xianyang to Jiuyuan

title.zh: 沙丘政变：始皇崩于沙丘，赵高李斯矫诏杀扶苏立胡亥
title.en: Shaqiu Coup: First Emperor dies; Zhao Gao and Li Si forge an edict to enthrone Huhai

title.zh: 陈胜吴广大泽乡起义
title.en: Chen Sheng and Wu Guang launch the Dazexiang Uprising

title.zh: 项羽巨鹿之战破釜沉舟；刘邦进逼咸阳
title.en: Xiang Yu crushes Qin main forces at Julu; Liu Bang marches on Xianyang

title.zh: 秦王子婴降，秦亡；鸿门宴后楚汉之争开启
title.en: Qin ruler Ziying surrenders; Feast at Hong Gate begins Chu–Han Contention

title.zh: 韩信于井陉背水一战灭赵，楚汉两军于荥阳、成皋持久相持
title.en: Han Xin destroys the Zhao army at Jingxing Pass while Liu Bang and Xiang Yu clash at Xingyang

title.zh: 楚汉荥阳成皋相持，“鸿沟议和”中分天下旋追击项羽
title.en: Chu-Han stalemate ends in the Hong Canal Pact dividing the realm before Han pursues Chu

title.zh: 垓下之战十面埋伏灭项羽，汉高祖刘邦称帝定都长安
title.en: Liu Bang defeats Xiang Yu at Gaixia and ascends the throne as Emperor Gaozu of Western Han

title.zh: 白登之围，汉初行和亲之策
title.en: Siege of Baideng; Han adopts Heqin marriage-alliance policy

title.zh: 周勃、陈平诛灭诸吕迎立汉文帝，开启休养生息之政
title.en: Zhou Bo and Chen Ping eliminate the Lü clan and enthrone Emperor Wen of Han

title.zh: 汉文帝废除肉刑、免收全国田租，与景帝轻徭薄赋共创“文景之治”
title.en: Emperor Wen abolishes corporal punishment and land taxes, ushering in the Rule of Wen and Jing

title.zh: 七国之乱，削藩后中央集权确立
title.en: Rebellion of the Seven States suppressed; central authority consolidated

title.zh: 张骞出使西域，凿空丝绸之路
title.en: Zhang Qian sets out for the Western Regions, opening the Silk Road

title.zh: 汉武帝采董仲舒策罢黜百家、独尊儒术，兴太学置博士
title.en: Emperor Wu adopts Dong Zhongshu plan, elevating Confucianism and founding the Imperial Academy

title.zh: 马邑之谋，汉匈全面战争爆发
title.en: Plot of Mayi; full-scale Han–Xiongnu war begins

title.zh: 卫青收复河套置朔方郡；主父偃献《推恩令》削弱诸侯
title.en: Wei Qing recovers the Ordos Loop for Shuofang Commandery; Decree of Extended Grace curbs princes

title.zh: 霍去病两次河西之战，设河西四郡
title.en: Huo Qubing’s Hexi campaigns; the Four Hexi Commanderies founded

title.zh: 漠北之战，卫青破单于、霍去病封狼居胥
title.en: Mobei Campaign; Wei Qing & Huo Qubing rout the Xiongnu

title.zh: 平定南越，设九郡
title.en: Conquest of Nanyue; nine southern commanderies established

title.zh: 汉武帝灭闽越国迁其民于江淮，并于海南岛置珠崖、儋耳二郡
title.en: Emperor Wu conquers Minyue and establishes Zhuya and Dan'er commanderies on Hainan Island

site.zh: 东冶 · 珠崖（福州 · 海口）

title.zh: 汉武帝发兵平西南夷，滇王降汉，置益州郡赐金印
title.en: Emperor Wu pacifies the Southwestern Yi; King of Dian submits and Yizhou Commandery is set

title.zh: 灭卫氏朝鲜，设乐浪等四郡
title.en: Conquest of Wiman Joseon; Lelang and three other commanderies established

title.zh: 贰师将军李广利伐大宛，丝路昆仑北路畅通
title.en: Li Guangli's Dayuan campaign secures the Southern Tarim Silk Road

title.zh: 巫蛊之祸太子刘据兵败自尽；太史令司马迁撰成《史记》
title.en: Witchcraft Crisis drives Prince Liu Ju to suicide; Sima Qian completes the Shiji chronicle

title.zh: 武帝下轮台罪己诏，转向与民休息
title.en: Emperor Wu issues the Luntai Edict of Repentance

title.zh: 大将军霍光废昌邑王刘贺，迎立汉宣帝开启昭宣中兴
title.en: Regent Huo Guang deposes Liu He after 27 days and enthrones Emperor Xuan (Zhaoxuan Restoration)

title.zh: 赵充国率军平定河湟先零诸羌，首创河湟军屯并置破羌县
title.en: General Zhao Chongguo pacifies the Qiang in Hehuang and pioneers frontier military farms

site.zh: 临羌 · 湟水（青海西宁）

title.zh: 设西域都护府，西域正式纳入版图
title.en: Protectorate of the Western Regions established at Wulei

title.zh: 呼韩邪单于朝觐汉宣帝，画麒麟阁十一功臣
title.en: Chanyu Huhanye pays homage to Emperor Xuan; 11 ministers honored in Qilin Pavilion

title.zh: 昭君出塞，呼韩邪单于入朝和亲
title.en: Wang Zhaojun marries Xiongnu Chanyu Huhanye

title.zh: 西域都护段会宗复入乌孙平定内乱，安辑葱岭以西诸国
title.en: Protector-General Duan Huizong pacifies strife in Wusun and stabilizes the Pamir states

title.zh: 汉成帝改置三公；王莽任大司马，王氏外戚掌权
title.en: Emperor Cheng establishes Three Excellencies; Wang Mang becomes Grand Marshal

title.zh: 王莽代汉，建国号新
title.en: Wang Mang usurps the throne and proclaims the Xin dynasty

title.zh: 黄河于魏郡元城决口，禹贡北流故道断绝泛滥兖豫
title.en: Yellow River breaches at Yuancheng, ending the ancient northern course and flooding the east

title.zh: 昆阳之战，新朝覆亡
title.en: Battle of Kunyang; collapse of the Xin dynasty

title.zh: 更始帝刘玄迁都长安；刘秀攻拔邯郸诛王郎，悉平河北诸部
title.en: Gengshi Emperor moves his court to Chang’an while Liu Xiu captures Handan and pacifies Hebei

title.zh: 刘秀称帝，定都洛阳
title.en: Liu Xiu (Emperor Guangwu) proclaims the Eastern Han at Luoyang

title.zh: 平公孙述，光武统一全国
title.en: Defeat of Gongsun Shu in Sichuan completes reunification

title.zh: 伏波将军马援南征交趾平二征起义，立铜柱定汉界
title.en: General Ma Yuan suppresses the Trưng sisters in Jiaozhi and erects bronze border pillars

title.zh: 匈奴分裂，南匈奴内附
title.en: Xiongnu split; the Southern Xiongnu submit and settle inside the frontier

title.zh: 汉明帝建白马寺，佛教正式传入洛阳
title.en: Emperor Ming founds White Horse Temple; Buddhism takes root

title.zh: 王景发卒数十万修渠治河，形成千年安流“王景故道”
title.en: Wang Jing builds a 500-km Yellow River levee system, stabilizing its course for a millennium

title.zh: 班超出使西域，重开丝路
title.en: Ban Chao sent to the Western Regions, reopening the Silk Road

title.zh: 窦宪破北匈奴于稽落山，登燕然山勒石记功
title.en: Dou Xian routs the Northern Xiongnu at Jiluo and carves a victory stele on Mt. Yanran

title.zh: 金微山之战：耿夔大破北匈奴，北单于西遁
title.en: Geng Kui crushes the Northern Xiongnu at Mt. Jinwei (Altai) and the Chanyu flees west

title.zh: 永元之隆：汉和帝联结郑众诛大将军窦宪，东汉达极盛
title.en: Prosperity of Yongyuan: Emperor He ousts Regent Dou Xian and brings Eastern Han to its zenith

title.zh: 班超遣甘英出使大秦（罗马）
title.en: Ban Chao dispatches Gan Ying toward Daqin (Roman Empire)

title.zh: 蔡伦奏进改进造纸术（蔡侯纸）
title.en: Imperial eunuch Cai Lun refines the papermaking process in Luoyang

title.zh: 永初羌乱爆发席卷凉州，东汉罢西域都护
title.en: Qiang uprisings engulf Liangzhou as Han withdraws its Protectorate of the Western Regions

title.zh: 班勇任西域长史屯兵柳中破北匈奴，复通西域
title.en: Ban Yong (son of Ban Chao) garrisons Liuzhong and defeats Northern Xiongnu, reopening Tarim

title.zh: 张衡造候风地动仪与浑天仪
title.en: Zhang Heng invents the seismoscope and armillary sphere

title.zh: 护羌校尉赵冲战殁，西羌大乱席卷关陇；汉顺帝崩，梁冀专权
title.en: Major Qiang rebellion sweeps Guanzhong and Longyou while Regent Liang Ji monopolizes power

title.zh: 汉桓帝与单超等五宦官合谋诛灭梁冀外戚集团；段颎于陇右破羌
title.en: Emperor Huan and five eunuchs overthrow Regent Liang Ji while Duan Jiong crushes the Qiang

title.zh: 党锢之祸：166、169 年两兴党狱，清流名士遭禁锢诛戮
title.en: The Partisan Prohibitions of 166 and 169 ban and execute leading scholar-officials

title.zh: 夏育、田晏、臧旻三路伐鲜卑大败，檀石槐称雄漠南
title.en: Three Han columns against the Xianbei are routed and Tanshihuai dominates the southern steppe

site.zh: 高柳 · 云中 · 雁门

title.zh: 张角率太平道发起黄巾起义
title.en: Zhang Jue launches the Yellow Turban Rebellion across eight provinces

title.zh: 董卓入洛阳，次年迁都长安
title.en: Dong Zhuo seizes Luoyang and burns the capital the next year

title.zh: 曹操迎汉献帝迁都许昌
title.en: Cao Cao escorts Emperor Xian to Xuchang

title.zh: 官渡之战，曹操统一北方
title.en: Battle of Guandu: Cao Cao unifies northern China

title.zh: 刘备三顾茅庐定《隆中对》；曹操北征乌桓斩蹋顿
title.en: Liu Bei visits Zhuge Liang for the Longzhong Plan; Cao Cao routs the Wuhuan at Mt. Bailang

title.zh: 赤壁之战，孙刘联军破曹，刘备据有荆州
title.en: Battle of Red Cliffs: Sun-Liu alliance defeats Cao Cao; Liu Bei holds Jingzhou

title.zh: 潼关之战：曹操渡渭离间大破马超、韩遂，平定关陇
title.en: Battle of Tong Pass: Cao Cao defeats Ma Chao and Han Sui to pacify Guanzhong

title.zh: 刘备入成都迫降刘璋，跨有荆、益二州
title.en: Liu Bei enters Chengdu and receives Liu Zhang’s surrender, holding both Jingzhou and Yizhou

title.zh: 孙刘“湘水划界”分荆州；张辽威震逍遥津大破孙权
title.en: Sun-Liu Xiang River pact divides Jingzhou; Zhang Liao routs Sun Quan at Xiaoyao Ford

title.zh: 刘备取汉中称王；冬吕蒙白衣渡江袭荆州，关羽败亡
title.en: Liu Bei takes Hanzhong; in winter Lü Meng seizes Jingzhou and Guan Yu falls

title.zh: 曹丕代汉称帝，国号魏
title.en: Cao Pi forces Emperor Xian to abdicate and proclaims Cao Wei

title.zh: 刘备在成都称帝，国号汉
title.en: Liu Bei proclaims himself emperor of Shu Han at Chengdu

title.zh: 夷陵之战，陆逊火烧连营大破刘备
title.en: Battle of Yiling; Lu Xun defeats Liu Bei by fire attack

title.zh: 刘备病逝永安白帝城，临终托孤于丞相诸葛亮
title.en: Liu Bei dies at White Emperor City in Yong'an, entrusting the state to Zhuge Liang

title.zh: 诸葛亮南征孟获，平定南中
title.en: Zhuge Liang's Southern Campaign pacifies Nanzhong

title.zh: 诸葛亮首次北伐，马谡失街亭
title.en: Zhuge Liang's First Northern Expedition; loss of Jieting

title.zh: 孙权称帝，迁都建业
title.en: Sun Quan proclaims himself emperor of Wu and moves the capital to Jianye

title.zh: 孙权遣卫温、诸葛直航海至夷洲（台湾）
title.en: Sun Quan dispatches Wei Wen's fleet to Yizhou (Taiwan)

title.zh: 司马懿坚壁拒守百余日；诸葛亮病逝五丈原，蜀军退回汉中
title.en: Sima Yi holds firm for over 100 days; Zhuge Liang dies on Wuzhang Plains and Shu retreats

title.zh: 司马懿远征辽东斩公孙渊，收复辽东与乐浪、带方
title.en: Sima Yi conquers Liaodong and executes Gongsun Yuan, recovering Lelang and Daifang

title.zh: 高平陵之变，司马懿控制曹魏朝政
title.en: Incident at the Gaoping Tombs; Sima Yi seizes power in Wei

title.zh: 甘露之变：魏帝曹髦率宿卫讨司马昭，于南阙下遇弑
title.en: Coup of Ganlu: Wei Emperor Cao Mao marches against Sima Zhao and is slain at the palace gate

title.zh: 邓艾、钟会率魏军伐蜀，蜀汉亡
title.en: Wei generals Deng Ai and Zhong Hui conquer Shu Han at Chengdu

title.zh: 司马炎代魏称帝，建立西晋
title.en: Sima Yan replaces Cao Wei and establishes Western Jin

title.zh: 晋军六路伐吴，王濬楼船下益州
title.en: Western Jin launches six-pronged invasion of Eastern Wu

title.zh: 西晋灭吴，三国归晋
title.en: Western Jin conquers Eastern Wu, ending the Three Kingdoms

title.zh: 西晋灭吴，三国归晋
title.en: Western Jin conquers Eastern Wu, reunifying China

title.zh: 晋武帝司马炎卒，惠帝即位，杨骏、贾南风相继专权
title.en: Emperor Wu dies; Empress Jia Nanfeng's court intrigues begin

title.zh: 贾南风干政，西晋八王之乱爆发
title.en: Empress Jia Nanfeng seizes power, sparking the War of the Eight Princes

title.zh: 赵王司马伦篡位，八王之乱全面升级
title.en: Sima Lun usurps the throne; War of the Eight Princes escalates

title.zh: 刘渊称汉王，十六国之始
title.en: Liu Yuan proclaims the kingdom of Han, opening the Sixteen Kingdoms era

title.zh: 李雄在成都称帝建大成（成汉）；司马越迎惠帝还洛阳
title.en: Li Xiong proclaims Cheng-Han in Chengdu; Sima Yue controls Luoyang court

title.zh: 永嘉之乱，洛阳陷落
title.en: Disaster of Yongjia: Luoyang falls and Emperor Huai is captured

title.zh: 晋愍帝在长安即位；祖逖中流击楫渡江北伐
title.en: Emperor Min enthroned in Chang'an; Zu Ti crosses the Yangtze north

title.zh: 长安陷落，西晋亡
title.en: Chang'an falls; end of Western Jin

title.zh: 司马睿在建康即晋王位，东晋建立
title.en: Sima Rui establishes the Eastern Jin court at Jiankang

title.zh: 石勒称赵王，建立后赵
title.en: Shi Le proclaims himself King of Zhao, founding Later Zhao

title.zh: 王敦之乱：王敦自武昌举兵攻入建康，控制东晋朝政
title.en: Rebellion of Wang Dun: Wang Dun marches from Wuchang into Jiankang and controls the court

title.zh: 石勒灭前赵，后赵统一北方大部
title.en: Shi Le destroys Former Zhao; Later Zhao unifies most of northern China

title.zh: 石虎迁后赵都城自襄国至邺城
title.en: Shi Hu moves the Later Zhao capital from Xiangguo to Ye

title.zh: 桓温西征灭成汉，收复巴蜀
title.en: Huan Wen conquers Cheng-Han and recovers Sichuan

title.zh: 苻健在长安称天王，建立前秦
title.en: Fu Jian proclaims the Former Qin at Chang’an

title.zh: 王羲之与谢安等雅集会稽山阴兰亭，作《兰亭集序》
title.en: Wang Xizhi and Xie An gather at the Orchid Pavilion in Kuaiji, composing Preface to Lanting

title.zh: 桓温首次北伐至灞上，王猛扪虱谈天下
title.en: Huan Wen’s first northern expedition reaches Bashang; Wang Meng meets Huan Wen

title.zh: 前秦苻坚遣王猛攻破邺城，灭前燕
title.en: Fu Jian of Former Qin sends Wang Meng to capture Ye and destroy Former Yan

title.zh: 前秦灭前凉、代国，苻坚统一北方
title.en: Former Qin conquers Former Liang and Dai; Fu Jian unifies northern China

title.zh: 淝水之战：谢安、谢玄率八万北府兵大破苻坚大军，前秦瓦解
title.en: Battle of Fei River: Xie An & Xie Xuan’s Beifu army routs Fu Jian; Former Qin collapses

title.zh: 慕容垂建后燕、姚苌建后秦，北方再度分裂
title.en: Murong Chui founds Later Yan and Yao Chang founds Later Qin

title.zh: 乞伏国仁在陇西建西秦；吕光据凉州建后凉
title.en: Qifu Guoren founds Western Qin; Lü Guang founds Later Liang

title.zh: 拓跋珪复代称王，建立北魏
title.en: Tuoba Gui restores Dai and founds Northern Wei

title.zh: 参合陂之战，北魏大破后燕主力，进据中原
title.en: Battle of Canhe Slope: Northern Wei crushes the Later Yan army

title.zh: 河西鲜卑秃发乌孤起兵建南凉，定都乐都、西平据有河湟
title.en: Tufa Wugu founds Southern Liang in the Hehuang valley with capitals at Ledu and Xiping

site.zh: 乐都 · 西平（青海海东 · 西宁）

title.zh: 拓跋珪自盛乐迁都平城，正式称帝（北魏道武帝）
title.en: Tuoba Gui moves the Northern Wei capital to Pingcheng and takes imperial title

title.zh: 慕容德据青州建南燕，定都广固
title.en: Murong De founds Southern Yan in Shandong with Guanggu as capital

title.zh: 桓玄篡晋建楚；北府将刘裕自京口起兵讨平桓玄复晋
title.en: Liu Yu rises at Jingkou to crush usurper Huan Xuan and restore the Eastern Jin court

site.zh: 京口 · 建康 · 江陵

title.zh: 赫连勃勃建大夏，筑统万城
title.en: Helian Bobo founds the Xia kingdom and builds Tongwancheng

title.zh: 刘裕北伐攻破广固，灭南燕
title.en: Liu Yu’s northern expedition captures Guanggu and destroys Southern Yan

title.zh: 刘裕北伐灭后秦，收复洛阳、长安
title.en: Liu Yu's northern expedition destroys Later Qin and retakes Luoyang & Chang'an

title.zh: 刘裕代晋建宋，南朝开始
title.en: Liu Yu replaces Jin with Liu Song, beginning the Southern Dynasties

title.zh: 北魏太武帝攻克胡夏都城统万城，431 年灭夏
title.en: Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei captures Tongwancheng; destroys Xia in 431

title.zh: 赫连定被俘，北魏灭胡夏；宋文帝元嘉之治
title.en: Helian Ding captured, Northern Wei conquers Xia; Era of Yuanjia in Liu Song

title.zh: 北魏攻入龙城，北燕亡
title.en: Northern Wei marches into Longcheng, ending Northern Yan

title.zh: 北魏太武帝灭北凉，统一北方，结束十六国
title.en: Emperor Taiwu of Northern Wei conquers Northern Liang, unifying northern China

title.zh: 宋文帝元嘉北伐失利，北魏太武帝南征饮马长江
title.en: Failed Yuanjia northern expedition; Northern Wei counterattacks to the Yangtze at Guabu

title.zh: 北魏慕容白曜尽取刘宋淮北四州，南北分界南移淮水
title.en: Northern Wei annexes Liu Song’s four provinces north of the Huai, shifting the border to Huai

title.zh: 萧道成代宋建南齐，南朝宋亡
title.en: Xiao Daocheng deposes Liu Song and founds the Southern Qi dynasty

title.zh: 北魏冯太后与孝文帝颁行均田制与三长制，奠定田制根基
title.en: Empress Dowager Feng and Emperor Xiaowen enact the Equal-Field and Three-Elders systems

title.zh: 北魏孝文帝迁都洛阳，推行汉化改革
title.en: Emperor Xiaowen of Northern Wei moves the capital to Luoyang and promotes sinicization

title.zh: 萧衍代齐建梁，开启天监之治
title.en: Xiao Yan deposes Southern Qi and founds the Liang dynasty at Jiankang

title.zh: 钟离之战：梁将韦睿、曹景宗火攻水淹大破北魏三十万大军
title.en: Battle of Zhongli: Liang generals Wei Rui and Cao Jingzong rout 300,000 Northern Wei troops

title.zh: 六镇之乱：破六韩拔陵于沃野镇起兵，北魏边防崩解
title.en: Rebellion of the Six Garrisons: Poliuhan Baling’s frontier uprising shatters Northern Wei

title.zh: 河阴之变，北魏陷入内乱
title.en: Heyin Incident plunges Northern Wei into civil war

title.zh: 梁将陈庆之率七千白袍军北伐连克三十二城，攻入洛阳
title.en: Liang general Chen Qingzhi leads 7,000 White-Robe troops north, taking 32 cities and Luoyang

title.zh: 北魏分裂为东魏、西魏
title.en: Northern Wei splits into Eastern Wei and Western Wei

title.zh: 沙苑之战：宇文泰以少胜多破高欢，创西魏府兵制
title.en: Battle of Shayuan: Yuwen Tai routs Gao Huan’s Eastern Wei army and founds the Fubing system

title.zh: 玉壁之战：西魏韦孝宽坚守五十日，挫败东魏高欢大军
title.en: Siege of Yubi: Western Wei general Wei Xiaokuan holds for 50 days, repelling Gao Huan

title.zh: 侯景之乱攻陷建康台城，梁武帝萧衍饿死，江南残破
title.en: Hou Jing's Rebellion storms Jiankang Palace; aged Emperor Wu starves as Jiangnan is ravaged

title.zh: 高洋迫东魏孝静帝禅让，建立北齐
title.en: Gao Yang replaces Eastern Wei and establishes Northern Qi

title.zh: 突厥土门可汗大破柔然，建突厥汗国，称雄漠北
title.en: Bumin Qaghan crushes the Rouran north of Huaihuang and founds the First Turkic Khaganate

title.zh: 西魏尉迟迥伐蜀攻克成都，尽取萧梁巴蜀益州之地
title.en: Western Wei general Yuchi Jiong conquers Chengdu and annexes Sichuan from the Liang dynasty

title.zh: 西魏于谨攻陷江陵，立萧詧为西梁（后梁）主
title.en: Western Wei captures Jiangling and installs Western Liang

title.zh: 陈霸先建陈；宇文觉建北周
title.en: Chen Baxian founds Chen; Yuwen Jue founds Northern Zhou

title.zh: 太建北伐：陈将吴明彻大破北齐，尽复江北淮南之地
title.en: Taijian Northern Expedition: Chen general Wu Mingche defeats Northern Qi and recovers Huainan

title.zh: 北周武帝灭北齐，北方再统一
title.en: Emperor Wu of Northern Zhou conquers Northern Qi, reunifying the north

title.zh: 杨坚以丞相辅政，韦孝宽平尉迟迥，焚毁邺城
title.en: Regent Yang Jian has Wei Xiaokuan crush Yuchi Jiong and razes the old capital of Ye

title.zh: 杨坚建隋，定都大兴
title.en: Yang Jian founds the Sui dynasty at Daxing

title.zh: 隋文帝废西梁国，江陵并入隋境，大造战船备战伐陈
title.en: Emperor Wen of Sui abolishes Western Liang at Jiangling and prepares to conquer Chen

title.zh: 隋灭陈，统一全国
title.en: Sui conquers Chen, reunifying China after nearly 300 years

title.zh: 东突厥启民可汗内附，隋于河套北筑大利城
title.en: Eastern Tujue Qimin Qaghan submits to Sui

title.zh: 隋炀帝营建东都洛阳、开通济渠；始设进士科创立科举制
title.en: Emperor Yang builds Luoyang, digs the Tongji Canal, and founds the Jinshi civil exam

title.zh: 隋炀帝开凿永济渠，北通涿郡，南达黄河
title.en: Emperor Yang constructs the Yongji Canal north to Zhuo Commandery

title.zh: 隋炀帝西巡张掖，破吐谷浑置西海、河源、鄯善、且末四郡
title.en: Emperor Yang defeats Tuyuhun and establishes Xihai and three other western commanderies

title.zh: 隋炀帝开凿江南河，大运河贯通南北
title.en: Emperor Yang completes the Grand Canal linking Jiangnan and the north

title.zh: 隋炀帝征调百万大军东征高句丽，萨水失利
title.en: Emperor Yang launches his first grand campaign against Goguryeo

title.zh: 隋炀帝雁门被突厥围困；次年瓦岗军克洛口仓群雄并起
title.en: Emperor Yang besieged at Yanmen by Turks; Wagang rebels seize Luokou Granary as revolts spread

title.zh: 李渊太原起兵，攻入大兴城；瓦岗军据中原
title.en: Li Yuan rises in Taiyuan and captures Daxing (Chang'an)

title.zh: 宇文化及江都兵变弑隋炀帝，隋亡
title.en: Yuwen Huaji mutinies at Jiangdu and kills Emperor Yang, ending the Sui

title.zh: 李渊在长安称帝，建立唐朝
title.en: Li Yuan proclaims himself emperor in Chang'an, founding Tang

title.zh: 虎牢之战李世民擒窦建德、降王世充；李靖平萧铣
title.en: Battle of Hulao: Li Shimin captures Dou Jiande and Wang Shichong; Li Jing pacifies Xiao Xian

title.zh: 玄武门之变，李世民即位
title.en: Xuanwu Gate Incident; Li Shimin (Taizong) ascends the throne

title.zh: 唐太宗李世民即位，开创贞观之治
title.en: Emperor Taizong (Li Shimin) inaugurates the prosperous Reign of Zhenguan

title.zh: 李靖灭东突厥，尊太宗为“天可汗”，置定襄、云中都督府
title.en: Li Jing conquers Eastern Tujue; Taizong hailed as Heavenly Qaghan

title.zh: 李靖分道远征吐谷浑抵黄河源柏海，伏允可汗降唐
title.en: Li Jing leads a six-column expedition to Lake Baihai, forcing Tuyuhun King Buyun to submit

title.zh: 侯君集灭高昌，唐置安西都护府
title.en: Hou Junji conquers Gaochang; Tang establishes the Anxi Protectorate

title.zh: 文成公主入藏，与吐蕃松赞干布联姻
title.en: Princess Wencheng enters Tibet to marry Songtsen Gampo

title.zh: 玄奘自天竺载经归长安译经；唐太宗亲征高句丽克辽东城
title.en: Xuanzang returns to Chang'an with Sanskrit sutras; Emperor Taizong campaigns in Goguryeo

title.zh: 王玄策借吐蕃兵大破中天竺阿罗那顺，声威达南亚
title.en: Wang Xuance leads Tibetan-Nepalese forces to defeat Arunāśva in Central India

title.zh: 苏定方灭西突厥，置昆陵、濛池都护府，唐疆西极咸海
title.en: Su Dingfang defeats Western Tujue; Kunling & Mengchi Protectorates reach the Aral Sea

title.zh: 白江口海战：刘仁轨大破日本、百济水军，奠定东亚格局
title.en: Battle of Baekgang: Liu Rengui crushes the Yamato-Baekje fleet, reshaping East Asia

title.zh: 李勣攻克平壤灭高句丽，置安东都护府
title.en: Li Ji captures Pyongyang, conquering Goguryeo; Andong Protectorate set up

title.zh: 大非川之战：薛仁贵护送吐谷浑复国败于吐蕃，吐谷浑入吐蕃
title.en: Battle of Dafeichuan: Xue Rengui's Tang army is defeated by Tibet, which annexes Tuyuhun

title.zh: 安东都护府自平壤内迁辽东故城
title.en: Andong Protectorate relocated from Pyongyang to Liaodong

title.zh: 调露元年改交州都督府为安南都护府
title.en: Protectorate General to Pacify the South (Annam) established at Jiaozhou

title.zh: 武则天改唐为周，定都神都洛阳
title.en: Wu Zetian proclaims the Zhou dynasty at Shendu Luoyang

title.zh: 粟末靺鞨大祚荣于东牟山立震国，后受唐封渤海郡王建渤海国
title.en: Dae Jo-yeong founds the state of Balhae (Bohai) at Mount Dongmou in Jilin

title.zh: 武则天于庭州设北庭都护府，统辖天山北路
title.en: Wu Zetian establishes Beiting Protectorate north of the Tianshan

title.zh: 神龙政变：张柬之等拥唐中宗于洛阳复辟，复唐国号
title.en: Shenlong Coup: Chancellor Zhang Jianzhi restores Emperor Zhongzong in Luoyang, reviving Tang

title.zh: 景龙政变：太子李重俊发羽林兵诛武三思，兵败被杀
title.en: Jinglong Coup: Crown Prince Li Chongjun slays Wu Sansi with palace guards but falls in battle

title.zh: 唐隆政变：李隆基联结太平公主诛韦后，奉唐睿宗复位
title.en: Tanglong Coup: Li Longji and Princess Taiping eliminate Empress Wei and restore Ruizong

title.zh: 先天政变：唐玄宗诛太平公主党开启开元盛世；封渤海郡王
title.en: Xiantian Coup: Xuanzong ousts Princess Taiping to open the Kaiyuan era and invests Bohai

title.zh: 王君㚟、信安王李祎反击吐蕃拔石堡城，固河西防线
title.en: Tang generals Wang Junchuo and Li Yi capture Shibao Fortress from Tibet, securing Hexi

title.zh: 唐玄宗分全国为开元十五道，置采访使定型道州监察制
title.en: Emperor Xuanzong divides the empire into Fifteen Kaiyuan Circuits under commissioners

title.zh: 唐册封皮逻阁为云南王，六诏合一建南诏迁都太和城
title.en: Tang invests Piluoge as King of Yunnan; the Six Zhao unite to form the Nanzhao Kingdom

title.zh: 改元天宝，沿边常设安西、范阳等十节度使，外重内轻
title.en: Tianbao era begins; Ten Frontier Military Commands (Jiedushi) established along the borders

title.zh: 骨力裴罗灭后突厥建回鹘汗国，受唐封为怀仁可汗
title.en: Kutlug Bilge Kül founds the Uyghur Khaganate, invested by Tang as Huairen Qaghan

site.zh: 回鹘牙帐（哈拉巴尔嘎斯）

title.zh: 高仙芝率军翻越帕米尔远征小勃律，西域震恐归附
title.en: General Gao Xianzhi leads 10,000 troops across the Pamirs to conquer Gilgit (Little Balur)

site.zh: 连云堡 · 小勃律（吉尔吉特）

title.zh: 怛罗斯之战，造纸术西传阿拉伯世界
title.en: Battle of Talas; papermaking spreads to the Islamic world

title.zh: 安禄山、史思明于范阳起兵，安史之乱爆发
title.en: An Lushan and Shi Siming rebel at Fanyang, sparking the An–Shi Rebellion

title.zh: 马嵬驿兵变诛杨国忠、赐死杨贵妃；唐肃宗灵武即位
title.en: Mawei Mutiny: guards execute Yang Guozhong and Consort Yang; Suzong ascends at Lingwu

title.zh: 郭子仪借回纥兵收复长安、洛阳两京，安庆绪退保邺城
title.en: Guo Ziyi recovers Chang'an and Luoyang with Uyghur cavalry; An Qingxu falls back to Yecheng

title.zh: 安史之乱平定，河朔三镇割据肇端；吐蕃一度攻入长安
title.en: An–Shi Rebellion ends; Hebei warlords keep their garrisons; Tibet briefly seizes Chang'an

title.zh: 凉州陷于吐蕃，河西走廊被截断，安西北庭孤悬坚守
title.en: Liangzhou falls to Tibet, severing Hexi; Anxi & Beiting hold out as exclaves

title.zh: 杨炎推行两税法，赋税制度重大转型
title.en: Yang Yan enacts the Two-Tax System fiscal reform

title.zh: 沙州（敦煌）陷于吐蕃，陇右河西尽失
title.en: Shazhou (Dunhuang) falls to the Tibetan Empire

title.zh: 北庭陷落，唐与西域隔绝
title.en: Beiting falls; Tang is cut off from the Western Regions

title.zh: 永贞内禅：王叔文、柳宗元革新受挫，俱文珍迫顺宗禅位
title.en: Yongzhen Abdication: eunuch Ju Wenzhen halts the Wang Shuwen reform and forces Shunzong out

title.zh: 李愬雪夜入蔡州平淮西，史称元和中兴
title.en: Li Su takes Caizhou in a snowy night raid; Yuanhe Restoration

title.zh: 甘露之变：唐文宗与李训谋诛仇士良事败，晚唐宦官专权
title.en: Sweet Dew Incident: Emperor Wenzong and Li Xun’s failed plot against Qiu Shiliang ends in purge

title.zh: 回鹘汗国崩溃；唐武宗与李德裕破回鹘、平泽潞（会昌中兴）
title.en: Uyghur Khaganate collapses; Emperor Wuzong and Li Deyu defeat Uyghurs and Zelu (Huichang Era)

title.zh: 张议潮沙州起义，建归义军收复瓜沙甘肃等十一州归唐
title.en: Zhang Yichao's Guiyi Circuit recovers Dunhuang, Guazhou and eleven Hexi prefectures

title.zh: 赴援安南之桂林戍卒由庞勋率领起义北攻徐州，截断江淮漕运
title.en: Pang Xun leads the Guilin garrison mutiny north to seize Xuzhou and sever the Grand Canal

title.zh: 王仙芝、黄巢于曹州发动唐末大起义
title.en: Wang Xianzhi and Huang Chao launch the late-Tang peasant uprising

title.zh: 黄巢破潼关入长安称帝建齐；唐僖宗奔蜀，唐室衰亡
title.en: Huang Chao captures Chang’an and proclaims the Qi dynasty; Emperor Xizong flees to Shu

title.zh: 李克用入关中讨李茂贞，王建据蜀、杨行密据淮南，藩镇割据成型
title.en: Li Keyong marches into Guanzhong as Wang Jian and Yang Xingmi carve out warlord regimes

title.zh: 朱温逼唐哀帝禅位建后梁，唐朝灭亡
title.en: Zhu Wen deposes Emperor Ai to found Later Liang, ending the Tang dynasty

title.zh: 朱温代唐建后梁，契丹耶律阿保机称汗
title.en: Zhu Wen founds Later Liang; Abaoji becomes Khitan khan

title.zh: 王审知受封闽王，定都福州；王建在蜀称帝
title.en: Wang Shenzhi enfeoffed as Prince of Min at Fuzhou

title.zh: 耶律阿保机建契丹国，称帝建元神册
title.en: Yelü Abaoji proclaims the Khitan Empire

title.zh: 刘龑在番禺称帝建南汉，定都兴王府
title.en: Liu Yan proclaims Southern Han at Xingwangfu (Guangzhou)

title.zh: 李存勖灭后梁，建后唐
title.en: Li Cunxu destroys Later Liang and founds Later Tang

title.zh: 后唐庄宗遣军灭前蜀并有巴蜀；次年契丹灭渤海国
title.en: Later Tang conquers Former Shu (Sichuan); Khitan conquers Balhae in 926

title.zh: 兴教门之变：郭从谦洛阳兵变弑后唐庄宗，李嗣源即位
title.en: Xingjiao Gate Incident: Zhuangzong Li Cunxu dies in a Luoyang mutiny; Li Siyuan ascends

title.zh: 孟知祥在成都称帝，建立后蜀
title.en: Meng Zhixiang proclaims Later Shu in Chengdu

title.zh: 石敬瑭割燕云十六州予契丹，建后晋
title.en: Shi Jingtang cedes the Sixteen Prefectures to the Khitan and founds Later Jin

title.zh: 徐知诰（李昪）代杨吴建南唐，定都金陵
title.en: Xu Zhigao (Li Bian) replaces Wu to found Southern Tang at Jinling

title.zh: 吴权自立，安南脱离中原王朝
title.en: Ngo Quyen defeats Southern Han; Annam becomes independent

title.zh: 南唐攻灭闽国，与吴越分其地
title.en: Southern Tang conquers Min and partitions its territory with Wuyue

title.zh: 契丹灭后晋，改国号辽；刘知远建后汉
title.en: Khitan destroys Later Jin and adopts the dynastic name Liao; Liu Zhiyuan founds Later Han

title.zh: 郭威建后周；刘崇在太原建北汉
title.en: Guo Wei founds Later Zhou; Liu Chong founds Northern Han at Taiyuan

title.zh: 周世宗开始南征北伐
title.en: Emperor Shizong of Later Zhou launches reunification campaigns

title.zh: 周世宗三征南唐功成：李璟去帝号献江北淮南十四州
title.en: Shizong of Later Zhou compels Southern Tang to cede all 14 prefectures north of the Yangtze

title.zh: 周世宗北伐辽国，收复瀛、莫、易三州与三关
title.en: Northern campaign of Zhou Shizong recovers Three Passes and Three Prefectures

title.zh: 陈桥兵变，赵匡胤建宋
title.en: Mutiny at Chenqiao: Zhao Kuangyin founds the Song dynasty

title.zh: 陈桥兵变，赵匡胤建宋
title.en: Mutiny at Chenqiao: Zhao Kuangyin founds the Song dynasty

title.zh: 杯酒释兵权，确立重文轻武国策
title.en: Disarming generals over wine; civil supremacy policy established

title.zh: 慕容延钊假道灭虢，北宋平定荆南与湖南
title.en: Northern Song annexes the Jingnan and Chu (Hunan) regimes along the Yangtze

title.zh: 王全斌攻入成都灭后蜀孟昶降，花蕊夫人赋诗叹亡国
title.en: Song general Wang Quanbin conquers Later Shu in Chengdu; Consort Huarui laments its surrender

title.zh: 潘美率宋军克广州，刘鋹降，南汉亡
title.en: Pan Mei captures Guangzhou and accepts Liu Chang’s surrender, ending Southern Han

title.zh: 曹彬率宋军攻克金陵，李煜降，南唐亡
title.en: Cao Bin captures Jinling and accepts Li Yu’s surrender, ending Southern Tang

title.zh: 斧声烛影：宋太祖万岁殿夜饮暴崩，晋王赵光义即位
title.en: Candlelight and Axe-Sound Mystery: Emperor Taizu dies suddenly; brother Taizong ascends

title.zh: 吴越王钱俶纳土归宋，江南和平统一
title.en: King Qian Chu of Wuyue peacefully surrenders territory to Song

title.zh: 宋太宗灭北汉结束十国分裂；高梁河之战北伐失利
title.en: Emperor Taizong conquers Northern Han, ending Ten Kingdoms; routed by Liao at Gaoliang River

title.zh: 雍熙北伐失利，杨业于陈家谷力战殉国
title.en: Yongxi Northern Expedition fails; Yang Ye falls at Chenjiagu

title.zh: 澶渊之盟，宋辽百年和平
title.en: Chanyuan Treaty inaugurates a century of peace between Song and Liao

title.zh: 辽圣宗营建中京大定府；宋辽沿边广设榷场互市
title.en: Emperor Shengzong of Liao builds the Central Capital; Song and Liao open border trade markets

title.zh: 宋真宗升应天府（商丘）为南京陪都
title.en: Yingtianfu (Shangqiu) elevated to Southern Capital of Song

title.zh: 成都设益州交子务，发行世界最早官方纸币“交子”
title.en: Official Jiaozi Bureau established in Chengdu, issuing first paper money

title.zh: 元昊于兴庆府称帝建大夏（西夏）
title.en: Li Yuanhao proclaims the Western Xia empire at Xingqingfu (Yinchuan)

title.zh: 好水川之战：西夏元昊设伏歼灭任福主力，震动宋廷
title.en: Battle of Haoshuichuan: Western Xia ambushes Ren Fu's Song army, spurring court reforms

title.zh: 重熙增币；建大名府为北京陪都以备御辽
title.en: Damingfu elevated to Northern Capital to guard against Liao

title.zh: 范仲淹、富弼主持推行“庆历新政”
title.en: Fan Zhongyan leads the Qingli Reforms

title.zh: 庆历和议（宋夏）
title.en: Qingli Peace Accord between Song and Western Xia

title.zh: 黄河于澶州商胡埽决口北流，东汉以来王景故道废弃
title.en: Yellow River breaches at Shanghu in Chanzhou, shifting north and ending the Wang Jing course

title.zh: 欧阳修主持嘉祐二年贡举，苏轼、苏辙、曾巩、张载、程颢同榜登科
title.en: Ouyang Xiu presides over the 1057 exam, graduating Su Shi, Su Zhe, Zeng Gong, and Zhang Zai

title.zh: 宋神宗任用王安石推行熙宁变法
title.en: Emperor Shenzong appoints Wang Anshi to enact the Xining New Policies

title.zh: 王韶熙河开边，收复熙、河、洮、岷等六州，新置熙河路
title.en: Wang Shao's Xihe Campaign recovers Xi, He, Tao, and Min prefectures, establishing Xihe Circuit

title.zh: 高太后垂帘起用司马光尽废新法（元祐更化），党争激化
title.en: Empress Dowager Gao appoints Sima Guang to repeal Wang Anshi’s reforms (Yuanyou Reversal)

title.zh: 王厚、童贯发起“河湟开边”，收复青唐置西宁州
title.en: Hehuang Campaign: Wang Hou and Tong Guan recover Qingtang and establish Xining Prefecture

title.zh: 完颜阿骨打在会宁称帝建金，攻取辽东与上京
title.en: Wanyan Aguda proclaims the Jin dynasty at Huining and takes eastern Liao

title.zh: 宋金海上之盟，约攻辽
title.en: Alliance on the Sea between Song and Jin against Liao

title.zh: 方腊江南起义攻陷杭州震动东南，童贯率北伐军南下讨平
title.en: Fang La's uprising seizes Hangzhou in the southeast before Tong Guan suppresses the rebels

title.zh: 完颜娄室俘辽天祚帝，金朝灭辽
title.en: Jurchen Jin general Wanyan Loushi captures Emperor Tianzuo, ending Liao

title.zh: 靖康之变，北宋亡
title.en: Jingkang Incident: Jin captures Kaifeng, ending Northern Song

title.zh: 赵构即位于南京应天府，南宋开始
title.en: Zhao Gou (Emperor Gaozong) enthroned at Yingtianfu, beginning Southern Song

title.zh: 苗刘兵变：苗傅、刘正彦于杭州逼高宗禅位，韩世忠平叛
title.en: Miao-Liu Mutiny: Miao Fu and Liu Zhengyan depose Gaozong; Han Shizhong restores him

title.zh: 韩世忠黄天荡阻击金兀术水军
title.en: Han Shizhong blocks Wuzhu's Jin fleet at Huangtiandang

title.zh: 宋高宗正式定行在于临安府
title.en: Emperor Gaozong formally establishes Lin'an as the temporary capital

title.zh: 岳飞北伐，郾城、颍昌大捷，进兵朱仙镇
title.en: Yue Fei's northern campaign wins victories at Yancheng and Zhuxianzhen

title.zh: 绍兴和议，以淮河—大散关为界
title.en: Treaty of Shaoxing fixes the Song–Jin border along the Huai River and Dasan Pass

title.zh: 金海陵王南侵，虞允文采石矶大捷
title.en: Yu Yunwen defeats Jin Emperor Wanyan Liang at the Battle of Caishi

title.zh: 宋孝宗隆兴北伐，次年订立隆兴和议
title.en: Emperor Xiaozong's Longxing Northern Expedition and Peace Accord

title.zh: 南宋乾淳之治与金大定之治对峙；朱熹陆九渊鹅湖之会
title.en: Qian-Chun and Dading eras bring stability; Zhu Xi and Lu Jiuyuan debate at Goose Lake

title.zh: 绍熙内禅赵汝愚拥立宋宁宗；同年黄河阳武决口夺泗入淮
title.en: Shaoxi Abdication enthrones Ningzong; Yellow River breaches at Yangwu into the Huai

site.zh: 临安 · 阳武 · 淮安

title.zh: 铁木真统一蒙古，称成吉思汗
title.en: Temüjin unites the Mongol tribes as Genghis Khan

title.zh: 韩侂胄“开禧北伐”失利被诛，次年宋金订立《嘉定和议》
title.en: Han Tuozhou's Kaixi Northern Expedition fails; Song and Jin conclude the Treaty of Jiading

title.zh: 蒙古攻陷金中都，金迁都汴京，黄河以北与辽东被蒙古吞并
title.en: Mongols capture Jin capital Zhongdu; Jin moves south to Bianjing, losing half its territory

title.zh: 成吉思汗六盘山病逝，蒙古灭西夏
title.en: Genghis Khan dies at Mount Liupan as Mongol forces annihilate Western Xia

title.zh: 宋蒙联军蔡州灭金；宋军“端平入洛”溃败，宋蒙战争爆发
title.en: Song-Mongol forces destroy Jin at Caizhou; failed Duanping Expedition sparks Song-Mongol war

title.zh: 凉州会盟：萨迦班智达与蒙古阔端会谈，吐蕃正式归附
title.en: Liangzhou Accord: Sakya Pandita meets Mongol prince Godan, bringing Tibet into the realm

title.zh: 忽必烈率蒙军渡金沙江平定大理国
title.en: Kublai leads Mongol forces across the Jinsha River to conquer Dali

title.zh: 钓鱼城之战，蒙哥汗战死城下
title.en: Siege of Diaoyu Fortress; Möngke Khan dies in campaign

title.zh: 忽必烈设总制院（后改宣政院），统辖吐蕃政教事务
title.en: Kublai establishes the Bureau of Buddhist and Tibetan Affairs (Zongzhiyuan)

title.zh: 忽必烈定国号“大元”
title.en: Kublai Khan proclaims the Great Yuan dynasty

title.zh: 吕文焕力竭降元，襄阳苦守六年陷落
title.en: Xiangyang falls to the Yuan army after a six-year siege under Lü Wenhuan

title.zh: 马可·波罗抵达大都
title.en: Marco Polo arrives at Dadu

title.zh: 伯颜率元军入临安，恭帝出降；元置云南行中书省于中庆（昆明）
title.en: Bayan captures Lin'an, Emperor Gong surrenders; Yuan sets Yunnan Branch Secretariat at Zhongqing

title.zh: 崖山海战，南宋亡
title.en: Battle of Yashan: end of the Song dynasty

title.zh: 崖山海战灭南宋，元朝统一全国
title.en: Battle of Yashan destroys Southern Song; Yuan reunifies China

title.zh: 置澎湖巡检司管辖澎湖与琉球；第二次东征日本
title.en: Penghu Inspection Office established; second eastern campaign to Japan

title.zh: 忽必烈亲征平定辽东乃颜之乱，设辽阳行省
title.en: Kublai suppresses Nayan's revolt in Manchuria; Liaoyang Province established

title.zh: 元廷设宣政院掌佛教与吐蕃事务，西藏纳入中央管辖
title.en: Yuan court establishes Xuanzheng Yuan, integrating Tibet into central imperial administration

title.zh: 京杭大运河全线贯通
title.en: Beijing–Hangzhou Grand Canal fully opened via Shandong

title.zh: 中书省与全国十行省行政格局定型
title.en: Central Secretariat and Ten Branch Secretariats system consolidated

title.zh: 元仁宗诏复科举，以程朱理学取士，延续至清末
title.en: Emperor Renzong restores the civil exams with Zhu Xi's Neo-Confucian canon as the standard

title.zh: 南坡之变：铁失于上都南坡行帐弑元英宗与丞相拜住
title.en: Coup at Nanpo: Censor Tegshi assassinates reformist Emperor Yingzong and Chancellor Baiju

title.zh: 两都之战（天历之变）：燕铁木儿拥元文宗击败上都天顺帝
title.en: War of the Two Capitals: El Temür enthrones Emperor Wenzong in Dadu and defeats Shangdu

title.zh: 黄河于曹县白茅堤大决口泛滥，元廷命贾鲁治河征发民夫
title.en: Yellow River breaches the Baimaodi dike at Caoxian; Jia Lu’s massive corvée sparks unrest

title.zh: 韩山童、刘福通于颍州发动红巾军起义
title.en: Han Shantong and Liu Futong launch the Red Turban Rebellion at Yingzhou

title.zh: 高邮之战：脱脱围张士诚，临阵被罢，元军百万溃散
title.en: Siege of Gaoyou: Toghto is dismissed while besieging Zhang Shicheng and the Yuan host collapses

title.zh: 朱元璋攻克集庆（南京），改置应天府
title.en: Zhu Yuanzhang captures Jiqing (Nanjing), renaming it Yingtianfu

title.zh: 红巾军三路北伐，中路关先生攻破上都，焚毁宫阙
title.en: Red Turban armies march north in three columns; the central column sacks and burns Shangdu

title.zh: 鄱阳湖水战，朱元璋大败陈友谅
title.en: Battle of Lake Poyang: Zhu Yuanzhang defeats Chen Youliang

title.zh: 朱元璋攻灭张士诚统一江南，命徐达、常遇春誓师北伐
title.en: Zhu Yuanzhang conquers Zhang Shicheng to unify Jiangnan and launches Xu Da’s Northern Expedition

title.zh: 明大将军徐达、常遇春攻克大都，元顺帝北走上都，元亡
title.en: Ming generals Xu Da and Chang Yuchun capture Dadu as Toghon Temur flees north, ending Yuan

title.zh: 朱元璋于应天称帝建明；徐达北伐克大都，元廷北迁
title.en: Zhu Yuanzhang founds the Ming in Yingtian; Xu Da captures Dadu as Yuan retreats north

title.zh: 汤和、傅友德分道伐蜀，灭明夏政权平定四川
title.en: Tang He and Fu Youde conquer the Ming Xia regime to unify Sichuan

title.zh: 胡惟庸案，废丞相
title.en: Hu Weiyong case: the office of Grand Chancellor is abolished

title.zh: 傅友德、蓝玉、沐英率军平定云南元梁王与大理段氏
title.en: Fu Youde, Lan Yu, and Mu Ying pacify the Yuan Prince of Liang and the Duan clan in Yunnan

title.zh: 冯胜收辽东降纳哈出（1387）；蓝玉捕鱼儿海破北元
title.en: Feng Sheng pacifies Liaodong (1387); Lan Yu crushes the Northern Yuan court at Lake Buir

title.zh: 蓝玉案株连一万五千人，明初开国功臣宿将殆尽
title.en: Lan Yu Case purges 15,000 officials and generals, decimating Ming's founding military elite

title.zh: 燕王朱棣于北平起兵发动“靖难之役”
title.en: Zhu Di, Prince of Yan, launches the Jingnan Campaign from Beiping

title.zh: 靖难军破南京金川门，建文帝不知所踪，燕王朱棣即位
title.en: Jingnan forces breach Nanjing's Jinchuan Gate; Zhu Di ascends the throne as Yongle Emperor

title.zh: 郑和率宝船队自刘家港首次下西洋
title.en: Zheng He embarks on his first treasure fleet voyage from Liujiagang

title.zh: 设交趾布政司；1409 年设奴儿干都司
title.en: Jiaozhi Province established in Vietnam; Nurgan Commandery established in 1409

title.zh: 明成祖废思州、思南宣慰司，置贵州承宣布政使司定十三行省
title.en: Yongle Emperor establishes Guizhou Province, completing the Ming thirteen-province system

title.zh: 明成祖朱棣正式迁都北京，以南京为留都
title.en: Yongle Emperor formally moves the primary Ming capital to Beijing

title.zh: 明宣宗罢交趾布政使司撤军弃安南，黎利建后黎朝
title.en: Emperor Xuanzong abolishes Jiaozhi Province and withdraws from Vietnam; Le Loi founds Later Le

title.zh: 郑和末次下西洋，此后海禁
title.en: Zheng He's seventh and final voyage; maritime restrictions follow

title.zh: 明廷始筑辽东边墙，防御朵颜三卫与女真
title.en: Ming begins constructing the Liaodong Wall to defend the northeast

title.zh: 土木堡之变：瓦剌也先大破明军，俘明英宗
title.en: Tumu Crisis: Oirat leader Esen routs the Ming army and captures Emperor Yingzong

title.zh: 夺门之变：石亨、徐有贞迎明英宗自南宫复辟，于谦遇害
title.en: Wresting the Gate Coup: Shi Heng and Xu Youzhen restore Emperor Yingzong and execute Yu Qian

title.zh: 余子俊奏筑延绥边墙，明代九边长城防线成型
title.en: Yu Zijun constructs the 1,700-li Yansui Wall, shaping the Ming Nine Garrisons Great Wall

title.zh: 明宪宗设西厂；汪直、朱永联合朝鲜发起“成化犁庭”
title.en: Emperor Xianzong sets up the Western Depot; Ming-Joseon forces launch the Chenghua Campaign

title.zh: 刘大夏于黄陵岗塞河筑太行堤，断黄河北流成“河夺淮”定局
title.en: Liu Daxia seals the Huanglinggang breach and builds the Taihang Dike, fixing the Yellow-Huai

title.zh: 王守仁贬谪贵州修文“龙场悟道”，创立知行合一心学
title.en: Wang Yangming attains enlightenment at Longchang in Guizhou, founding the School of Mind

title.zh: 吐鲁番占领哈密卫，明廷闭嘉峪关断绝西域贡路
title.en: Turpan occupies Hami Guard; the Ming court closes Jiayuguan Pass and halts western tribute

title.zh: 王阳明督兵三十五日平定江西南昌宁王朱宸濠之乱
title.en: Wang Yangming suppresses the Prince of Ning (Zhu Chenhao) Rebellion at Nanchang in 35 days

title.zh: 大礼议之争：嘉靖帝于左顺门廷杖百官，皇权压倒内阁
title.en: Great Rites Controversy: Jiajing Emperor flogs protesting officials at Left Shun Gate

title.zh: 壬寅宫变：杨金英等宫女谋缢嘉靖帝未遂，帝移居西苑
title.en: RenYin Palace Rebellion: palace women led by Yang Jinying fail to strangle the Jiajing Emperor

site.zh: 北京紫禁城（乾清宫·西苑）

title.zh: 庚戌之变，俺答汗兵临北京
title.en: Gengxu Incident: Altan Khan raids the suburbs of Beijing

title.zh: 戚继光率戚家军九战九捷，平定台州倭患
title.en: Qi Jiguang wins nine straight victories at Taizhou, crushing Japanese pirates

title.zh: 隆庆开关，于福建漳州月港开放海外贸易
title.en: Longqing Opening lifts maritime ban at Yuegang in Fujian

title.zh: 隆庆和议，与蒙古开互市
title.en: Longqing Peace Accord opens frontier horse markets with the Mongols

title.zh: 张居正清丈全国田亩，推行“一条鞭法”
title.en: Zhang Juzheng implements the Single Whip Law tax reform

title.zh: 万历朝鲜之役：明军入朝抗击丰臣秀吉日军
title.en: Imjin War: Ming dispatches forces to aid Joseon against Toyotomi Hideyoshi

title.zh: 李化龙平定播州杨应龙之乱，“改土归流”分置遵义、平越二府
title.en: Ming forces crush the Bozhou Tusi rebellion, replacing hereditary rule with two prefectures

title.zh: 努尔哈赤于赫图阿拉称汗，建立后金
title.en: Nurhaci proclaims himself Khan of Later Jin at Hetu Ala in Manchuria

title.zh: 萨尔浒之战：努尔哈赤各个击破明军四路大军
title.en: Battle of Sarhū: Nurhaci defeats the four Ming expeditionary columns piecemeal

title.zh: 沈辽之战：努尔哈赤连克沈阳、辽阳，后金迁都辽阳
title.en: Battle of Shen-Liao: Nurhaci captures Shenyang and Liaoyang, moving the Later Jin capital

title.zh: 宁远大捷：袁崇焕凭孤城红夷大炮重创后金努尔哈赤
title.en: Victory at Ningyuan: Yuan Chonghuan repels Nurhaci's Later Jin siege with heavy cannon

title.zh: 陕北民变，李自成起义之始
title.en: Shaanxi peasant uprisings begin; rise of Li Zicheng

title.zh: 皇太极在盛京称帝，改国号“大清”
title.en: Hong Taiji proclaims the Great Qing dynasty at Shengjing (Mukden)

title.zh: 李自成克潼关入西安称新顺王；张献忠拔武昌进取巴蜀
title.en: Li Zicheng takes Xi'an as King of Xinshun; Zhang Xianzhong seizes Wuchang and enters Shu

title.zh: 李自成破北京，清军入关
title.en: Li Zicheng takes Beijing; Qing armies enter Shanhai Pass

title.zh: 清军入关，定都北京
title.en: Qing armies enter Shanhai Pass and make Beijing the capital

title.zh: 清军破扬州、南京，弘光政权覆灭；颁剃发令，江南抗清
title.en: Qing armies take Yangzhou and Nanjing, ending the Hongguang court; the queue edict sparks revolt

title.zh: 郑成功横渡鹿耳门驱逐荷兰殖民者，收复台湾设承天府
title.en: Koxinga (Zheng Chenggong) expels the Dutch and establishes Tungning on Taiwan

title.zh: 少年康熙帝于武英殿智擒专权辅臣鳌拜，正式亲政
title.en: Young Kangxi Emperor seizes regent Oboi at Wuying Hall to assume personal rule

title.zh: 康熙帝下旨撤藩，吴三桂于云南起兵反清，三藩之乱爆发
title.en: Kangxi orders abolition of the feudatories; Wu Sangui rebels in Yunnan (Three Feudatories)

title.zh: 清军攻克昆明，康熙帝彻底平定三藩之乱
title.en: Qing forces capture Kunming, suppressing the Revolt of the Three Feudatories

title.zh: 施琅收台湾，设台湾府
title.en: Shi Lang takes Taiwan; Taiwan Prefecture established under Fujian

title.zh: 康熙命彭春、萨布素发起雅克萨之战，痛击沙俄侵略军
title.en: Siege of Albazin (Yakesa) against Russian Cossack incursions

title.zh: 《尼布楚条约》划定东段边界
title.en: Treaty of Nerchinsk defines the eastern Sino-Russian border

title.zh: 多伦会盟，喀尔喀蒙古内附
title.en: Dolon Nor Assembly brings the Khalkha Mongols into the Qing realm

title.zh: 康熙帝三次亲征漠北，昭莫多之战大破准噶尔部噶尔丹主力
title.en: Emperor Kangxi personally leads campaigns into Outer Mongolia, routing Galdan at Jao Modo

title.zh: 清军驱逐准噶尔军，护送七世达赖入藏，西藏定局
title.en: Qing forces expel Dzungars from Lhasa and install the 7th Dalai Lama

title.zh: 康熙帝卒，雍正帝即位，开启摊丁入亩与西南改土归流
title.en: Yongzheng Emperor ascends; tax reform and Southwest gaitu guiliu launched

title.zh: 年羹尧平青海罗卜藏丹津
title.en: Nian Gengyao suppresses Lobzang Danjin’s revolt in Qinghai

title.zh: 设驻藏大臣；《恰克图条约》
title.en: Imperial Resident in Tibet established; Treaty of Kyakhta signed

title.zh: 雍正帝设军机房（后称军机处），皇权空前集中
title.en: Emperor Yongzheng creates the Grand Council, concentrating state power in the throne

title.zh: 乾隆帝即位，设办理苗疆事务、经略西北准部
title.en: Qianlong Emperor ascends; northwest campaigns prepared

title.zh: 清军两路出师西域直抵伊犁，攻灭准噶尔汗国并俘获达瓦齐
title.en: Qing armies march into Ili in two columns, destroying the Dzungar Khanate and Dawachi

title.zh: 乾隆帝限令西洋商船只许广州一口通商，十三行专营
title.en: Qianlong confines Western trade to Canton under the Thirteen Hongs (the Canton System)

title.zh: 平定准噶尔、回部，设伊犁将军
title.en: Pacification of the Dzungars and Altishahr; General of Ili established

title.zh: 渥巴锡率土尔扈特部自伏尔加河万里东归
title.en: Torghut Mongols under Ubashi Khan return from the Volga to Ili

title.zh: 福康安率军渡海平定台湾林爽文起义，乾隆赐改诸罗县为“嘉义”
title.en: Fuk’anggan crosses the strait to suppress Lin Shuangwen’s uprising; Zhuluo is renamed Jiayi

title.zh: 福康安击退廓尔喀，颁《钦定藏内善后章程》与金瓶掣签制
title.en: Gorkha campaign concluded; 29-Article Ordinance and Golden Urn instituted

title.zh: 英使马戛尔尼于承德觐见乾隆帝请开商埠遭拒
title.en: British envoy Lord Macartney meets the Qianlong Emperor at Chengde; trade demands refused

title.zh: 太上皇乾隆禅位嘉庆帝；川楚白莲教起义爆发
title.en: Qianlong abdicates to Jiaqing; White Lotus Rebellion breaks out

title.zh: 太上皇乾隆崩，嘉庆帝迅雷赐死权臣和珅，清廷由盛转衰
title.en: Following Qianlong's death, the Jiaqing Emperor executes corrupt minister Heshen

title.zh: 癸酉之变：天理教林清攻入紫禁城隆宗门，皇子绵宁御敌
title.en: Guiyou Incident: Lin Qing’s rebels storm the Forbidden City to Longzong Gate and are repelled

title.zh: 张格尔之乱攻陷喀什噶尔，长龄率军西征平定
title.en: Jahangir Khoja seizes Kashgar; General Changling marches west and restores Qing rule

title.zh: 林则徐于广东虎门海滩当众销毁鸦片两万余箱，虎门销烟
title.en: Imperial Commissioner Lin Zexu destroys over 20,000 chests of opium at Humen in Guangdong

title.zh: 英军封锁珠江口北犯，第一次鸦片战争爆发
title.en: British fleet blockades the Pearl River estuary, sparking the First Opium War

title.zh: 《南京条约》签订：割让香港岛，开五口通商
title.en: The Treaty of Nanjing cedes Hong Kong Island and opens five treaty ports to British trade

title.zh: 太平天国金田起义（1853 年定都天京，据长江中下游）
title.en: Jintian Uprising launches the Taiping Heavenly Kingdom across the Yangtze

title.zh: 黄河于兰阳铜瓦厢决口夺大清河入渤海，奠定现代走向
title.en: Yellow River breaches at Tongwaxiang, shifting north into the Bohai Sea along its modern path

title.zh: 天京事变：杨韦内讧血洗天京，石达开出走，太平天国转衰
title.en: Tianjing Incident: internal purge shatters Taiping leadership; Shi Dakai departs Tianjing

title.zh: 沙俄迫签《瑷珲条约》，割占黑龙江以北外兴安岭以南
title.en: Treaty of Aigun cedes territory north of the Amur River to Russia

title.zh: 英法联军攻占北京、火烧圆明园；签《北京条约》割外东北
title.en: Anglo-French forces sack the Old Summer Palace; Convention of Peking cedes Outer Manchuria

title.zh: 辛酉政变：慈禧、慈安联结恭亲王奕訢诛肃顺等八大臣垂帘
title.en: Xinyou Coup: Cixi, Ci’an, and Prince Gong oust Sushun’s Eight Regents to begin the Regency

site.zh: 北京 · 承德避暑山庄

title.zh: 湘军攻陷天京，太平天国覆灭；沙俄迫签《勘分西北界约记》
title.en: Xiang Army captures Tianjing, ending Taiping Heavenly Kingdom; Russia annexes outer northwest

title.zh: 曾国藩、李鸿章创办江南制造总局，洋务运动兴起
title.en: Zeng Guofan and Li Hongzhang found the Jiangnan Arsenal as Self-Strengthening takes off

title.zh: 左宗棠抬棺西征平定阿古柏，收复新疆（1884 年建省）
title.en: Zuo Zongtang reconquers Xinjiang from Yaqub Beg (Xinjiang Province in 1884)

title.zh: 曾纪泽使俄订立《中俄伊犁条约》，收复伊犁九城大部
title.en: Zeng Jize signs the Treaty of Ili with Russia, recovering most of the Nine Cities of Ili

title.zh: 老将冯子材率军于镇南关大捷重创法军并克谅山，扭转中法战局
title.en: Battle of Zhennan Pass: General Feng Zicai routs French forces and recaptures Lang Son

title.zh: 台湾正式建省，刘铭传任首任巡抚，筑铁路、设电报
title.en: Taiwan becomes a full province under Governor Liu Mingchuan, who builds railways and telegraphs

title.zh: 甲午战争爆发；黄海海战邓世昌驾“致远”舰壮烈殉国
title.en: First Sino-Japanese War breaks out; Deng Shichang perishes ramming the enemy in Yellow Sea

title.zh: 甲午战败，被迫签订《马关条约》割让台湾、澎湖
title.en: Treaty of Shimonoseki cedes Taiwan and Penghu to Japan

title.zh: 百日维新与戊戌政变慈禧囚光绪；列强强租胶州湾、旅大与新界
title.en: Hundred Days’ Reform ends in Wuxu Coup; powers lease Jiaozhou Bay, Dalian, and New Territories

site.zh: 北京（紫禁城·菜市口） · 胶州湾

title.zh: 八国联军占北京，慈禧挟光绪奔西安；东南督抚行东南互保
title.en: Eight-Nation Alliance occupies Beijing as Cixi flees to Xi’an; southern governors keep peace

title.zh: 清廷废除科举，延续一千三百年的取士制度终结
title.en: The Qing court abolishes the imperial examinations, ending a 1,300-year institution

title.zh: 武昌起义爆发，各省响应开启辛亥革命
title.en: Wuchang Uprising erupts and sparks the nationwide Xinhai Revolution

title.zh: 孙中山于南京宣誓就职，中华民国成立
title.en: Sun Yat-sen is inaugurated in Nanjing, founding the Republic of China

title.zh: 蔡锷在云南起义，发起讨袁护国战争
title.en: Cai E launches the National Protection War in Yunnan against Yuan Shikai

title.zh: 袁世凯病逝，北洋集团分裂为皖、直、奉系，南北军阀割据
title.en: Yuan Shikai dies; the Beiyang bloc fractures into Anhui, Zhili, and Fengtian warlord cliques

title.zh: 巴黎和会外交失利，北京爆发五四运动
title.en: May Fourth Movement erupts in Beijing over the Treaty of Versailles

title.zh: 直皖战争爆发，曹锟、吴佩孚直系击败段祺瑞皖系控制北京
title.en: Zhili–Anhui War: Cao Kun and Wu Peifu defeat Duan Qirui's Anhui Clique to seize Beijing

title.zh: 中国共产党第一次全国代表大会召开
title.en: First National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party

title.zh: 国共第一次合作，黄埔军校在广州创办
title.en: First KMT-CCP United Front; Whampoa Military Academy founded

title.zh: 国民革命军自广州誓师北伐，攻克武昌、南昌
title.en: National Revolutionary Army launches the Northern Expedition

title.zh: 北伐完成，定都南京
title.en: Northern Expedition completed; Nationalist government at Nanjing

title.zh: 日本关东军袭占沈阳，发动九一八事变
title.en: Mukden Incident (Sept 18): Kwantung Army seizes Shenyang and occupies Manchuria

title.zh: 日本扶植溥仪在长春建伪“满洲国”，东北沦陷十四载
title.en: Japan installs Puyi in Changchun as head of puppet Manchukuo, occupying Northeast China

title.zh: 红军长征途中召开遵义会议，次年会师陕甘
title.en: Zunyi Conference held during the Long March

title.zh: 张学良、杨虎城发动西安事变，促成联共抗日
title.en: Xi'an Incident leads to the Second United Front against Japan

title.zh: 七七事变，全面抗战
title.en: Marco Polo Bridge Incident begins the full-scale War of Resistance

title.zh: 台儿庄大捷与武汉会战，抗战进入相持阶段
title.en: Battle of Tai'erzhuang and Defense of Wuhan

title.zh: 抗日战争胜利，中国正式收回台湾全岛与澎湖列岛
title.en: Victory over Japan: China formally recovers Taiwan Island and the Penghu Archipelago

title.zh: 国民政府承认外蒙古独立公投结果，外蒙古脱离中国版图
title.en: Nationalist Government recognizes the Outer Mongolian referendum, detaching Outer Mongolia

title.zh: 辽沈、淮海、平津三大战役展开
title.en: Liaoshen, Huaihai, and Pingjin decisive campaigns

site.zh: 锦州 · 徐州 · 北平

title.zh: 渡江战役攻克南京，国民政府退往台北
title.en: Yangtze River Crossing Campaign takes Nanjing

title.zh: 毛泽东于天安门宣告中华人民共和国成立
title.en: Mao Zedong proclaims the founding of the People’s Republic of China in Beijing

title.zh: 签订《十七条协议》，西藏和平解放
title.en: Seventeen-Point Agreement signed; peaceful liberation of Tibet

title.zh: 中国第一颗原子弹在罗布泊成功爆炸
title.en: China successfully tests its first atomic bomb at Lop Nur

title.zh: 第26届联大通过第2758号决议，恢复联合国合法席位
title.en: UN General Assembly Resolution 2758 restores PRC's lawful seat

title.zh: 中共十一届三中全会召开，开启改革开放
title.en: Third Plenum of the 11th Central Committee launches Reform and Opening-Up

title.zh: 设立深圳、珠海、汕头、厦门四大经济特区
title.en: Shenzhen, Zhuhai, Shantou, and Xiamen Special Economic Zones established

title.zh: 开发开放上海浦东新区
title.en: Development and opening of Pudong New Area in Shanghai

title.zh: 中国对香港恢复行使主权，香港回归祖国
title.en: China resumes exercise of sovereignty over Hong Kong on July 1

title.zh: 中国对澳门恢复行使主权，澳门回归祖国
title.en: China resumes exercise of sovereignty over Macau on December 20

title.zh: 中国正式加入世界贸易组织（WTO）；青藏铁路开工
title.en: China joins the World Trade Organization (WTO); Qinghai–Tibet Railway begins

title.zh: 第29届夏季奥林匹克运动会于北京举行
title.en: 29th Summer Olympic Games hosted in Beijing ("One World, One Dream")

title.zh: 中国2010年上海世界博览会盛大举行
title.en: Expo 2010 Shanghai hosted under the theme "Better City, Better Life"

title.zh: 秦孝公与商鞅自栎阳迁都咸阳，废井田、设县制、统一度量衡
title.en: Duke Xiao of Qin and Shang Yang move the capital to Xianyang and launch the Second Reform

title.zh: 秦始皇统一六国定都咸阳，收天下兵器铸十二金人
title.en: Qin Shi Huang unifies China with Xianyang as imperial capital

title.zh: 刘邦入关破咸阳约法三章；项羽于鸿门设宴
title.en: Liu Bang enters Xianyang; Xiang Yu hosts the Feast at Hongmen

title.zh: 萧何营建未央宫成，汉高祖自栎阳正式定都长安
title.en: Xiao He completes Weiyang Palace; Chang'an becomes Western Han capital

title.zh: 巫蛊之祸：江充构陷太子刘据，长安激战五日太子兵败自尽
title.en: Witchcraft Crisis (Wugu Affair) in Chang’an drives Crown Prince Liu Ju to rebellion and suicide

title.zh: 大将军霍光于未央宫奏废昌邑王刘贺，迎立汉宣帝开启昭宣中兴
title.en: Regent Huo Guang deposes Liu He at Weiyang Palace and enthrones Emperor Xuan of Han

title.zh: 王莽于长安篡汉建立新朝，推行王田私属改制
title.en: Wang Mang usurps the Han throne in Chang'an and founds the Xin Dynasty

title.zh: 董卓焚洛阳挟汉献帝西迁长安
title.en: Dong Zhuo forcibly relocates Emperor Xian to Chang'an

title.zh: 蜀汉北伐兵出祁山震动关中，魏明帝曹叡亲赴长安坐镇督师
title.en: Shu Han marches from Mount Qi shaking Guanzhong; Wei Emperor Cao Rui commands defense from Chang'an

title.zh: 刘曜攻陷长安，晋愍帝出降，西晋灭亡
title.en: Liu Yao captures Chang'an; Emperor Min surrenders, ending the Western Jin

title.zh: 苻健称天王定都长安，建立前秦政权
title.en: Fu Jian (Emperor Jingming) establishes the Former Qin dynasty at capital Chang'an

title.zh: 苻坚于长安即前秦天王位，重用王猛变法图强
title.en: Fu Jian ascends in Chang'an as Heavenly King of Former Qin and appoints Wang Meng to reform the state

title.zh: 宇文泰于长安立西魏，开创关陇集团与北周基业
title.en: Yuwen Tai establishes Western Wei at Chang'an, laying the foundation for Sui and Tang

title.zh: 隋文帝诏宇文恺于龙首原南营建大兴城（唐长安前身）
title.en: Emperor Wen of Sui commissions Yuwen Kai to build Daxing City (Tang Chang'an)

title.zh: 李渊于长安太极殿称帝建唐，改大兴为长安
title.en: Li Yuan proclaims the Tang Dynasty at Taiji Palace in Chang'an

title.zh: 玄武门之变，李世民即位为唐太宗，次年改元贞观
title.en: Xuanwu Gate Incident in Chang'an; Li Shimin ascends as Emperor Taizong

title.zh: 颜杲卿、颜真卿举河北十七郡抗燕；常山陷落颜氏殉国，《祭侄文稿》所哀
title.en: Yan Gaoqing and Yan Zhenqing raise 17 Hebei commanderies; Changshan falls, the Yan clan dies

title.zh: 睢阳之战：张巡、许远数千人死守十月，屏障江淮财赋，城破殉国
title.en: Siege of Suiyang: Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan hold out ten months, shielding the Jianghuai tax base

title.zh: 邺城之战：九节度围安庆绪，史思明来援唐军溃散，遂杀安庆绪称帝再陷洛阳
title.en: Battle of Yecheng: Shi Siming routs nine Tang governors, kills An Qingxu, takes the Yan throne

title.zh: 唐隆政变李隆基诛韦后；713年发动先天政变开启开元盛世
title.en: Tanglong (710) and Xiantian (713) Coups: Li Longji eliminates Empress Wei and Princess Taiping

title.zh: 安史叛军破潼关陷长安，玄宗奔蜀；次年郭子仪收复西京
title.en: An Lushan rebels capture Chang’an, sparking the Mawei Mutiny; Guo Ziyi retakes it in 757

title.zh: 甘露之变：唐文宗与李训谋诛宦官事败，神策军血洗大明宫
title.en: Sweet Dew Incident in Daming Palace: failed plot against Qiu Shiliang leads to court purge

title.zh: 黄巢起义军攻占长安称齐帝，唐僖宗奔蜀
title.en: Huang Chao captures Chang'an and proclaims the Qi regime

title.zh: 徐达克奉元路，明廷改置西安府，始定“西安”之名
title.en: Ming general Xu Da captures Fengyuan and renames the prefecture Xi'an

title.zh: 李自成攻克西安，次年正月于西安建国号大顺
title.en: Li Zicheng captures Xi'an and proclaims the Dashun Dynasty

title.zh: 张学良、杨虎城发动西安事变，促成抗日民族统一战线
title.en: Xi'an Incident sparks the Second United Front against Japanese aggression

title.zh: 周威烈王于洛邑初命晋大夫魏斯、赵籍、韩虔为诸侯（三家分晋）
title.en: King Weilie of Zhou formally recognizes Wei, Zhao, and Han as marquises at Luoyi

title.zh: 刘秀建立东汉定都洛阳，开启光武中兴
title.en: Liu Xiu establishes the Eastern Han with Luoyang as imperial capital

title.zh: 汉明帝于洛阳创建白马寺，为中国第一古刹
title.en: Emperor Ming of Han establishes White Horse Temple in Luoyang

title.zh: 永元之隆：汉和帝于洛阳诛除大将军窦宪外戚集团，东汉达极盛
title.en: Prosperity of Yongyuan: Emperor He overthrows Dou Xian’s clan in Luoyang, reaching Han zenith

title.zh: 曹丕代汉称帝建立曹魏，定都洛阳
title.en: Cao Pi founds Cao Wei with Luoyang as capital

title.zh: 甘露之变：魏帝曹髦率宿卫讨司马昭，于洛阳南阙下遇弑
title.en: Coup of Ganlu: Wei Emperor Cao Mao marches against Sima Zhao and is slain in Luoyang

title.zh: 司马炎代魏建立西晋定都洛阳，280年灭吴一统
title.en: Sima Yan founds the Western Jin in Luoyang and reunifies China in 280

title.zh: 永嘉之乱：汉赵攻陷洛阳掳晋怀帝，衣冠南渡
title.en: Disaster of Yongjia: sack of Luoyang triggers the southward migration

title.zh: 北魏孝文帝自平城迁都洛阳，推行汉化并开凿龙门石窟
title.en: Emperor Xiaowen of Northern Wei moves the capital to Luoyang and initiates Longmen Grottoes

title.zh: 隋炀帝营建东都洛阳，以洛阳为中心开凿通济渠与永济渠
title.en: Emperor Yang of Sui builds the Eastern Capital Luoyang and launches the Grand Canal

title.zh: 武则天改唐为周，定都神都洛阳
title.en: Wu Zetian proclaims the Zhou Dynasty with Luoyang as the Divine Capital

title.zh: 李存勖灭后梁建立后唐，定都洛阳
title.en: Li Cunxu founds Later Tang with Luoyang as imperial capital

title.zh: 孙权自武昌迁都建业（今南京），正式称帝建立东吴
title.en: Sun Quan moves his capital to Jianye (Nanjing) and proclaims the Eastern Wu Empire

title.zh: 晋将王濬楼船下益州直抵建业，孙皓出降，三国归晋
title.en: Jin naval forces under Wang Jun capture Jianye, ending the Three Kingdoms

title.zh: 兴教门之变：郭从谦洛阳兵变弑后唐庄宗，李嗣源入洛即位
title.en: Xingjiao Gate Incident in Luoyang: Emperor Zhuangzong falls in mutiny and Li Siyuan ascends

title.zh: 司马睿渡江于建康建立东晋，开启六朝古都繁华
title.en: Sima Rui establishes the Eastern Jin in Jiankang (Nanjing)

title.zh: 王敦之乱：王敦自武昌顺江东下攻入建康，控制东晋朝政
title.en: Rebellion of Wang Dun: Wang Dun marches from Wuchang into Jiankang to control the Jin court

title.zh: 北府将刘裕自京口起兵克建康，讨平桓玄，开启北府兵掌权
title.en: Northern Garrison general Liu Yu rises at Jingkou, retakes Jiankang, and crushes Huan Xuan

title.zh: 刘裕代晋建宋，南朝宋齐梁陈四代皆都建康
title.en: Liu Yu founds Liu Song; Jiankang serves as capital of all four Southern Dynasties

title.zh: 隋军韩擒虎渡江克建康灭陈，结束近三百年南北分裂
title.en: Sui forces cross the Yangtze and capture Jiankang, reunifying China

title.zh: 李昪于金陵建立南唐，词章书画冠绝十国
title.en: Li Bian founds Southern Tang in Jinling, cultural heart of the Ten Kingdoms

title.zh: 南宋改江宁为建康府，为留都与长江防线核心枢要
title.en: Jiankang serves as auxiliary capital and Yangtze defense hub of Southern Song

title.zh: 朱元璋于应天府（南京）称帝建立明朝
title.en: Zhu Yuanzhang proclaims the Ming Dynasty in Yingtian (Nanjing)

title.zh: 靖难之役：燕王朱棣攻克南京，即位为明成祖
title.en: Jingnan Campaign: Zhu Di captures Nanjing and ascends as the Yongle Emperor

title.zh: 第一次鸦片战争清廷战败，于南京下关江面签署《南京条约》
title.en: Treaty of Nanjing signed after the First Opium War

title.zh: 太平天国攻占江宁，改名天京并定都十一年
title.en: Taiping Heavenly Kingdom captures Jiangning and makes it its capital Tianjing

title.zh: 安庆之战：曾国荃湘军合围两年攻克安庆，天京门户洞开
title.en: Siege of Anqing: Zeng Guoquan’s Xiang Army captures Anqing, opening the approach to Tianjing

title.zh: 曾国藩、曾国荃率湘军轰塌城墙攻陷天京，太平天国运动覆灭
title.en: Xiang Army under Zeng Guofan and Zeng Guoquan breaches Tianjing, ending the Taiping Kingdom

title.zh: 孙中山于南京就任中华民国临时大总统，宣告共和
title.en: Sun Yat-sen inaugurated in Nanjing as Provisional President of the Republic of China

title.zh: 秦将王翦、王贲攻拔燕都蓟城，燕王喜走保辽东
title.en: Qin generals Wang Jian and Wang Ben capture the Yan capital Ji; King Xi flees to Liaodong

title.zh: 安禄山于范阳（幽州）起兵反唐，安史之乱爆发
title.en: An Lushan launches his rebellion from Fanyang (Youzhou / Beijing)

title.zh: 后晋割燕云十六州，辽升幽州为南京析津府（陪都）
title.en: Liao elevates Youzhou to its Southern Capital, Nanjing Xijin Fu

title.zh: 金海陵王完颜亮迁都燕京，定名金中都大兴府，首开北京帝都史
title.en: Jin ruler Wanyan Liang moves the imperial capital to Yanjing, renaming it Zhongdu

title.zh: 成吉思汗蒙古大军攻占金中都
title.en: Genghis Khan's Mongol forces capture Jin Zhongdu

title.zh: 忽必烈营建元大都成，定为元朝国都，积水潭万艘漕船云集
title.en: Kublai Khan establishes Dadu (Khanbaliq) as capital of the Yuan Dynasty

title.zh: 明成祖朱棣建北京紫禁城成，正式自南京迁都北京
title.en: Yongle Emperor completes the Forbidden City and moves the Ming capital to Beijing

title.zh: 土木堡之变后瓦剌逼近京师，于谦指挥北京保卫战获胜
title.en: Yu Qian leads the successful Defense of Beijing after the Tumu Crisis

title.zh: 夺门之变：石亨、徐有贞迎明英宗自南宫复辟，于谦含冤遇害
title.en: Wresting the Gate Coup: Emperor Yingzong is restored from the Southern Palace; Yu Qian is slain

title.zh: 壬寅宫变：杨金英等宫女于乾清宫谋缢嘉靖帝未遂，帝移居西苑
title.en: RenYin Palace Rebellion: palace women led by Yang Jinying attempt to strangle Emperor Jiajing

title.zh: 辛酉政变：慈禧、慈安两宫太后联结恭亲王奕訢诛肃顺等八大臣
title.en: Xinyou Coup in Beijing: Cixi and Ci’an ally with Prince Gong to oust the Eight Regents

title.zh: 戊戌政变：慈禧太后囚光绪帝于瀛台，于菜市口杀戊戌六君子
title.en: Wuxu Coup in Beijing: Empress Dowager Cixi confines Emperor Guangxu and executes Six Gentlemen

title.zh: 斧声烛影：宋太祖与晋王赵光义夜饮万岁殿暴崩，宋太宗即位
title.en: Candlelight and Axe-Sound Mystery at Wansui Hall: Emperor Taizu dies and Taizong ascends

title.zh: 苗刘兵变：苗傅、刘正彦于杭州逼宋高宗禅位，韩世忠勤王复辟
title.en: Miao-Liu Mutiny in Hangzhou: Miao Fu and Liu Zhengyan briefly depose Gaozong before restoration

title.zh: 绍熙内禅：赵汝愚、韩侂胄奉太皇太后旨于临安迫光宗禅位宁宗
title.en: Shaoxi Abdication in Lin’an: Zhao Ruyu and Han Tuozhou compel Guangzong to yield to Ningzong

title.zh: 李自成破北京崇祯自缢；旋即清军入关定都北京
title.en: Li Zicheng captures Beijing; Qing forces soon enter and make Beijing their capital

title.zh: 第二次鸦片战争英法联军攻入北京，劫掠并焚毁圆明园
title.en: Anglo-French forces enter Beijing and burn the Old Summer Palace (Yuanmingyuan)

title.zh: 北京爆发五四爱国运动，揭开新民主主义革命序幕
title.en: May Fourth Movement erupts in Beijing

title.zh: 北平和平解放，同年10月1日于北京天安门宣告新中国成立
title.en: Peaceful liberation of Beiping; founding of the PRC proclaimed at Tiananmen

title.zh: 魏惠王自安邑迁都大梁，开凿鸿沟连接黄河与淮泗水系
title.en: King Hui of Wei moves his capital to Daliang and excavates the Honggou Canal

title.zh: 秦将王贲引黄河鸿沟水灌大梁城，魏王假降，魏亡
title.en: Qin general Wang Ben floods Daliang to conquer the state of Wei

title.zh: 通济渠贯通洛阳经汴州入淮，汴州跃升为天下漕运咽喉
title.en: Grand Canal makes Bianzhou (Kaifeng) the premier north-south waterway hub

title.zh: 朱温篡唐建后梁定都开封；后晋、后汉、后周皆都于此
title.en: Zhu Wen founds Later Liang in Kaifeng; four of the Five Dynasties make it their capital

title.zh: 赵匡胤陈桥兵变，于东京开封府建立北宋
title.en: Zhao Kuangyin founds the Northern Song Dynasty with Dongjing (Kaifeng) as capital

title.zh: 靖康之变：金军攻陷汴京，掳徽钦二帝北去，北宋灭亡
title.en: Jingkang Incident: Jurchen Jin forces capture Kaifeng, ending the Northern Song

title.zh: 金宣宗避蒙古兵锋，自中都南迁都城至汴京
