title.en: Emperor Xuanzong of Jin relocates the Jurchen capital south to Bianjing

title.zh: 李自成三围开封，黄河决口灌城，古城尽没于泥沙
title.en: Yellow River dike breach during the 1642 Siege of Kaifeng submerges the city

title.zh: 隋炀帝开江南河自京口达杭州，贯通大运河最南端
title.en: Sui completes the Jiangnan Canal terminating at Hangzhou

title.zh: 钱镠建立吴越国定都杭州，筑捍海塘、浚西湖，保境安民
title.en: Qian Liu establishes the Wuyue Kingdom in Hangzhou and builds the Qiantang seawall

title.zh: 宋高宗正式定临安府（杭州）为南宋行在（都城）
title.en: Emperor Gaozong establishes Lin'an (Hangzhou) as capital of the Southern Song

title.zh: 绍兴和议达成，岳飞于临安风波亭遇害
title.en: General Yue Fei is executed at Fengbo Pavilion in Lin'an

title.zh: 元军伯颜兵临临安，谢太后携宋恭帝奉玺出降
title.en: Yuan forces under Bayan reach Lin'an; the Southern Song court surrenders

title.zh: 秦将司马错由石牛道灭蜀置蜀郡，前311年张仪按咸阳规制筑成都城
title.en: Qin general Sima Cuo conquers Shu; Zhang Yi rebuilds Chengdu modeled on Xianyang

title.zh: 蜀郡太守李冰凿离堆修筑都江堰，成都平原自此号“天府之国”
title.en: Shu Governor Li Bing builds the Dujiangyan Irrigation System, making Chengdu the Land of Plenty

title.zh: 刘备于成都称帝建立蜀汉，拜诸葛亮为丞相
title.en: Liu Bei proclaims the Shu Han Empire in Chengdu with Zhuge Liang as Chancellor

title.zh: 蜀军首次出祁山北伐，天水参军姜维归附获赞“凉州上士”
title.en: During Shu Han's first Qishan expedition, Tianshui officer Jiang Wei joins Zhuge Liang's banner

title.zh: 魏将邓艾偷渡阴平直抵成都，刘禅出降，蜀汉灭亡
title.en: Wei general Deng Ai marches through Yinping to Chengdu; Liu Shan surrenders

title.zh: 姜维于成都策反钟会图谋复蜀，兵变事败力战殉国
title.en: Jiang Wei incites Zhong Hui to rebel in Chengdu in a bid to restore Shu Han, perishing in battle

title.zh: 安史之乱唐玄宗幸蜀驻跸成都，后升益州为成都府
title.en: Emperor Xuanzong takes refuge in Chengdu during the An Lushan Rebellion

title.zh: 王建于成都建前蜀，后孟知祥复于成都建后蜀
title.en: Former Shu and Later Shu kingdoms successively govern from Chengdu

title.zh: 北宋于成都设益州交子务，发行世界最早官方纸币“交子”
title.en: Northern Song establishes the Jiaozi Bureau in Chengdu, issuing the world’s first paper money

title.zh: 孙刘联军于赤壁火攻大破曹操，奠定三国鼎立之局
title.en: Battle of Red Cliffs: Sun Quan and Liu Bei defeat Cao Cao by fire attack

title.zh: 孙权自公安徙治鄂县，取“以武而昌”改名武昌
title.en: Sun Quan establishes Wuchang as his military and political capital on the Yangtze

title.zh: 岳飞凯旋驻节鄂州大本营，练成精锐“岳家军”经略中原
title.en: Yue Fei garrisons his headquarters at Ezhou, forging the elite Yue Family Army to reclaim the North

title.zh: 武昌起义爆发，打响辛亥革命第一枪，终结两千年帝制
title.en: Wuchang Uprising sparks the 1911 Xinhai Revolution, ending imperial rule in China

title.zh: 刘备三顾茅庐请诸葛亮于襄阳隆中出山，定《隆中对》
title.en: Liu Bei visits Zhuge Liang three times at Longzhong near Xiangyang

title.zh: 关羽北伐水淹七军，围曹仁于樊城、襄阳，威震华夏
title.en: Guan Yu floods the Seven Armies and besieges Xiangyang and Fancheng

title.zh: 襄樊之战：宋军孤城苦守襄阳六年，元军回回炮破樊城后降元
title.en: Six-year Siege of Xiangyang ends after Yuan forces deploy counterweight trebuchets

title.zh: 汉武帝分酒泉置敦煌郡，筑玉门关、阳关扼丝路咽喉
title.en: Emperor Wu of Han establishes Dunhuang Commandery and the Yumen and Yangguan passes

title.zh: 沙门乐僔于敦煌鸣沙山东麓开凿莫高窟第一窟
title.en: Monk Yuezun carves the first cave at the Mogao Grottoes in Dunhuang

title.zh: 张议潮于沙州起义驱逐吐蕃，遣使奉表归唐，置归义军
title.en: Zhang Yichao leads the Dunhuang uprising and restores Tang rule as the Guiyi Circuit

title.zh: 白登之围：汉高祖刘邦于平城白登山被冒顿单于围困七日
title.en: Siege of Baideng: Emperor Gaozu of Han is besieged by Modu Chanyu at Pingcheng

title.zh: 拓跋珪迁都平城称帝建北魏，开凿云冈石窟
title.en: Tuoba Gui moves the Northern Wei capital to Pingcheng and initiates the Yungang Grottoes

title.zh: 宇文化及于江都发动兵变弑隋炀帝，隋朝覆亡
title.en: Yuwen Huaji assassinates Emperor Yang of Sui in Jiangdu (Yangzhou)

title.zh: 鉴真和尚自扬州启航第六次东渡日本成功
title.en: Monk Jianzhen sets sail from Yangzhou on his successful sixth voyage to Japan

title.zh: 史可法率孤军死守扬州抗击清军，城破殉国
title.en: Ming loyalist Shi Kefa defends Yangzhou to the death against Qing forces

title.zh: 赵佗于番禺自立为南越武王；前111年汉武帝平南越置南海郡
title.en: Zhao Tuo founds the Nanyue Kingdom at Panyu (Guangzhou); reconquered by Han in 111 BCE

title.zh: 唐廷于广州首设市舶使，总管南海番舶贸易
title.en: Tang establishes the first Maritime Trade Commissioner (Shibosi) in Guangzhou

title.zh: 林则徐抵广州查禁鸦片，于虎门海滩当众销烟
title.en: Imperial Commissioner Lin Zexu destroys opium stocks at Humen near Guangzhou

title.zh: 楚、赵、魏、韩、燕五国合纵攻秦，至函谷关，秦出兵逆击，五国联军皆败走
title.en: Coalition of Chu, Zhao, Wei, Han, and Yan marches on Hangu Pass but is repulsed by Qin forces

title.zh: 齐孟尝君田文合韩、魏之师攻破函谷关，迫秦昭襄王割城求和
title.en: Lord Mengchang of Qi leads a Qi-Han-Wei coalition that storms Hangu Pass after three years

title.zh: 刘邦率楚军自南阳迂回攻破武关、峣关，先入关中降秦王子婴
title.en: Liu Bang breaches Wuguan Pass from Nanyang and enters Guanzhong to accept Qin’s surrender

title.zh: 井陉之战：韩信出井陉口背水列阵，奇兵拔赵壁破赵军二十万
title.en: Battle of Jingxing: Han Xin deploys with his back to the river and routs 200,000 Zhao troops

site.zh: 井陉关·娘子关（今河北井陉）

title.zh: 匈奴老上单于率十四万骑破萧关，汉文帝遣三将军屯细柳备胡
title.en: Xiongnu Chanyu Laoshang breaches Xiaoguan Pass with 140,000 cavalry, alarming Chang’an

title.zh: 汉武帝分置敦煌郡，筑玉门关与阳关，扼控丝绸之路南北咽喉
title.en: Emperor Wu establishes Yumen Pass and Yangguan Pass to command the Silk Road routes

site.zh: 玉门关·阳关（今甘肃敦煌）

title.zh: 潼关之战：曹操北渡蒲阪津迂回渭南，以离间计大破马超韩遂
title.en: Battle of Tongguan: Cao Cao outflanks the pass and defeats the coalition of Ma Chao and Han Sui

title.zh: 汉中之战：刘备据阳平关与定军山，黄忠阵斩夏侯渊尽取汉中
title.en: Hanzhong Campaign: Liu Bei takes Yangping Pass and Mount Dingjun; Huang Zhong slays Xiahou Yuan

site.zh: 阳平关·定军山（今陕西勉县）

title.zh: 蜀汉大将军姜维自沓中疾退，凭剑门关天险拒钟会十万魏军
title.en: Shu general Jiang Wei holds the cliffs of Jianmen Pass against Zhong Hui’s 100,000 Wei troops

title.zh: 虎牢之战：李世民率精骑据虎牢关生擒窦建德，王世充随即出降
title.en: Battle of Hulao: Li Shimin captures Dou Jiande at Hulao Pass, forcing Wang Shichong to yield

site.zh: 虎牢关（今河南荥阳汜水）

title.zh: 唐玄宗纳张九龄之议凿辟大庾岭梅关新路，贯通赣粤南北商道
title.en: Chancellor Zhang Jiuling excavates the Meiguan Pass road across Dayu Ridge, linking Gan and Yue

site.zh: 大庾岭梅关（今广东南雄北）

title.zh: 哥舒翰被迫出潼关中伏惨败，潼关失守，唐玄宗仓皇奔蜀
title.en: Geshu Han is ambushed outside Tongguan Pass; the pass falls and Emperor Xuanzong flees to Shu

title.zh: 韩愈谏迎佛骨贬潮州，风雪逾蓝田关赋“雪拥蓝关马不前”名句
title.en: Exiled to Chaozhou, Han Yu crosses snowbound Lantian Pass and composes his famous quatrain

title.zh: 雁门之战：杨业率骑自西陉出雁门关背奇袭，大破辽军斩萧咄李
title.en: Battle of Yanmen Pass: Song general Yang Ye leads a flanking cavalry strike to rout Liao forces

title.zh: 明将冯胜平定河西，于祁连峡谷最窄处筑嘉峪关，成明长城西端
title.en: Ming general Feng Sheng builds Jiayuguan Pass in the Hexi Corridor as the Great Wall’s west end

title.zh: 土木之变后瓦剌逼紫荆、居庸二关，于谦督军严守内三关退敌
title.en: After the Tumu Crisis, Yu Qian fortifies Juyong and Zijing passes and repels Oirat forces

site.zh: 居庸关·紫荆关（今北京昌平/河北易县）

title.zh: 山海关大战：吴三桂开关纳多尔衮清军，联手击败李自成大顺军
title.en: Battle of Shanhai Pass: Wu Sangui opens the gates to Dorgon’s Qing army, defeating Li Zicheng

title.zh: 王莽于青海湖东岸置西海郡（治龙夷城），汉代郡县首次推进至青海湖畔
title.en: Wang Mang establishes Xihai Commandery east of Qinghai Lake with its seat at Longyi

site.zh: 西海郡龙夷城（今青海海晏）

title.zh: 东吴景帝孙休析会稽南部置建安郡，治建安县，福建始设独立郡级建置
title.en: Sun Xiu of Eastern Wu carves Jian'an Commandery from southern Kuaiji in northern Fujian

title.zh: 吐谷浑首领夸吕始自称可汗，于青海湖西十五里营建王都伏俟城
title.en: Tuyuhun ruler Kualu proclaims himself Khagan and builds his royal capital at Fusi City

site.zh: 伏俟城（今青海共和铁卜卡）

title.zh: 后唐册封马殷为楚国王，马氏于潭州建南楚政权，兴茶铸币保境安民
title.en: Later Tang invests Ma Yin as King of Chu at Tan Zhou, founding the Southern Chu kingdom

title.zh: 吐蕃唃厮啰部迁都青唐城（今西宁），建青唐政权并扼丝路青海道要冲
title.en: Tibetan ruler Gusiluo moves his capital to Qingtang (Xining) on the Qinghai Silk Road

title.zh: 枢密副使狄青元宵夜袭昆仑关，于归仁铺大破侬智高，平定广南西路
title.en: Song general Di Qing launches a night raid through Kunlun Pass to defeat Nong Zhigao

title.zh: 文天祥、张世杰、陆秀夫奉益王赵昰于福州称帝（宋端宗），升福安府抗元
title.en: Wen Tianxiang, Zhang Shijie, and Lu Xiufu enthrone Emperor Duanzong at Fuzhou against Yuan

title.zh: 万历平播之役：李化龙督八路明军攻克海龙屯，灭播州杨氏土司改土归流
title.en: Bozhou Campaign: Ming commander Li Hualong storms Hailongtun Fortress, ending Yang tusi rule

title.zh: 吴三桂于湖南衡州称帝建国号大周，旋即病卒，清军随即反攻收复湖南
title.en: Wu Sangui proclaims the Zhou dynasty at Heng Zhou shortly before dying, turning the war

title.zh: 楚考烈王伐鲁灭之，迁鲁顷公于莒，周公所封八百年鲁国绝祀
title.en: King Kaolie of Chu annexes Lu at Qufu, ending the 800-year state founded by the Duke of Zhou

title.zh: 汉高祖刘邦自淮南还过鲁，以太牢祠孔子，开历代帝王亲祭孔子之始
title.en: Emperor Gaozu of Han offers the Grand Sacrifice to Confucius at Lu, starting imperial rites

title.zh: 宋真宗东封泰山毕亲幸曲阜谒孔庙，追谥孔子为玄圣文宣王
title.en: Emperor Zhenzong visits the Temple of Confucius at Qufu after the Mount Tai Fengshan rites

title.zh: 后周太祖郭威平兖州后幸曲阜谒孔庙，称孔子“百世帝王之师”并亲行拜礼
title.en: Later Zhou Emperor Guo Wei visits Qufu and bows to Confucius as Teacher of Emperors for All Ages

title.zh: 康熙帝南巡回銮亲幸曲阜孔庙，行三跪九叩大礼并御书“万世师表”匾额
title.en: Emperor Kangxi visits Qufu Temple of Confucius, performing full imperial rites and calligraphy

title.zh: 越王勾践灭吴后北徙都琅琊望东海，至越王翳时始自琅琊南迁返吴
title.en: King Yi of Yue moves his capital south from Langya, ending Yue's northern maritime court era

title.zh: 秦始皇东巡登琅琊山，留三月，徙三万户筑琅琊台立石颂秦德
title.en: Qin Shi Huang ascends Mount Langya, moving 30,000 households to build Langya Terrace and stele

site.zh: 琅琊台（今山东青岛·黄岛）

title.zh: 秦始皇末次东巡至琅琊，遣方士徐福率童男女数千人入海求仙
title.en: On his final eastern tour at Langya, Qin Shi Huang sends Xu Fu across the sea for immortals

title.zh: 汉武帝东巡海上至琅琊，登琅琊台礼祠四时主，遣方士入海求蓬莱
title.en: Emperor Wu of Han tours the coast to Langya, sacrificing at Langya Terrace and seeking Penglai

site.zh: 琅琊台（今山东青岛·黄岛）

title.zh: 琅琊人樊崇起兵反莽，义军以朱涂眉相别号“赤眉军”，终成覆莽主力
title.en: Fan Chong of Langya launches the Red Eyebrows uprising against Wang Mang's Xin dynasty

title.zh: 琅琊王司马睿采王导之策南渡镇建邺，偕琅琊王氏奠定东晋基业
title.en: Sima Rui, Prince of Langya, crosses south to Jianye with Wang Dao, founding the Eastern Jin

title.zh: 宋真宗景德元年诏昌南镇进御瓷底书“景德年制”，景德镇由此得名
title.en: Emperor Zhenzong decrees Changnan imperial porcelain bear the Jingde mark, naming Jingdezhen

title.zh: 明廷于景德镇珠山置御器厂督造宫廷御瓷，永宣青花与成化斗彩冠绝天下
title.en: The Ming court establishes the Zhushan Imperial Kiln Factory at Jingdezhen for royal porcelain

title.zh: 顺治丁酉科场案发，江南才子吴兆骞等流徙宁古塔，塞外苦寒渐兴文教
title.en: After the 1657 exam scandal, Jiangnan literati like Wu Zhaoqian are exiled to frontier Ningguta

title.zh: 清廷设镇守宁古塔等处将军，统辖松花江、乌苏里江至库页岛广袤边疆
title.en: The Qing court appoints the General of Ningguta to govern the frontier to Ussuri and Sakhalin

site.zh: 宁古塔城（今黑龙江海林）

title.zh: 刘裕北伐攻克南燕都城广固，擒慕容超收复青齐之地
title.en: Liu Yu storms the Southern Yan capital Guanggu, capturing Murong Chao and recovering Shandong

title.zh: 河北大水百万流民南奔，富弼知青州置场劝募赈活饥民五十余万
title.en: Prefect Fu Bi organizes relief in Qing Zhou for Hebei flood refugees, saving over 500,000 lives

title.zh: 苏轼知密州筑超然台，丙辰中秋欢饮达旦赋《水调歌头》
title.en: Su Shi governs Mi Zhou, composing his Mid-Autumn masterpiece Prelude to Water Melody

title.zh: 刘备自葭萌挥师南下与刘璋决裂，夺取涪城开启益州之战
title.en: Liu Bei marches south from Jiameng to break with Liu Zhang, launching his Yi Province campaign

title.zh: 利州都督武士彟任上，武则天相传诞于利州嘉陵江畔
title.en: Empress Wu Zetian is traditionally born at Li Zhou while her father Wu Shiyue governs there

title.zh: 代州刺史杨业出雁门关背击辽军，杀辽驸马萧咄李获雁门大捷
title.en: Prefect Yang Ye leads cavalry behind Liao lines at Yanmen Pass, winning the Battle of Yanmen

site.zh: 代州雁门（今山西忻州代县）

title.zh: 长安失守，太子李亨北上朔方军治所灵武即位为唐肃宗号令平叛
title.en: Crown Prince Li Heng ascends the throne as Emperor Suzong at Lingwu to rally Tang forces

title.zh: 党项李继迁攻陷宋朔方重镇灵州，改灵州为西平府定为西夏陪都
title.en: Tangut leader Li Jiqian captures Ling Zhou, renaming it Xiping Prefecture as a Xia capital

title.zh: 前秦吕光攻破龟兹城，奉迎高僧鸠摩罗什东入凉州与长安译经
title.en: Former Qin general Lü Guang captures Kucha and escorts Buddhist master Kumarajiva east

site.zh: 龟兹（今新疆阿克苏库车）

title.zh: 唐阿史那社尔率军平定龟兹，移安西都护府于龟兹统辖安西四镇
title.en: Tang general Ashina She'er pacifies Kucha, where the Anxi Protectorate is relocated

site.zh: 龟兹（今新疆阿克苏库车）

title.zh: 班超自鄯善西至于阗，诛匈奴使者降服于阗王广德复通西域南道
title.en: Ban Chao wins the allegiance of King Guangde of Khotan, reopening the southern Silk Road

title.zh: 唐廷于于阗置毗沙都督府，与龟兹、疏勒、碎叶并列安西四镇
title.en: The Tang court establishes the Pisha Area Command at Khotan among the Four Garrisons of Anxi

title.zh: 渤海文王大钦茂迁都上京龙泉府，仿唐长安形制筑城号海东盛国
title.en: King Mun of Balhae moves his capital to Shangjing Longquanfu, modeled on Tang Chang'an

site.zh: 上京龙泉府（今黑龙江牡丹江宁安）

title.zh: 辽太祖耶律阿保机围困渤海上京忽汗城，大諲譔出降改设东丹国
title.en: Liao founder Abaoji captures Huhancheng (Shangjing), ending Balhae and establishing Dongdan

site.zh: 忽汗城（今黑龙江牡丹江宁安）

title.zh: 曹魏毌丘俭东征高句丽，登丸都山攻克高句丽王都丸都城刻石纪功
title.en: Cao Wei general Guanqiu Jian storms the Goguryeo capital at Wandu and carves a victory stele

site.zh: 丸都城（今吉林通化集安）

title.zh: 高句丽长寿王于国都国内城立广开土境好太王碑，铭记开疆史事
title.en: King Jangsu of Goguryeo erects the Gwanggaeto Stele at Guonei City in modern Ji'an, Tonghua

site.zh: 国内城（今吉林通化集安）

title.zh: 明征夷将军张辅率军自广西太平府凭祥度坡垒关（镇南关）南征
title.en: Ming general Zhang Fu marches from Taiping Prefecture through Pingxiang Pass into Jiaozhi

site.zh: 凭祥坡垒关（今广西崇左凭祥）

title.zh: 忽必烈于滦河上游开平即大汗位建元中统，旋升开平府为上都
title.en: Kublai Khan is enthroned as Great Khan at Kaiping, soon elevated to summer capital Shangdu

site.zh: 开平（今内蒙古锡林郭勒正蓝旗）

title.zh: 康熙帝亲赴多伦诺尔会盟喀尔喀三部与漠南诸旗，编旗管辖漠北
title.en: Emperor Kangxi convenes the Dolon Nor Assembly, integrating the Khalkha Mongols into banners

site.zh: 多伦诺尔（今内蒙古锡林郭勒多伦）

title.zh: 汉武帝遣路博德筑居延遮虏障屯田戍边，遗存万枚居延汉简
title.en: Emperor Wu dispatches Lu Bode to build the Juyan frontier forts, leaving 10,000 Han slips

site.zh: 居延（今内蒙古阿拉善额济纳）

title.zh: 成吉思汗末次亲征西夏首克黑水城，后元朝于此置亦集乃路
title.en: Genghis Khan captures the Western Xia fortress of Khara-Khoto on his final campaign

site.zh: 黑水城（今内蒙古阿拉善额济纳）

title.zh: 苏轼生于眉州眉山纱縠行，与苏洵、苏辙同出眉山并列唐宋八大家
title.en: Su Shi is born in Mei Zhou (Meishan), home to the Three Su literary masters of Northern Song

title.zh: 朱熹与陆九龄、陆九渊会讲于信州铅山鹅湖寺，史称“鹅湖之会”
title.en: Zhu Xi and Lu Jiuyuan debate Neo-Confucian philosophy at Goose Lake Temple in Shangrao

site.zh: 信州鹅湖（今江西上饶铅山）

title.zh: 辛弃疾罢官隐居信州上饶带湖与瓢泉，赋豪放词抒恢复中原之志
title.en: Patriotic poet Xin Qiji resides in Shangrao for two decades, composing his greatest poems

title.zh: 诸葛亮第三次北伐遣陈式进取武都、阴平二郡，收复陇南要冲
title.en: On his third northern expedition, Zhuge Liang captures Wudu and Yinping in modern Longnan

title.zh: 韩信少时于淮阴受漂母饭信、胯下之辱，后仗剑从军拜汉大将军
title.en: Han Xin endures early hardship in Huaiyin before rising to become Han's supreme commander

title.zh: 韩世忠与梁红玉屯兵楚州筑城抚民，扼守淮东门户十余年屏卫南宋
title.en: Han Shizhong and Liang Hongyu garrison Chu Zhou (Huai'an), defending the Huai frontier

title.zh: 明廷设漕运总督驻节淮安府城，统辖南北大运河四百万石漕粮北运
title.en: The Ming court establishes the Viceroy of Grain Transport at Huai'an on the Grand Canal

title.zh: 闽越围东瓯，汉武帝遣庄助发会稽兵浮海救东瓯并内徙其众于江淮
title.en: Emperor Wu of Han dispatches naval forces from Kuaiji to relieve Dong'ou (Wenzhou)

title.zh: 谢灵运出任永嘉太守，遍游永嘉楠溪江山水，开创中国古典山水诗派
title.en: Xie Lingyun governs Yongjia (Wenzhou), pioneering classical Chinese landscape poetry

title.zh: 金军渡江南侵搜山检海，宋高宗赵构自明州航海驻跸温州江心屿
title.en: Fleeing Jurchen Jin pursuit by sea, Emperor Gaozong of Song holds court at Wenzhou

title.zh: 吴越争霸古战场槜李（今嘉兴）归越国，扼杭嘉湖水网要冲
title.en: Site of the classic Wu-Yue battle of Zuili, Jiaxing guards the fertile northern Zhejiang plain

title.zh: 张经、卢镗与俞大猷统兵于嘉兴王江泾大破倭寇，获抗倭首捷
title.en: Ming commanders Zhang Jing and Yu Dayou crush Wokou pirates at Wangjiangjing in Jiaxing

site.zh: 嘉兴王江泾（今浙江嘉兴）

title.zh: 中共一大自上海转移至嘉兴南湖红船续会闭幕，宣告中国共产党成立
title.en: The First National Congress concludes aboard the Red Boat on South Lake in Jiaxing

title.zh: 朱元璋亲率大军攻克婺州改宁越府，延揽宋濂、王祎等浙东名儒
title.en: Zhu Yuanzhang captures Wu Zhou (Jinhua), recruiting Neo-Confucian scholars Song Lian and Wang Yi

title.zh: 衍圣公孔端友负楷木圣像随宋高宗南渡，诏赐家衢州形成孔氏南宗
title.en: Duke Yansheng Kong Duanyou escorts sacred Confucian heirlooms south and settles in Quzhou

title.zh: 朱元璋遣使入处州青田山中礼聘刘基（刘伯温）出山辅佐定天下
title.en: After capturing Chu Zhou (Lishui), Zhu Yuanzhang invites Liu Bowen of Qingtian to his court

title.zh: 曹丕代汉建魏，尊曹氏故里谯县（今亳州）为陪都，列曹魏五都
title.en: Cao Pi designates the Cao clan's ancestral home of Qiao (Bozhou) among the Five Capitals of Wei

title.zh: 刘福通迎韩林儿于亳州称帝，号小明王，建国大宋改元龙凤
title.en: Liu Futong enthrones Han Lin'er at Bozhou as Emperor of the restored Song Red Turban regime

title.zh: 宋廷平定方腊起义后诏改歙州为徽州，统辖一府六县育徽州文化
title.en: After suppressing Fang La's uprising, the Song court renames She Zhou to Hui Zhou

title.zh: 朱元璋克徽州访休宁名儒朱升，获“高筑墙、广积粮、缓称王”国策
title.en: At Huizhou, scholar Zhu Sheng counsels Zhu Yuanzhang to build high walls and store grain

title.zh: 欧阳修致仕退居颍州西湖畔，合藏书金石琴棋酒鹤自号六一居士
title.en: Ouyang Xiu retires beside West Lake in Ying Zhou (Fuyang) as the Six-One Lay Buddhist

title.zh: 刘锜率八字军孤城坚守顺昌（今阜阳），以少击众大破金兀术主力
title.en: Song general Liu Qi defends Shunchang (Fuyang), routing Wuzhu's elite Jin iron cavalry

title.zh: 魏胜于海州举义收复州城，会合宋水师李宝屡败金兵屏蔽淮海
title.en: Loyalist commander Wei Sheng recovers Hai Zhou (Lianyungang) and repels Jin forces

title.zh: 后周世宗柴荣南征取江北十四州，升静海始建通州扼长江入海口
title.en: Later Zhou Emperor Chai Rong establishes Tong Zhou (Nantong) at the mouth of the Yangtze

title.zh: 状元张謇于通州唐闸建成大生纱厂投产，兴办实业学堂开近代南通
title.en: Optimus scholar Zhang Jian opens the Dasheng Cotton Mill in Nantong, pioneering industry

title.zh: 范仲淹任西溪盐官倡议重修海堰，筑百里范公堤护淮南盐场良田
title.en: Fan Zhongyan initiates construction of the coastal Fan Gong Dike at Yancheng

title.zh: 皖南事变后新四军于江苏盐城重建军部，陈毅代军长、刘少奇政委
title.en: After the Southern Anhui Incident, the New Fourth Army rebuilds its headquarters at Yancheng

title.zh: 顾宪成、高攀龙于无锡重修东林书院讲学议政，撰“风声雨声”名联
title.en: Gu Xiancheng and Gao Panlong restore the Donglin Academy in Wuxi as a center of reform

site.zh: 无锡东林书院（今江苏无锡）

title.zh: 巴郡阆中天文学家落下闳入长安造《太初历》，确立正月为岁首
title.en: Astronomer Luoxia Hong of Langzhong authors the Taichu Calendar under Emperor Wu of Han

site.zh: 巴郡阆中（今四川南充阆中）

title.zh: 刘备定益州后拜张飞为巴西太守镇守阆中七年，于宕渠大破张郃
title.en: Zhang Fei governs Baxi Commandery from Langzhong for seven years and defeats Zhang He

site.zh: 巴西阆中（今四川南充阆中）

title.zh: 宋政和四年改戎州为叙州，控扼金沙江与岷江汇合万里长江第一城
title.en: The Song court renames Rong Zhou to Xu Zhou (Yibin) at the headwaters of the Yangtze River

title.zh: 海通禅师于嘉州三江汇流凌云山开凿弥勒大佛，历九十载至韦皋竣工
title.en: Monk Haitong begins carving the 71-meter Leshan Giant Buddha at the confluence in Jia Zhou

site.zh: 嘉州凌云山（今四川乐山）

title.zh: 诸葛亮南征自成都率水师顺江至江阳（今泸州）会师，分兵平南中
title.en: Zhuge Liang sails down the Min River to Jiangyang (Luzhou) to assemble his southern expedition

title.zh: 余玠筑泸州神臂城扼守长江上游，军民拉锯坚守抗蒙长达三十四年
title.en: Song commander Yu Jie fortifies Shenbicheng at Luzhou, resisting Mongol sieges for 34 years

site.zh: 泸州神臂城（今四川泸州）

title.zh: 元稹左迁通州（今达州）司马，与江州司马白居易千里寄诗唱和
title.en: Poet Yuan Zhen serves in exile as Marshal of Tong Zhou (Dazhou), exchanging poems with Bai Juyi

title.zh: 汉武帝开西南夷定邛都，置越嶲郡治邛都（今西昌）通川滇古道
title.en: Emperor Wu establishes Yuexi Commandery at Qiongdu (Xichang), opening the Sichuan-Yunnan road

site.zh: 越嶲郡（今四川凉山西昌）

title.zh: 蓝玉平建昌卫月鲁帖木儿之乱，明置四川行都司驻节建昌统川西南
title.en: General Lan Yu pacifies Jianchang (Xichang), seat of the Sichuan Branch Military Commission

site.zh: 建昌卫（今四川凉山西昌）

title.zh: 王安石诞于抚州临川，与同郡南丰曾巩双双名列“唐宋八大家”
title.en: Reformist statesman and poet Wang Anshi is born in Linchuan, Fuzhou (Jiangxi)

title.zh: 汤显祖于抚州临川玉茗堂写成《牡丹亭》，“临川四梦”冠绝明代剧坛
title.en: Playwright Tang Xianzu completes The Peony Pavilion at Yuming Hall in Linchuan, Fuzhou

site.zh: 抚州玉茗堂（今江西抚州）

title.zh: 韩愈由潮州量移袁州（今宜春）刺史，赎放质押奴婢七百余人兴学
title.en: Governing Yuan Zhou (Yichun), Han Yu frees over 700 bonded servants and promotes schooling

title.zh: 宋应星任袁州府分宜教谕期间刊印《天工开物》，总结百工技艺
title.en: While teaching in Yuanzhou Prefecture (Yichun), Song Yingxing publishes Tiangong Kaiwu

title.zh: 莆田木兰陂历三代接力合龙建成，拒咸蓄淡灌溉兴化平原万顷良田
title.en: The Mulan Weir irrigation project is completed in Putian, turning the plain into fertile fields

title.zh: 戚继光率军疾驰入闽，连破横屿、林墩与平海卫倭巢收复莆田
title.en: General Qi Jiguang leads his army into Fujian, routing Wokou pirates to recover Putian

title.zh: 曹操精骑追刘备于当阳长坂，赵云单骑救主、张飞据水断桥
title.en: Cao Cao overtakes Liu Bei at Changban in Dangyang (Jingmen), where Zhao Yun rescues Liu Shan

site.zh: 当阳长坂（今湖北荆门当阳）

title.zh: 吕蒙袭取江陵，关羽退保当阳麦城，年底突围至临沮漳乡遇害
title.en: Cut off after the fall of Jiangling, Guan Yu retreats to Maicheng in Dangyang before falling

site.zh: 当阳麦城（今湖北荆门当阳）

title.zh: 曾国（随国）立国汉东，曾侯乙墓六十五件青铜编钟冠绝先秦礼乐
title.en: The Marquis Yi of Zeng bronze chime bells at Suizhou showcase pre-Qin ritual music mastery

title.zh: 明成祖敕调军民三十万大修均州武当山，历十二年建成太和宫道场
title.en: Emperor Yongle mobilizes 300,000 artisans over twelve years to build Mount Wudang's temples

site.zh: 均州武当山（今湖北十堰丹江口）

title.zh: 都御史原杰抚治荆襄流民，于秦鄂豫交界置郧阳府并设郧阳抚治
title.en: Imperial Commissioner Yuan Jie establishes Yunyang Prefecture at Shiyan to settle migrants

site.zh: 郧阳府（今湖北十堰郧阳）

title.zh: 宋理宗赵昀即位改元宝庆，以潜邸升邵州为宝庆府，控扼湘西南
title.en: Emperor Lizong of Song elevates his former fief Shao Zhou to Baoqing Prefecture (Shaoyang)

title.zh: 邵阳人魏源据林则徐《四洲志》编成《海国图志》，倡师夷长技
title.en: Shaoyang scholar Wei Yuan compiles the Illustrated Treatise on the Maritime Kingdoms

title.zh: 项羽尊楚怀王心为义帝并徙于江南郴县，旋密令英布弑之于郴江
title.en: Xiang Yu exiles Emperor Yi of Chu to Chen County (Chenzhou) and orders his assassination

title.zh: 桂阳郡郴县人蔡伦用树皮麻头改良造纸术奏上汉和帝，称“蔡侯纸”
title.en: Cai Lun of Guiyang Commandery (Chenzhou) presents his improved papermaking process to the court

title.zh: 王昌龄贬龙标（今怀化）尉筑芙蓉楼，李白寄诗“随君直到夜郎西”
title.en: Poet Wang Changling is exiled to Longbiao (Huaihua), inspiring Li Bai's famous farewell poem

title.zh: 中国陆军总司令部于湖南芷江受降堂接受侵华日军今井武夫洽降
title.en: Chinese forces accept the preliminary surrender of Japanese troops in China at Zhijiang

title.zh: 禅宗六祖慧能驻锡韶州曹溪宝林寺弘法三十七年，口述《六祖坛经》
title.en: Sixth Patriarch Huineng teaches Chan Buddhism for 37 years at Baolin Temple in Shaoguan

title.zh: 韶州曲江人张九龄主持开凿大庾岭梅关新道，打通南北商贸坦途
title.en: Chancellor Zhang Jiuling of Qujiang (Shaoguan) cuts the Meiguan Pass road over Dayu Ridge

title.zh: 宋徽宗以潜邸端王升端州为肇庆府，亲书“肇庆府”御匾赐之
title.en: Emperor Huizong elevates his former fief Duan Zhou to Zhaoqing Prefecture and inscribes its name

title.zh: 利玛窦获准入驻两广总督驻地肇庆，绘成中文世界地图《山海舆地全图》
title.en: Jesuit Matteo Ricci settles at Zhaoqing and produces the first Chinese world map

title.zh: 桂王朱由榔于广东肇庆称帝改元永历，以肇庆为南明抗清中枢
title.en: Zhu Youlang, Prince of Gui, is proclaimed the Yongli Emperor at Zhaoqing to resist the Qing

title.zh: 北宋名相寇准贬雷州司户参军卒于任上，州民感其忠直建莱公祠
title.en: Former Song Chancellor Kou Zhun dies in exile at Lei Zhou (Zhanjiang), honored by a local shrine

title.zh: 岭南高凉冼夫人率百越诸州奉表归隋，隋文帝册封其为谯国夫人
title.en: Lady Xian of Gaoliang (Maoming) leads Lingnan into peaceful reunification under the Sui

title.zh: 汉武帝置交趾刺史部治苍梧郡广信县（今梧州），广信分界广东广西
title.en: Emperor Wu places the Jiaozhi Inspector at Guangxin (Wuzhou), dividing Guangdong and Guangxi

title.zh: 明廷于梧州设两广总督府与总镇府，统摄广东广西军政百余年
title.en: The Ming court establishes the Viceroy of Liangguang at Wuzhou to govern Guangdong and Guangxi

title.zh: 汉武帝平南越置合浦郡，合浦港成为汉代海上丝绸之路始发港
title.en: Emperor Wu establishes Hepu Commandery (Beihai), a primary port of the Han Maritime Silk Road

title.zh: 孟尝出任合浦太守革除滥采海珠弊政，不出岁余“去珠复还”
title.en: Grand Administrator Meng Chang reforms pearl-harvesting in Hepu, restoring the pearl beds

site.zh: 合浦郡（今广西北海合浦）

title.zh: 鉴真第五次东渡遇飓风漂至海南振州（今三亚），留大云寺传戒一年
title.en: Blown off course by a typhoon, Monk Jianzhen lands at Zhen Zhou (Sanya) and teaches for a year

title.zh: 黄道婆自崖州水南村习得黎族棉纺织绝技返松江，革新江南棉纺
title.en: After learning Li textile skills in Ya Zhou (Sanya), Huang Daopo revolutionizes cotton weaving

title.zh: 汉光武帝刘秀亲征陇右至高平第一城（今平凉），会窦融兵合围隗嚣
title.en: Emperor Guangwu marches to Gaoping (Pingliang), joining Dou Rong's forces against Wei Xiao

site.zh: 高平第一城（今甘肃平凉）

title.zh: 唐德宗遣浑瑊与吐蕃会盟于平凉川，吐蕃伏兵劫盟史称平凉劫盟
title.en: Tibetan forces ambush Tang envoy Hun Jian during treaty talks in the Ambush of Pingliang

title.zh: 秦宣太后诱杀义渠戎王，起兵灭义渠国，于陇东置北地郡筑长城
title.en: Queen Dowager Xuan of Qin eliminates Yiqu, establishing Beidi Commandery at Qingyang

title.zh: 范仲淹知庆州兼掌环庆路，抢筑大顺城稳固宋夏中路防线
title.en: Fan Zhongyan governs Qing Zhou (Qingyang) and builds Dashun Fortress against Western Xia

title.zh: 哀牢王柳貌率五十余万口内属东汉，汉明帝置永昌郡（治今保山）
title.en: King Liumao of Ailao submits to Eastern Han, which establishes Yongchang Commandery at Baoshan

title.zh: 明军平滇改临安路为临安府（治建水），拓建砖城文庙号滇南邹鲁
title.en: The Ming court establishes Lin'an Prefecture at Jianshui (Honghe) and builds its brick walls

site.zh: 临安府（今云南红河建水）

title.zh: 赤松德赞迎莲花生与寂护于山南建成西藏首座佛法僧俱全桑耶寺
title.en: Tibetan Emperor Trisong Detsen completes Samye Monastery in Shannan, Tibet's first monastery

site.zh: 桑耶寺（今西藏山南扎囊）

title.zh: 帕木竹巴绛曲坚赞统一卫藏，以山南乃东（泽当）为首府建帕竹政权
title.en: Jangchub Gyaltsen unifies Central Tibet from Nedong in Shannan, founding the Phagmodrupa rule

title.zh: 吐蕃赞普松赞干布亲征灭象雄王国，将藏西阿里高原并入吐蕃版图
title.en: Tibetan Emperor Songtsen Gampo conquers Zhangzhung, incorporating Ngari into the Tibetan Empire

site.zh: 象雄穹窿银城（今西藏阿里噶尔）

title.zh: 古格王室迎印度高僧阿底峡抵阿里托林寺译经，开启藏传佛教后弘期
title.en: The Guge court welcomes Indian master Atisha to Tholing Monastery in Ngari to translate sutras

site.zh: 古格托林寺（今西藏阿里札达）

title.zh: 李鸿章于芝罘签订《烟台条约》，增开宜昌、芜湖、温州、北海通商
title.en: Li Hongzhang signs the Chefoo Convention at Yantai, opening four more treaty ports

title.zh: 红四军在闽西龙岩上杭召开古田会议，确立思想建党、政治建军原则
title.en: Gutian Conference in Longyan establishes the foundational principle of political army building

title.zh: 大秦王安敦遣使自日南徼外献象牙、犀角，中罗首次直接往来
title.en: Envoys of Rome's Marcus Aurelius reach Han via Rinan with ivory and rhino horn

title.zh: 曹操出卢龙塞北征乌桓，张辽白狼山阵斩蹋顿，平定辽西
title.en: Cao Cao marches through Lulong Pass; Zhang Liao slays Tadun at White Wolf Mountain

title.zh: 北魏文成帝命沙门昙曜于平城西武州山开凿云冈石窟（昙曜五窟）
title.en: Monk Tanyao begins carving the Yungang Grottoes west of the Northern Wei capital Pingcheng

site.zh: 平城武州山（今山西大同云冈）

title.zh: 六镇乱起，武川镇军人宇文泰、独孤信、杨忠、李虎由此崛起，开关陇集团
title.en: Wuchuan men Yuwen Tai, Dugu Xin, Yang Zhong and Li Hu rise, seeding the Guanlong elite

site.zh: 武川镇（今内蒙古呼和浩特武川）

title.zh: 韦孝宽死守玉壁五十日，东魏高欢倾国攻城不克，忧愤发病
title.en: Wei Xiaokuan holds Yubi for fifty days; Gao Huan's Eastern Wei siege fails and he falls ill

site.zh: 玉壁城（今山西运城稷山）

title.zh: 郭守敬主持四海测验，筑告成观星台测影，编成《授时历》颁行
title.en: Guo Shoujing's empire-wide survey and Gaocheng Observatory yield the Shoushi Calendar

site.zh: 阳城告成（今河南郑州登封）

title.zh: 摩洛哥旅行家伊本·白图泰抵刺桐港，盛赞其为世界最大港口之一
title.en: Moroccan traveler Ibn Battuta reaches Zayton and hails it as one of the greatest ports on earth

site.zh: 泉州刺桐港（今福建泉州）

title.zh: 朱元璋自皇觉寺投濠州郭子兴红巾军，娶马氏，起于行伍
title.en: Zhu Yuanzhang leaves Huangjue Temple to join Guo Zixing's Red Turbans at Haozhou

site.zh: 濠州钟离（今安徽滁州凤阳）

title.zh: 阿桂历五年平定大小金川，废土司设屯置厅，改土归流
title.en: After a five-year war Agui subdues Greater and Lesser Jinchuan, abolishing its native chiefdoms

site.zh: 大小金川（今四川阿坝金川）

title.zh: 英使马戛尔尼于热河避暑山庄觐见乾隆，通商请求遭拒
title.en: Lord Macartney meets Qianlong at the Chengde Mountain Resort; British trade requests are refused

site.zh: 热河避暑山庄（今河北承德）

title.zh: 《南京条约》割让香港岛，英人辟维多利亚城开埠
title.en: Under the Treaty of Nanjing, Hong Kong Island is ceded and Victoria City is founded

title.zh: 中法马江海战：法舰突袭马尾，福建水师覆没，船政局遭炮毁
title.en: Battle of Fuzhou: French warships ambush Mawei, sinking the Fujian Fleet and shelling the yard

site.zh: 马尾船政（今福建福州马尾）

title.zh: 日军水陆围攻威海卫，丁汝昌于刘公岛殉国，北洋水师覆没
title.en: Japan besieges Weihaiwei; Ding Ruchang dies on Liugong Island as the Beiyang Fleet is destroyed

title.zh: 秦孝公下求贤令，卫鞅（商鞅）入秦于栎阳南门徙木立信，颁垦草令
title.en: Shang Yang enters Qin at Yueyang and establishes public trust with the South Gate pole decree

title.zh: 商鞅率秦军大破魏军，虏魏公子卬，收复河西受封商君十五邑
title.en: Shang Yang defeats Wei forces west of the Yellow River and is enfeoffed as Lord of Shang

title.zh: 秦惠文王即位，商鞅出奔商邑起兵败亡于彤地，然“秦法未败”
title.en: Shang Yang falls after Duke Xiao dies, yet his legalist institutions endure in Qin

title.zh: 孙膑自魏脱险入齐，以“田忌赛马”上中下驷之策受齐威王拜为军师
title.en: Sun Bin arrives in Linzi and becomes chief strategist to King Wei of Qi

title.zh: 屈原任楚怀王左徒草拟宪令，力谏联齐抗秦遭谗被疏，作《离骚》
title.en: Qu Yuan drafts reforms at Ying and composes Li Sao after being sidelined at court

title.zh: 屈原极谏无果，楚怀王赴武关之会为秦所扣留，客死咸阳
title.en: Despite Qu Yuan warning against it, King Huai of Chu enters Wu Pass and is detained by Qin

title.zh: 屈原流放沅湘行吟泽畔，作《九歌》《涉江》《天问》
title.en: Exiled south of the Yangtze, Qu Yuan wanders along the Yuan and Xiang rivers composing Nine Songs

title.zh: 伊阙之战：秦将白起避实击虚，斩首韩魏联军二十四万，拔五城
title.en: Battle of Yique: Qin general Bai Qi annihilates 240,000 Han-Wei coalition troops

title.zh: 华阳之战：白起急行军突袭赵魏联军，斩首十三万，沉赵卒二万于河
title.en: Battle of Huayang: Bai Qi routs Zhao-Wei forces on a forced march

title.zh: 白起拒帅秦军攻邯郸触怒秦昭襄王，行至咸阳西十里杜邮赐剑自尽
title.en: Bai Qi refuses to command the siege of Handan and is ordered to take his own life at Duyou

title.zh: 赵将李牧久守雁门诱敌深入，单日大破匈奴十余万骑
title.en: Zhao general Li Mu lures Xiongnu raiders deep past Yanmen Pass and crushes 100,000 horsemen

title.zh: 肥之战：李牧统赵军奇袭秦大营，大破秦将桓齮十万军，受封武安君
title.en: Battle of Fei: Li Mu routs Qin general Huan Yi and is enfeoffed as Lord Wu'an

title.zh: 秦王翦行反间计买通郭开，赵王迁冤杀名将李牧，数月后邯郸陷落
title.en: Qin intrigue leads King Qian of Zhao to execute Li Mu, sealing the fall of Handan

title.zh: 秦异人质赵，嬴政生于邯郸；前247年年十三归咸阳即秦王位
title.en: Ying Zheng (future Qin Shi Huang) is born in Handan as son of a Qin royal hostage

title.zh: 秦始皇命史禄开凿灵渠沟通湘漓二水，屠睢任嚣统军平定岭南置三郡
title.en: Qin Shi Huang orders the Lingqu Canal dug to link the Xiang and Li rivers and conquer Lingnan

title.zh: 胡亥赵高矫诏赐死公子扶苏与大将蒙恬于上郡
title.en: Prince Fusu and General Meng Tian are forced to die by forged edict at frontier Shangjun

title.zh: 项梁、项羽叔侄于吴中斩会稽守通起兵反秦，率八千江东子弟渡江而西
title.en: Xiang Liang and Xiang Yu raise 8,000 Jiangdong warriors in Suzhou against the Qin Empire

title.zh: 巨鹿之战：项羽破釜沉舟渡漳水，九战九捷大破章邯王离秦军主力
title.en: Battle of Julu: Xiang Yu smashes his cooking pots and crushes the main Qin army in nine battles

title.zh: 鸿门宴：项羽设宴新丰鸿门，张良樊哙翼蔽刘邦脱险
title.en: Feast at Hongmen: Zhang Liang and Fan Kuai help Liu Bang escape Xiang Yu's camp near Xianyang

title.zh: 彭城之战：项羽率三万精骑自齐南驰，一日大破刘邦五十六万联军于睢水
title.en: Battle of Pengcheng: Xiang Yu leads 30,000 cavalry to rout Liu Bang's 560,000 coalition troops

title.zh: 楚汉荥阳成皋相持经年，项羽刘邦中分天下订“鸿沟之约”
title.en: Xiang Yu and Liu Bang divide the realm along the Hong Canal before Han launches the final push

title.zh: 垓下之战：韩信十面埋伏、四面楚歌围困楚军，项羽突围至乌江拒渡自刎
title.en: Battle of Gaixia: Surrounded by Han Xin and Chu songs, Xiang Yu takes his life by the Wu River

title.zh: 亭长刘邦斩白蛇起义称沛公，萧何曹参樊哙归附
title.en: Pavilion chief Liu Bang rises in rebellion at Peixian backed by Xiao He, Cao Shen, and Fan Kuai

title.zh: 刘邦就封汉王入汉中，萧何月下追韩信
title.en: In Hanzhong, Xiao He rides by moonlight to bring back Han Xin as Liu Bang’s Grand General

title.zh: 韩信明修褒斜栈道惑章邯，暗度故道袭取陈仓，一举平定三秦之地
title.en: Han Xin feints along plank roads while secretly seizing Chencang to conquer the Three Qin

title.zh: 韩信于临晋设疑兵陈船，自夏阳以木罂缻渡黄河奇袭安邑，生擒魏王豹
title.en: Han Xin crosses the Yellow River using wooden jars to outflank and capture King Bao of Wei

title.zh: 潍水之战：韩信囊沙壅水诱敌半渡，决水斩杀楚大将龙且，平定齐地封齐王
title.en: Battle of the Wei River: Han Xin dams the river with sandbags to defeat Chu general Long Ju

title.zh: 吕后与萧何设谋诱淮阴侯韩信入贺，斩韩信于长乐宫钟室
title.en: Empress Lü and Xiao He lure Han Xin into Changle Palace in Chang’an and execute him

title.zh: 汉高祖刘邦讨英布归过故乡沛县，击筑歌《大风歌》
title.en: Returning from crushing Ying Bu, Emperor Gaozu feasts in hometown Peixian singing Great Wind

title.zh: 韩贵族张良散尽家财求力士，于博浪沙狙击东巡秦始皇误中副车
title.en: Zhang Liang ambushes Qin Shi Huang’s convoy at Bolangsha and flees into hiding at Xiapi

title.zh: 匈奴寇边，汉文帝劳军细柳营按辔徐行，赞周亚夫真将军
title.en: Emperor Wen inspects Xiliu Camp at a walk, praising strict commander Zhou Yafu as a true general

title.zh: 卫青率汉军自云中西出至陇西，收复河南河套之地，筑朔方城屏卫关中
title.en: General Wei Qing retakes the Ordos Loop from the Xiongnu and establishes Shuofang Commandery

title.zh: 卫青夜行六七百里突袭匈奴右贤王庭，俘获万五千人
title.en: Wei Qing launches a night raid routing the Right Tuqi King and becomes General-in-Chief

title.zh: 年十八岁的霍去病率八百轻骑赴利，封冠军侯
title.en: Eighteen-year-old Huo Qubing leads 800 light cavalry deep into Xiongnu lines as Marquis Guanjun

title.zh: 河西之战：霍去病连破匈奴五王，受浑邪王四万众降
title.en: Hexi Campaign: Huo Qubing sweeps past Mt. Yanzhi and opens the Hexi Corridor to the West

title.zh: 漠北大战：卫青破单于，霍去病北进封狼居胥山
title.en: Mobei Campaign: Wei Qing routs the Chanyu while Huo Qubing performs rites atop Mt. Langjuxu

title.zh: 汉武帝晚年罢轮台屯田，下《轮台罪己诏》深陈既往征伐之悔
title.en: In his late reign Emperor Wu issues the Luntai Edict of Self-Reproach, pivoting toward peace

title.zh: 二十岁的司马迁南游江淮，上会稽探禹穴、窥九疑、浮沅湘
title.en: Twenty-year-old Sima Qian travels across Jianghuai, Kuaiji, and Xiang gathering historical lore

title.zh: 太史令司马迁受宫刑后发愤著书，成《史记》百三十篇
title.en: Enduring punishment over the Li Ling affair, Grand Historian Sima Qian completes the Shiji

title.zh: 王莽废孺子婴代汉建“新”，改王田奴婢币制并频改地名
title.en: Wang Mang proclaims the Xin Dynasty in Chang'an, enacting sweeping land and currency reforms

title.zh: 昆阳之战：刘秀率敢死队冲阵大破王莽四十二万大军
title.en: Battle of Kunyang: Liu Xiu leads 3,000 shock troops to rout Wang Mang's 420,000-man army

title.zh: 刘秀巡行河北攻拔邯郸诛灭王郎，铜马诸部降附号“铜马帝”
title.en: Liu Xiu captures Handan and absorbs northern peasant armies, securing Hebei as his base

title.zh: 班超奉命使鄯善，“不入虎穴焉得虎子”率三十六吏士夜袭火烧匈奴使营
title.en: Ban Chao leads 36 men in a daring night raid on Xiongnu envoys, winning Shanshan over to Han

title.zh: 西域都护班超发龟兹鄯善等八国兵讨平焉耆，西域五十余国悉纳质内属
title.en: Protector-General Ban Chao subdues Yanqi as fifty Western Regions states submit to Eastern Han

title.zh: 班超年逾七旬上疏“但愿生入玉门关”，召还洛阳病逝
title.en: Aged seventy, Ban Chao petitions to return alive through Yumen Pass and dies back in Luoyang

title.zh: 曹操入主兖州击败青州黄巾百万众，收编精锐三十余万为“青州兵”
title.en: Cao Cao takes Yanzhou and integrates Yellow Turban veterans into his elite Qingzhou Army

title.zh: 曹操自洛阳迎汉献帝迁许都，行屯田“奉天子以令不臣”
title.en: Cao Cao escorts Emperor Xian to Xuchang and launches garrison farms to command the realm

title.zh: 下邳之战：曹操荀攸决沂泗水灌城生擒吕布，尽得徐州之地
title.en: Battle of Xiapi: Cao Cao diverts the Yi and Si rivers to flood the city and capture Lü Bu

title.zh: 曹操北征乌桓斩蹋顿，归途登碣石山赋《观沧海》
title.en: Returning from crushing the Wuhuan at Mt. Bailang, Cao Cao composes Gazing on the Blue Sea

title.zh: 潼关之战：曹操渡渭筑冰城，离间大破马超韩遂联军
title.en: Battle of Tong Pass: Cao Cao crosses the Wei River and sows discord to rout Ma Chao and Han Sui

title.zh: 魏王曹操病逝洛阳遗令薄葬；冬子曹丕受禅代汉建魏
title.en: Cao Cao dies in Luoyang ordering a simple burial; that winter his son Cao Pi founds Cao Wei

title.zh: 黄巾起义爆发，刘备与关羽、张飞于涿县募兵讨贼
title.en: Liu Bei joins Guan Yu and Zhang Fei in Zhuoxian to raise volunteers against the Yellow Turbans

title.zh: 刘备携荆州十余万百姓南撤，当阳长坂被曹纯虎豹骑追及
title.en: At Changban Slope Zhao Yun rescues infant Liu Shan while Zhang Fei holds Changban Bridge alone

title.zh: 刘备自葭萌南下进围成都，刘璋开城出降，刘备领益州牧跨有荆益二州
title.en: Liu Bei captures Chengdu from Liu Zhang, securing Shu as envisioned in the Longzhong Plan

title.zh: 定军山之战：黄忠法正乘高突击阵斩曹魏征西将军夏侯渊，曹操退兵
title.en: Battle of Mt. Dingjun: Huang Zhong slays Wei general Xiahou Yuan, securing Hanzhong for Liu Bei

title.zh: 白马之战：关羽策马刺颜良于万众之中斩首而还，解白马之围受封汉寿亭侯
title.en: Battle of Baima: Guan Yu slays Yuan Shao's vanguard general Yan Liang amidst enemy ranks

title.zh: 襄樊之战：关羽围曹仁于樊城，汉水秋汛水淹七军
title.en: Battle of Fancheng: Guan Yu floods seven Wei armies with autumn swells of the Han River

title.zh: 吕蒙白衣渡江袭取江陵，关羽腹背受敌退保麦城，突围西走临沮兵败遇害
title.en: After Lu Meng secretly seizes Jiangling, Guan Yu retreats to Maicheng and falls breaking out

title.zh: 孙策遇刺身亡，年十九岁的孙权继领江东六郡
title.en: Aged nineteen, Sun Quan succeeds his brother Sun Ce and consolidates rule over Jiangdong

title.zh: 赤壁之战：周瑜黄盖统孙刘水军借东南风火烧乌林战船
title.en: Battle of Red Cliffs: Zhou Yu and Huang Gai unleash fire ships to burn Cao Cao's armada

title.zh: 江陵之战：周瑜浴血奋战岁余攻克曹仁据守之江陵，出任南郡太守
title.en: Zhou Yu captures strategic Jiangling after a year-long siege and serves as Governor of Nanjun

title.zh: 濡须口之战：曹操率大军南攻濡须，孙权乘大船入曹营观军
title.en: At Ruxukou Sun Quan sails boldly past Wei lines; Cao Cao sighs that sons should be like Sun

title.zh: 石亭之战：东吴大都督陆逊诱曹休深入皖城石亭，合围斩获万余大破魏军
title.en: Battle of Shiting: Eastern Wu commander Lu Xun lures Wei general Cao Xiu deep and routs him

title.zh: 太尉司马懿率四万军日行百里远征辽东，声东击西攻克襄平斩公孙渊
title.en: Sima Yi leads a rapid campaign to conquer Liaodong and crush warlord Gongsun Yuan at Xiangping

title.zh: 高平陵之变：太傅司马懿乘曹爽陪魏帝祭高平陵闭城据武库
title.en: Gaoping Tombs Coup: Sima Yi seizes Luoyang arsenals while regent Cao Shuang is outside the city

title.zh: 永和九年上巳，王羲之与谢安等雅集兰亭作《兰亭集序》
title.en: Wang Xizhi gathers forty-two literati at Orchid Pavilion and brushes the Lantingji Xu preface

title.zh: 谢安隐居会稽东山四十余年屡辞征辟
title.en: Xie An emerges from forty years of seclusion at Mt. Dongshan to steady the Eastern Jin court

title.zh: 淝水之战：谢安运筹建康，谢玄率北府兵大破苻坚南征军
title.en: Battle of Fei River: Directed by Xie An, Xie Xuan leads 80,000 troops to rout Fu Jian’s host

title.zh: 彭泽令陶渊明叹“吾不能为五斗米折腰”，解印辞官归隐浔阳南山
title.en: Refusing to bow for five pecks of grain, Tao Yuanming resigns at Pengze for quiet farm life

title.zh: 刘裕代晋建宋后陶渊明隐居浔阳，著《桃花源记》寄志
title.en: Living in seclusion at Xunyang after Jin falls, Tao Yuanming writes Peach Blossom Spring

title.zh: 刘裕率晋军北伐攻克南燕都城广固，生擒慕容超，收复齐鲁故地
title.en: Liu Yu leads an Eastern Jin northern expedition that storms Guanggu and destroys Southern Yan

title.zh: 刘裕水陆北伐克洛阳、入潼关攻占长安灭后秦姚泓，收复两京
title.en: Liu Yu retakes Luoyang and Chang'an, destroying Later Qin in the grandest southern expedition

title.zh: 北魏孝文帝拓跋宏与冯太后于平城颁行均田制与三长制
title.en: Emperor Xiaowen of Northern Wei promulgates the Equal-Field land system at Pingcheng

title.zh: 北魏孝文帝借南征之名自平城迁都洛阳
title.en: Emperor Xiaowen moves the Northern Wei capital from Datong to Luoyang and enacts Sinicization

title.zh: 迁都洛阳后，孝文帝开启伊阙龙门石窟营建
title.en: Following the move to Luoyang, Northern Wei begins carving the monumental Longmen Grottoes

title.zh: 隋文帝杨坚命宇文恺营建新都大兴城，确立三省六部制、开皇律
title.en: Emperor Wen of Sui builds Daxing City and codifies the Three Departments and Six Ministries

title.zh: 天下反隋烽烟四起，宇文化及等于扬州江都宫发动兵变缢杀隋炀帝杨广
title.en: Amid nationwide rebellions, mutinous guards under Yuwen Huaji strangle Emperor Yang in Jiangdu

title.zh: 李世民劝父唐国公李渊于晋阳起兵西进，十一月攻克大兴城迎立代王
title.en: Li Shimin persuades his father Li Yuan to rise in Taiyuan and march west to capture Chang'an

title.zh: 浅水原之战：秦王李世民歼灭西秦薛仁杲主力，平定陇右
title.en: Battle of Qianshuiyuan: Li Shimin destroys Xue Rengao's Western Qin army to secure Longyou

title.zh: 虎牢之战：李世民率玄甲骑擒窦建德，洛阳王世充出降
title.en: Battle of Hulao: Li Shimin captures Dou Jiande with armored cavalry; Wang Shichong surrenders

title.zh: 年逾六旬的西海道行军大总管李靖统侯君集等西征吐谷浑
title.en: Sixty-four-year-old Marshal Li Jing leads a Tang expedition past Lake Qinghai to subdue Tuyuhun

title.zh: 徐敬业扬州起兵，骆宾王草檄讨武，武则天读檄叹宰相过
title.en: Xu Jingye rebels in Yangzhou with Luo Binwang’s manifesto; Empress Wu praises its literary force

title.zh: 神龙政变：张柬之等拥李显诛二张，武则天禅位复唐国号
title.en: Shenlong Coup: Zhang Jianzhi restores the Tang house in Luoyang shortly before Empress Wu dies

title.zh: 唐隆政变：临淄王李隆基联太平公主夜率羽林军诛杀韦后安乐公主
title.en: Prince Li Longji leads palace guards to overthrow Empress Wei in Chang'an, stabilizing Tang

title.zh: 开元十三年国富兵强，唐玄宗李隆基率百官与诸蕃使节东封泰山
title.en: At the height of Kaiyuan prosperity, Emperor Xuanzong performs Feng-Shan rites atop Mount Tai

title.zh: 潼关失守唐玄宗弃长安奔蜀，至马嵬驿禁军哗变诛宰相杨国忠
title.en: Fleeing toward Sichuan, imperial guards mutiny at Mawei and slay Chancellor Yang Guozhong

title.zh: 监察御史王维出塞途经居延泽，赋“大漠孤烟直，长河落日圆”
title.en: Envoy Wang Wei crosses the Juyan desert frontier, writing A solitary plume rises over desert

title.zh: 王维购得宋之问蓝田辋川别业，与裴迪泛舟弹琴赋《辋川集》二十首
title.en: Wang Wei retreats to his Wangchuan mountain estate near Lantian, composing the Wangchuan River poems

title.zh: 安禄山陷京执王维送洛阳普施寺，王维服药称喑暗赋悲诗
title.en: Held captive at Pushi Temple in Luoyang by rebels, Wang Wei feigns illness and writes loyal verse

title.zh: 青年杜甫壮游齐鲁仰望东岳，豪吟《望岳》“会当凌绝顶，一览众山小”
title.en: Young Du Fu travels Shandong and composes Gazing on Mount Tai, vowing to scale its highest peak

title.zh: 李白与杜甫于洛阳初次相遇，偕高适同游梁宋猎酒赋诗
title.en: Li Bai and Du Fu meet for the first time in Luoyang and travel across Henan with Gao Shi

title.zh: 杜甫困守长安十年，赴奉先探亲闻幼子饿死作咏怀长诗
title.en: After ten poor years in Chang'an, Du Fu journeys to Fengxian and laments pre-rebellion inequality

title.zh: 杜甫避乱越秦岭入蜀，得严武等资助于成都西郊浣花溪畔营建草堂
title.en: Refugeeing across the Qinling Mountains into Sichuan, Du Fu builds his Chengdu Thatched Cottage

title.zh: 杜甫寓居夔州两年诗兴大发，秋日登高赋千古七律《登高》
title.en: Living at Kuizhou above the Three Gorges, aging Du Fu composes his autumn masterpiece Climbing High

title.zh: 杜甫出峡登岳阳楼凭轩涕泗，暮年漂泊湘江病逝舟中
title.en: Sailing past Yueyang Tower out of the gorges, Du Fu spends his final days drifting on the Xiang River

title.zh: 朔方节度使郭子仪与李光弼率五万精兵赴灵武勤王辅佐唐肃宗即位
title.en: General Guo Ziyi marches from Shuofang to Lingwu to rally Tang armies around Emperor Suzong

title.zh: 郭子仪统唐军与回纥援骑血战长安城南香积寺斩首六万
title.en: Guo Ziyi wins a fierce battle south of Chang'an at Xiangji Temple, retaking both Tang capitals

title.zh: 仆固怀恩引回纥逼京，郭子仪免胄单骑见虏说服回纥退兵
title.en: Aged nearly seventy, Guo Ziyi rides unarmored alone into the Uyghur camp at Jingyang to win peace

title.zh: 安禄山叛军南下河北瓦解，平原太守颜真卿首举义旗传檄讨贼
title.en: Prefect Yan Zhenqing raises the loyalist banner at Pingyuan, rallying seventeen Hebei commanderies

title.zh: 颜真卿寻得殉国侄颜季明遗骸，悲愤挥毫草《祭侄文稿》
title.en: Mourning his martyred nephew, Yan Zhenqing brushes the immortal Draft of a Requiem to My Nephew

title.zh: 七十七岁的太师颜真卿奉命孤身赴蔡州宣慰叛将李希烈，囚禁逾年凛然不屈
title.en: Seventy-seven-year-old elder statesman Yan Zhenqing defies warlord Li Xilie at Caizhou unto death

title.zh: 韩愈任行军司马随宰相裴度督师淮西，李愬雪夜入蔡州擒吴元济
title.en: Serving under Pei Du, Han Yu witnesses the snow-night capture of Caizhou and writes its stele

title.zh: 韩愈谏迎佛骨贬潮州，过蓝田关赋“云横秦岭家何在”
title.en: Exiled to Chaozhou over the Buddha-bone memorial, Han Yu crosses snowy Lantian Pass in verse

title.zh: 盩厔县尉白居易感玄宗贵妃往事，作长诗《长恨歌》传诵京师
title.en: Young magistrate Bai Juyi composes the narrative poem Song of Everlasting Regret west of Chang’an

title.zh: 江州司马白居易秋夜浔阳江头闻琵琶，作长诗《琵琶行》
title.en: Exiled to Jiangzhou on the Yangtze, Bai Juyi hears a former capital lute player and writes Pipa Song

title.zh: 白居易任杭州刺史主持疏浚西湖、修筑石函蓄水灌田千顷
title.en: As Prefect of Hangzhou, Bai Juyi dredges West Lake and builds causeways irrigating vast farmland

title.zh: 白居易晚年定居洛阳履道里，重修龙门香山寺自号“香山居士”
title.en: Retiring in Luoyang, Bai Juyi takes the name Layman of Xiangshan by Longmen Fragrant Mountain

title.zh: 永贞革新败后柳宗元贬永州司马十年，作《永州八记》
title.en: After the Yongzhen Reform fails, Liu Zongyuan spends ten years in Yongzhou writing Eight Records

title.zh: 柳宗元出任柳州刺史，颁令赎免童奴、凿井种柑兴办州学，病逝任所
title.en: Appointed Prefect of Liuzhou, Liu Zongyuan frees debt slaves, digs wells, and plants orchards

title.zh: 刘禹锡坐永贞革新贬朗州司马十年
title.en: Exiled for ten years to Langzhou, poet Liu Yuxi adapts folk songs into Bamboo Branch Lyrics

title.zh: 和州刺史刘禹锡居斗室泰然处之，撰铭《陋室铭》传世
title.en: As Prefect of Hezhou, Liu Yuxi writes Inscription on My Humble Room celebrating inner virtue

title.zh: 刘禹锡扬州席上酬白居易，赋“沉舟侧畔千帆过，病树前头万木春”
title.en: Meeting Bai Juyi in Yangzhou, Liu Yuxi writes “Past the sunken boat a thousand sails speed by”

title.zh: 高平之战：赵匡胤身先士卒稳住后周阵脚，反击大破北汉军
title.en: Battle of Gaoping: Guard commander Zhao Kuangyin rallies Later Zhou lines to crush Northern Han

title.zh: 曹彬奉赵匡胤命克金陵勿伤生灵，南唐后主李煜出降
title.en: Song forces under Cao Bin capture Jinling sparing civilians; Southern Tang ruler Li Yu surrenders

title.zh: 西夏元昊大举犯边，范仲淹自请知延州筑大顺城固防
title.en: Guarding frontier Yan'an against Western Xia, Fan Zhongyan fortifies forts and writes autumn ci

title.zh: 参知政事范仲淹联富弼、欧阳修上《答手诏条陈十事》推行“庆历新政”
title.en: Vice Chancellor Fan Zhongyan, joined by Ouyang Xiu, launches the ten-point Qingli New Policies

title.zh: 范仲淹贬邓州作《岳阳楼记》，铸就“先天下之忧而忧”名篇
title.en: In Dengzhou, Fan Zhongyan writes Memorial to Yueyang Tower: “Worry before the world worries”

title.zh: 欧阳修左迁知滁州宽简治民，作《醉翁亭记》与民同乐
title.en: Prefect Ouyang Xiu governs Chuzhou lightly and writes Pavilion of the Old Drunkard on Mt. Langya

title.zh: 欧阳修主考嘉祐贡举革正文风，一榜擢苏轼苏辙曾巩诸贤
title.en: Chief examiner Ouyang Xiu reforms prose style in Kaifeng, passing Su Shi, Su Zhe, and Zeng Gong

title.zh: 二十七岁的王安石知鄞县，亲自踏勘浚湖筑堤、青黄不接贷官谷于民
title.en: Young magistrate Wang Anshi dredges lakes and pioneers low-interest grain loans in Ningbo

title.zh: 王安石二度罢相退居江宁钟山半山园，骑驴游山吟咏绝句
title.en: Retiring twice from office to Banshan Garden in Nanjing, Wang Anshi roams Bell Mountain writing verse

title.zh: 司马光退居洛阳独乐园十五载，主编成《资治通鉴》二百九十四卷
title.en: After fifteen years at Luoyang's Garden of Solitary Joy, Sima Guang completes the Zizhi Tongjian

title.zh: 李清照与夫赵明诚屏居青州十年搜集金石书画盈十余屋
title.en: Poet Li Qingzhao and husband Zhao Mingcheng spend ten peaceful years in Qingzhou cataloguing bronzes

title.zh: 靖康乱后李清照南渡过乌江，赋“生当作人杰，死亦为鬼雄”
title.en: Crossing south past Wujiang, Li Qingzhao writes “In life be a hero,” chiding the fleeing court

title.zh: 李清照避金兵流寓婺州金华，登八咏楼浩叹“江山留与后人愁”
title.en: Refugeeing in Jinhua, widowed Li Qingzhao climbs Bayong Tower lamenting lost northern rivers

title.zh: 建康牛头山之战：岳飞设伏夜袭大破金兀术，收复建康
title.en: Yue Fei ambushes Jin commander Wuzhu at Mt. Niutou and retakes Jiankang, steadying Southern Song

title.zh: 年三十二岁的岳飞首次北伐两月连克襄阳、信阳等荆襄六郡
title.en: Aged thirty-two, Yue Fei recaptures the six commanderies around Xiangyang in his first northern push

title.zh: 二十三岁的辛弃疾率五十骑夜突金军五万大营生擒叛徒张安国
title.en: Twenty-three-year-old Xin Qiji leads fifty horsemen into a 50,000-man Jin camp to seize a traitor

title.zh: 辛弃疾与思想家陈亮于江西铅山鹅湖十日纵论恢复大略
title.en: Xin Qiji and Chen Liang meet for ten days at Goose Lake in Jiangxi planning northern recovery

title.zh: 辛弃疾知镇江府整军备战，登北固亭赋《永遇乐·京口北固亭怀古》
title.en: Sixty-six-year-old Xin Qiji gazes north from Beigu Pavilion in Zhenjiang composing Yongyule

title.zh: 陆游应四川宣抚使王炎幕亲临汉中南郑抗金前线射虎观兵
title.en: Poet Lu You serves on the Hanzhong frontier against Jin before riding south through Sword Gate Pass

title.zh: 八十六岁的陆游病逝山阴故里，遗绝笔《示儿》盼王师北定中原
title.en: Dying at eighty-six in Shaoxing, patriot poet Lu You leaves his final testament poem To My Sons

title.zh: 元军渡江临安危急，赣州知州文天祥散尽家财募义军勤王
title.en: As Yuan armies cross the Yangtze, prefect Wen Tianxiang sells his estate in Ganzhou to raise troops

title.zh: 文天祥潮阳兵败被执，过零丁洋赋“留取丹心照汗青”
title.en: Captive crossing Lingdingyang Sea, Wen Tianxiang writes Let my loyal heart shine in history

title.zh: 文天祥囚元大都土室四年作《正气歌》，于柴市口南向再拜从容就义
title.en: Wen Tianxiang composes Song of Righteousness in prison and goes to his death calmly at Dadu Execution Ground

title.zh: 铁木真统一蒙古高原诸部，于斡难河源召开忽里勒台大会建大蒙古国
title.en: Temujin unites the Mongol tribes at an Onon River kurultai and takes the title Genghis Khan

title.zh: 野狐岭之战：成吉思汗集中铁骑冲阵，歼灭金军四十万主力
title.en: Battle of Yehuling: Genghis Khan smashes a 400,000-man Jin army north of Zhangjiakou Pass

title.zh: 成吉思汗东征西夏围困中兴府，盛夏避暑于六盘山病逝
title.en: Genghis Khan dies at Mount Liupan during his final campaign crushing the Western Xia Kingdom

title.zh: 忽必烈率蒙古大军自临洮革囊渡金沙江，千里奇袭攻灭大理国
title.en: Kublai Khan crosses the Jinsha River on inflated sheepskin rafts to conquer Dali in Yunnan

title.zh: 襄阳之战：忽必烈调回回炮攻破坚守六年的襄樊，长江门户洞开
title.en: After a six-year siege Kublai Khan uses counterweight trebuchets to breach Fancheng and Xiangyang

title.zh: 濠州红巾将朱元璋渡长江攻克元集庆路改名应天府
title.en: Rebel commander Zhu Yuanzhang captures Nanjing across the Yangtze and makes Yingtian his base

title.zh: 鄱阳湖水战：朱元璋率二十万水军火攻决战三十六日，击毙汉主陈友谅
title.en: Battle of Lake Poyang: Zhu Yuanzhang uses fire ships over 36 days to defeat rival Chen Youliang

title.zh: 明成祖命郑和率巨型宝船队自太仓刘家港扬帆首下西洋
title.en: Admiral Zheng He sets sail from Liujiagang with 27,000 men aboard treasure ships on his first voyage

title.zh: 郑和船队立满剌加官厂中转，于锡兰山立三体文字碑
title.en: Zheng He builds a maritime depot at Malacca and erects the trilingual Galle Stele in Sri Lanka

title.zh: 六十五岁的明成祖朱棣第五次亲征漠北阿鲁台班师途中，病逝于塞外榆木川
title.en: Returning from his fifth expedition across the Gobi Steppe, Yongle Emperor Zhu Di dies at Yumuchuan

title.zh: 六十二岁的三宝太监郑和第七次下西洋途中病逝于印度西海岸古里
title.en: On his seventh voyage Admiral Zheng He dies at Calicut on the Malabar Coast of India aged 62

title.zh: 北京保卫战：兵部尚书于谦拥立景泰帝，德胜门外大破瓦剌军
title.en: Defense of Beijing: War Minister Yu Qian enthrones Jingtai and routs Oirat cavalry at Deshengmen

title.zh: 参将戚继光练义乌矿徒成“戚家军”创鸳鸯阵
title.en: General Qi Jiguang trains Yiwu miners into his Mandarin-Duck Formation army, winning nine battles

title.zh: 戚继光与俞大猷会师福建攻克平海卫倭巢斩首二千余
title.en: Qi Jiguang and Yu Dayou storm the pirate stronghold at Putian, restoring peace to Fujian coasts

title.zh: 戚继光镇守蓟镇北方十六年，增筑空心敌台重修明长城
title.en: Guarding the northern frontier sixteen years, Qi Jiguang builds hollow watchtowers along the Wall

title.zh: 内阁首辅张居正辅十岁万历帝颁行“考成法”综核名实
title.en: Grand Secretary Zhang Juzheng enacts strict administrative audits under the young Wanli Emperor

title.zh: 张居正清丈全国田亩七百万顷，全面推行“一条鞭法”赋役改革
title.en: After a nationwide land survey, Zhang Juzheng enacts the Single Whip tax reform in silver

title.zh: 延平王郑成功统十余万水陆大军自厦门北伐溯长江而上
title.en: Zheng Chenggong leads a massive fleet up the Yangtze, capturing Zhenjiang and besieging Nanjing

title.zh: 十六岁的少年康熙帝玄烨训练布库侍卫，于武英殿迅雷智擒专权辅臣鳌拜
title.en: Sixteen-year-old Kangxi Emperor Xuanye uses palace wrestlers to arrest overbearing regent Oboi

title.zh: 康熙帝亲征朔漠，昭莫多之战清军火器大破准噶尔噶尔丹主力
title.en: Battle of Jao Modo: Kangxi leads Qing forces across the Gobi to crush Zunghar khan Galdan

title.zh: 钦差大臣林则徐于广东虎门海滩当众销毁鸦片二百三十七万斤
title.en: Imperial Commissioner Lin Zexu destroys over 20,000 chests of opium in lime pits at Humen Beach

title.zh: 林则徐遭革职“从重发往伊犁效力赎罪”，途经西安赠魏源《四洲志》
title.en: Exiled to Yili after the Opium War, Lin Zexu builds irrigation canals and warns of border threats

title.zh: 曾国藩于湖南衡州创办湘军水陆师颁《讨粤匪檄》
title.en: Zeng Guofan organizes the regional Xiang Army and flotilla at Hengyang, retaking Wuchang and Hanyang

title.zh: 曾国藩、曾国荃围攻数年攻克太平军长江咽喉安庆
title.en: Capturing strategic Anqing on the Yangtze, Zeng Guofan founds China's first modern ordnance works

title.zh: 闽浙总督左宗棠奏设福州船政局与求是堂艺局（船政学堂）
title.en: Viceroy Zuo Zongtang founds the Fuzhou Navy Yard and Academy at Mawei, cradle of modern Chinese sea power

title.zh: 左宗棠督师南征克复喀什噶尔，天山南北除伊犁外尽数收复
title.en: Under Zuo Zongtang's command, Qing forces retake Kashgar, recovering all Xinjiang save Ili

title.zh: 孙中山返广州策划兴中会首次武装反清起义，陆皓东殉难
title.en: Sun Yat-sen launches the first armed Guangzhou Uprising of the Revive China Society

title.zh: 辛亥革命武昌起义：湖北新军工程营打响第一枪光复武汉三镇
title.en: Wuchang Uprising: New Army engineers seize Wuchang sparking nationwide provincial secessions

title.zh: 孙中山扶病北上主张召开国民会议废除不平等条约
title.en: Traveling north for national reunification talks, Sun Yat-sen dies in Beijing leaving his Will

title.zh: 毛泽东领导湘赣边界秋收起义，三湾改编确立党对军队领导
title.en: Following the Autumn Harvest Uprising, Mao Zedong leads forces into the Jinggang Mountains

title.zh: 中央红军长征突破乌江占领遵义，召开遵义会议确立毛泽东领导地位
title.en: During the Long March, the Zunyi Conference establishes Mao Zedong’s leadership of the Red Army

title.zh: 毛泽东于延安窑洞著《论持久战》，系统阐明抗日战略三阶段
title.en: In Yan'an cave dwellings, Mao Zedong writes On Protracted War outlining China's strategy

title.zh: 毛泽东与中共中央在太行山麓西柏坡运筹指挥辽沈、淮海、平津三大战役
title.en: From Xibaipo headquarters Mao Zedong directs the Liaoshen, Huaihai, and Pingjin campaigns

title.zh: 司马迁生于黄河龙门之阳，早年耕牧诵读承父太史遗志
title.en: Sima Qian is born at Longmen overlooking the Yellow River in Shaanxi

title.zh: 汉武帝东巡封禅泰山，司马谈滞留周南临终执司马迁手托付修史大业
title.en: As Emperor Wu ascends Mount Tai, dying Sima Tan charges his son Sima Qian to complete his history

title.zh: 偏将军陆逊屯驻陆口致书骄矜关羽以麻痹其防备
title.en: Young commander Lu Xun lulls Guan Yu with humble letters from Lukou before seizing Jingzhou

title.zh: 陆逊出任东吴丞相辅佐孙权，直言谏阻两宫太子废立之争，次年愤懑卒于建业
title.en: Appointed Chancellor of Eastern Wu in Nanjing, Lu Xun remonstrates over the succession dispute

title.zh: 王羲之随琅琊王氏衣冠南渡居建康乌衣巷，少学书博采众长
title.en: Migrating south with the aristocratic Wang clan of Langya, young Wang Xizhi masters calligraphy

title.zh: 王羲之誓墓辞官退居剡县金庭，遍游浙东山水安度晚年
title.en: Swearing at his parents’ tomb never to serve again, Wang Xizhi retires among Zhejiang hills

title.zh: 陶渊明归隐庐山栗里躬耕垄亩，赋“采菊东篱下，悠然见南山”
title.en: Tao Yuanming farms beneath Mount Lu, writing Picking chrysanthemums by the eastern hedge

title.zh: 少年司马光于庭院击破大瓮救出溺水幼童，“司马光砸缸”机智沉着传为美谈
title.en: Young Sima Guang smashes a giant water vat with a stone to save a drowning playmate in Shanxi

title.zh: 翰林学士司马光与故友王安石三致长书激辩青苗新法利弊
title.en: Sima Guang exchanges three famous letters with friend Wang Anshi debating fiscal reforms

title.zh: 陆游春日重游绍兴沈园偶遇唐琬，题词《钗头凤》凄婉千古
title.en: Revisiting Shen Garden in Shaoxing, Lu You meets former wife Tang Wan and brushes Phoenix Hairpin

title.zh: 陆游权知嘉州、通判蜀州纵览巴蜀奇山异水，诗风雄放自号“放翁”
title.en: Serving across western Sichuan, Lu You embraces a bold poetic style and takes the name Fangweng

title.zh: 张居正生于湖广江陵，十二岁考中秀才荆州知府李士翱奇之赐名“居正”
title.en: Child prodigy Zhang Juzheng passes the prefectural exam at twelve in his native Jiangling

title.zh: 首辅张居正病逝归葬江陵，两年后遭清算抄家削谥
title.en: Buried in Jiangling, Zhang Juzheng suffers posthumous impeachment as his reforms begin to unravel

title.zh: 父郑芝龙降清后，二十三岁的郑成功于南安孔庙焚烧儒服痛哭拜辞
title.en: After his father submits to Qing, young Zheng Chenggong burns his scholar robes and raises a fleet

title.zh: 郑成功夺取厦门与金门并改厦门为“思明州”，整编五军水师与东西洋通商
title.en: Zheng Chenggong bases his naval command at Xiamen, renaming it Siming Prefecture for overseas trade

title.zh: 陈胜率起义军攻克楚故都陈县自立为王，国号“张楚”
title.en: Chen Sheng captures ancient Chu capital Chenxian and proclaims the Kingdom of Rising Chu

title.zh: 秦将章邯大破张楚西进军，陈胜退至下城父遭车夫庄贾背叛遇害，葬砀山
title.en: Hard-pressed by Qin general Zhang Han, rebel king Chen Sheng is slain by his driver at Chengfu

title.zh: 司徒王允设连环计策反中郎将吕布，于未央宫掖门诛杀专权乱政之董卓
title.en: Minister Wang Yun persuades warrior Lü Bu to slay tyrant Dong Zhuo at Weiyang Palace in Chang'an

title.zh: 辕门射戟：吕布百五十步外射中戟支，化解纪灵攻刘备之围
title.en: Shooting the Halberd at Camp Gate: Lü Bu hits a halberd prong from 150 paces to save Liu Bei

title.zh: 界桥之战：袁绍命麴义以八百先登强弩大破公孙瓒白马义从
title.en: Battle of Jieqiao: Yuan Shao's crossbowmen crush Gongsun Zan's cavalry, winning control of Hebei

title.zh: 袁绍掘地道攻破公孙瓒易京铁楼，尽并幽冀青并四州带甲百万
title.en: Yuan Shao storms Gongsun Zan's fortress at Yijing, uniting the four northern provinces of Han

title.zh: 汉水之战：赵云救黄忠后大开营门偃旗息鼓，退曹操追兵
title.en: Zhao Yun flings wide his camp gates by the Han River in an empty-camp bluff against Cao Cao's host

title.zh: 年近六旬的镇东将军赵云与邓芝设疑兵据箕谷牵制曹真主力
title.en: Sixty-year-old veteran Zhao Yun holds Jigu Valley as decoy force and retreats in intact order

title.zh: 洮西之战：姜维背水列阵大破曹魏雍州刺史王经斩首数万
title.en: Battle of Taoxi: Shu general Jiang Wei wins a major victory routing Wei governor Wang Jing

title.zh: 征西将军邓艾率精兵自阴平无人之地裹毡滚崖七百里奇袭江油
title.en: Wei general Deng Ai wraps soldiers in felt to roll down sheer cliffs along Yinping Trail

title.zh: 兖州刺史谢玄于广陵京口募北方流民劲卒组建“北府兵”
title.en: Xie Xuan recruits northern refugees at Guangling and Jingkou to forge the elite Northern Garrison

title.zh: 淝水大捷后谢玄乘胜北伐，收复兖青司豫四州及洛阳诸陵
title.en: Pressing his Fei River triumph, Xie Xuan marches north to recover Henan, Shandong, and Luoyang

title.zh: 黄巢转战岭南攻占广州，旋自桂州编筏沿湘江北进荆襄
title.en: Rebel commander Huang Chao captures Guangzhou in the far south before rafting north into Hubei

title.zh: 大将军徐达与常遇春北伐攻克元大都，改置北平府
title.en: Ming generals Xu Da and Chang Yuchun capture Yuan capital Dadu and rename it Beiping Prefecture

title.zh: 努尔哈赤攻宁远受挫，同年八月病逝于沈阳近郊叆鸡堡
title.en: Repulsed at Ningyuan, Nurhaci dies that August near Mukden (Shenyang)

title.zh: 松锦大战：皇太极围点打援生擒明督师洪承畴与大将祖大寿
title.en: Battle of Song-Jin: Hong Taiji crushes the last Ming field armies outside Shanhaiguan Pass

title.zh: 雍正帝重用鄂尔泰于西南大规模推行“改土归流”
title.en: Yongzheng Emperor empowers Ortai to replace hereditary chieftains with regular prefectures

title.zh: 洪秀全统太平军顺长江东下攻占江宁改名“天京”定为都城
title.en: Hong Xiuquan captures Nanjing, renames it Heavenly Capital Tianjing, and proclaims land reform

title.zh: 洪秀全在曾国荃湘军合围断粮中病逝，月余湘军轰塌城墙攻陷天京
title.en: Hong Xiuquan dies during the siege of Nanjing shortly before Hunan Army sappers breach the walls

title.zh: 刘邦赞张良“运筹帷帐之中，决胜千里之外”，封为留侯
title.en: Liu Bang praises Zhang Liang for winning battles a thousand li away and enfeoffs him at Liu

title.zh: 东吴大都督周瑜西取巴蜀途中病逝巴丘，临终荐鲁肃自代
title.en: Eastern Wu commander Zhou Yu dies aged 36 at Baqiu on the march to Shu, recommending Lu Su

title.zh: 邓艾著《济河论》，主持淮南屯田开广漕渠，积粮平吴灭蜀
title.en: Deng Ai authors On Canal Irrigation and builds vast military-farm colonies across Huainan

title.zh: 桓温第三次北伐前燕进抵枋头，遭慕容垂断粮大败而还
title.en: Huan Wen leads 50,000 Jin troops north to Fangtou, where Murong Chui cuts his supply lines

title.zh: 己巳之变：皇太极绕道破喜峰口逼北京，袁崇焕驰援广渠门
title.en: Jisi Incident: Hong Taiji bypasses Shanhaiguan to besiege Beijing; Yuan Chonghuan defends the gates

title.zh: 安禄山据洛阳称燕帝后双目失明，正月为子安庆绪夜袭所弑
title.en: Blind and tyrannical in Luoyang, Yan emperor An Lushan is assassinated at night by his son

title.zh: 南唐太子李煜于金陵嗣位，词章书画名冠五代十国
title.en: Li Yu ascends the Southern Tang throne in Jinling, presiding over a refined court of poetry and art

title.zh: 七夕之夜李煜于汴京歌《虞美人》追怀故国，旋卒于开封
title.en: Captive in Kaifeng on Qixi night, Li Yu composes his immortal lyric Yu Meiren before his death

title.zh: 秦将章邯破张楚军，陈胜退至下城父遇害，葬于芒砀山
title.en: Defeated by Qin general Zhang Han, rebel king Chen Sheng is betrayed at Xiachengfu

title.zh: 于谦巡抚河南山西十九载，平反冤狱赈济灾黎，赋诗“两袖清风”
title.en: Yu Qian governs Henan and Shanxi nineteen years with incorruptible integrity and famine relief

title.zh: 北京保卫战：于谦亲督二十二万军背城血战，于德胜门大破瓦剌也先
title.en: Defense of Beijing: Yu Qian rallies 220,000 troops outside Desheng Gate to rout Esen's host

title.zh: 林则徐任云贵总督平定滇西纷争整顿边防，旋奉诏督师卒于普宁
title.en: Appointed Viceroy of Yun-Gui in Kunming, Lin Zexu pacifies frontier unrest and strengthens defenses

title.zh: 孟子游魏都大梁见梁惠王，首倡“何必曰利，亦有仁义而已矣”
title.en: Mencius visits King Hui of Liang in Daliang, advocating benevolent governance over narrow profit

title.zh: 孟子适齐任客卿游学稷下学宫，向齐宣王系统阐述王道与民本思想
title.en: Serving as senior scholar at Linzi's Jixia Academy, Mencius expounds humane kingship to King Xuan

title.zh: 孟子去齐返故里邹邑讲学终老，与万章诸弟子编撰《孟子》七篇
title.en: Returning home to Zou, Mencius teaches disciples and compiles the seven-book classic Mencius

title.zh: 曹操任丞相辟河内司马懿为文学掾，随幕府参赞军谋
title.en: Chancellor Cao Cao summons Sima Yi of Henei to Ye as literary clerk and military advisor

site.zh: 邺城丞相府（今河北临漳）

title.zh: 合肥之战：张辽率八百勇士冲阵大破孙权十万军，威震逍遥津
title.en: Battle of Hefei: Zhang Liao leads 800 vanguard riders to rout Sun Quan's army at Xiaoyao Ford

site.zh: 合肥逍遥津（今安徽合肥）

title.zh: 司马懿自宛城八日急行千二百里，奇袭上庸新城斩叛将孟达
title.en: Sima Yi marches 1,200 li from Wan in eight days, storming Xincheng to capture rebel Meng Da

title.zh: 东吴四路攻魏，太尉司马懿亲率轻骑疾驰南下解樊城之围
title.en: Grand Commandant Sima Yi leads light cavalry south to relieve besieged Fancheng from Wu forces

title.zh: 祖冲之于建康推算圆周率至小数点后七位，创制《大明历》
title.en: Zu Chongzhi calculates pi to seven decimal places in Jiankang and compiles the Daming Calendar

title.zh: 高阳太守贾思勰总结北方农牧经验，撰成农学巨著《齐民要术》
title.en: Governor Jia Sixie compiles Qimin Yaoshu in Shandong, the earliest intact Chinese agronomy manual

title.zh: 侯景攻陷建康台城，八十六岁的梁武帝萧衍饥病交加饿死台城
title.en: Rebel general Hou Jing storms Jiankang Palace, where aged Emperor Wu of Liang starves to death

title.zh: 邙山之战兰陵王高长恭率五百骑破周军解围，军中作《兰陵王入阵曲》
title.en: Prince of Lanling Gao Changgong breaks the siege of Luoyang with 500 riders, inspiring a battle hymn

site.zh: 洛阳金墉城（今河南洛阳）

title.zh: 瓦岗军翟让、李密攻克兴洛仓开仓赈粮，秦叔宝程咬金归附
title.en: Wagang rebels Zhai Rang and Li Mi seize Luokou Granary to feed the poor as heroes rally to their banner

site.zh: 荥阳洛口仓（今河南郑州巩义）

title.zh: 薛仁贵北征九姓铁勒“三箭定天山”，军中传唱长歌入汉关
title.en: Xue Rengui fells three Tiele chieftains with three arrows, pacifying the northern steppe frontier

site.zh: 天山·金山（今阿尔泰山南麓）

title.zh: 王勃省亲过洪州登滕王阁，即席挥毫赋千古骈文《滕王阁序》
title.en: Young poet Wang Bo composes the immortal Preface to the Pavilion of Prince Teng at Nanchang banquet

site.zh: 洪州滕王阁（今江西南昌）

title.zh: 布衣毕昇于汴京发明胶泥活字印刷术，载入沈括《梦溪笔谈》
title.en: Artisan Bi Sheng invents ceramic movable-type printing in Kaifeng, recorded in Dream Pool Essays

title.zh: 包拯拜枢密副使，立朝刚毅，贵戚宦官为之敛手
title.en: Bao Zheng is named Vice Commissioner of Military Affairs; nobles and eunuchs dread his rigor

site.zh: 东京开封府（今河南开封）

title.zh: 沈括晚年退居润州梦溪园，撰成科学笔记巨著《梦溪笔谈》
title.en: Polymath Shen Kuo retires to Mengxi Garden in Zhenjiang to complete his scientific classic Dream Pool Essays

site.zh: 润州梦溪园（今江苏镇江）

title.zh: 宋江等三十六人于河朔京东起义横行十郡，成《水浒传》原型
title.en: Song Jiang and thirty-six outlaws rise around Liangshan Marsh, inspiring the classic Water Margin

site.zh: 梁山泊（今山东济宁梁山）

title.zh: 二十岁的农家子岳飞自相州汤阴应募从军，母勉以尽忠报国
title.en: Twenty-year-old Yue Fei enlists in the army from his hometown Tangyin, vowed to loyal service

site.zh: 相州汤阴（今河南安阳汤阴）

title.zh: 岳飞奉诏平定吉虔盗乱，力谏高宗勿屠虔州保全全城百姓
title.en: After pacifying rebels in Ganzhou, Yue Fei pleads with Emperor Gaozong to spare all townspeople

title.zh: 岳飞自鄂州孤军北伐连克伊阳商州，愤孤军无援矢志收复河山
title.en: Yue Fei launches a northern counteroffensive from Ezhou, retaking Shangzhou on the Qinling frontier

title.zh: 李时珍历二十七载三易其稿，于蕲州撰成药物学巨著《本草纲目》
title.en: Physician Li Shizhen completes Compendium of Materia Medica in Qizhou after twenty-seven years of work

title.zh: 崇祯帝中皇太极反间计，于北京西市磔杀督师袁崇焕自毁长城
title.en: Deceived by Hong Taiji's ruse, the Chongzhen Emperor executes commander Yuan Chonghuan in Beijing

title.zh: 曹雪芹于北京西山贫病交加中逝世，遗千古文学巅峰《红楼梦》
title.en: Cao Xueqin dies in poverty in the Western Hills of Beijing, leaving behind Dream of the Red Chamber

title.zh: 四十岁的湘阴举人左宗棠出山入幕长沙，运筹死守孤城退太平军
title.en: At forty, Zuo Zongtang joins the defense staff at Changsha, successfully holding off Taiping forces

title.zh: 太平天国翼王石达开抢渡大渡河遇山洪绝境，舍生保部众就义
title.en: Trapped by flash floods along the Dadu River, Taiping Prince Shi Dakai surrenders himself to save his men

site.zh: 大渡河安顺场（今四川雅安石棉）

title.zh: 闽浙总督左宗棠率楚军收复杭州平定浙江，兴修水利恢复蚕桑
title.en: Viceroy Zuo Zongtang retakes Hangzhou with the Chu Army and restores Zhejiang dikes and sericulture

title.zh: 陕甘总督左宗棠攻克肃州肃清关内，沿驿道绵延千里广植左公柳
title.en: Viceroy Zuo Zongtang captures Jiuquan and plants thousands of li of roadside willows across Gansu

title.zh: 六十八岁的左宗棠再舁榇进驻哈密备战，助曾纪泽争回伊犁九城
title.en: Aged sixty-eight, Zuo Zongtang marches with his coffin to Hami, backing diplomatic recovery of Ili

title.zh: 七十三岁的左宗棠抱病督师福建抗法，中法议和后病逝福州行辕
title.en: Aged seventy-three, Zuo Zongtang oversees coastal defense in Fujian against France and dies in Fuzhou

site.zh: 福州钦差行辕（今福建福州）

title.zh: 道士王圆箓于莫高窟偶然发现藏经洞，五万件中古遗书重见天日
title.en: Taoist Wang Yuanlu uncovers the Library Cave at Mogao, revealing 50,000 medieval manuscripts

site.zh: 敦煌莫高窟（今甘肃敦煌）

title.zh: 詹天佑主持建成中国人自建首条干线京张铁路，创八达岭人字形线
title.en: Chief engineer Zhan Tianyou completes the self-built Beijing-Zhangjiakou Railway with switchback tracks

site.zh: 八达岭青龙桥（今北京延庆）

title.zh: 黄兴率同盟会敢死队猛攻两广总督署，七十二烈士合葬广州黄花岗
title.en: Huang Xing leads revolutionaries storming the Viceroy Yamen in Guangzhou; 72 martyrs rest at Huanghuagang

site.zh: 广州黄花岗（今广东广州）

title.zh: 蔺相如完璧归赵、渑池会挫秦王，老将廉颇肉袒负荆请罪成将相和
title.en: Lin Xiangru outwits Qin at Mianchi; general Lian Po bears thorns on his back to reconcile in Handan

site.zh: 邯郸回车巷（今河北邯郸）

title.zh: 燕太子丹于易水白衣送别荆轲，高渐离击筑歌“风萧萧兮易水寒”
title.en: Crown Prince Dan of Yan bids farewell to assassin Jing Ke by the icy Yi River as music echoes

site.zh: 易水岸（今河北保定易县）

title.zh: 霍去病夏越居延海深入二千里，大破祁连山受浑邪王四万众降
title.en: Huo Qubing marches 2,000 li past Juyan Lake to rout Xiongnu at Mt. Qilian and accept surrender

title.zh: 二十四岁的冠军侯霍去病病逝长安，武帝筑祁连山冢陪葬茂陵
title.en: Young general Huo Qubing dies at twenty-four; Emperor Wu builds a Qilian-shaped mound beside Maoling

title.zh: 中郎将苏武出使匈奴被扣，持汉节牧羊北海十九载白发归汉
title.en: Han envoy Su Wu is detained by Xiongnu and tends sheep by Lake Baikal for nineteen years unbroken

title.zh: 兰台令史班固历二十余载撰成中国第一部纪传体断代史《汉书》
title.en: Court historian Ban Gu completes the Book of Han in Luoyang, inaugurating dynastic history writing

title.zh: 经学家许慎博采篆文古籀，撰成世界首部系统字书《说文解字》
title.en: Scholar Xu Shen compiles Analytical Dictionary of Characters, the foundational lexicon of Chinese script

title.zh: 南阳名医张仲景总结汉代临床方证，撰成“医圣”经典《伤寒杂病论》
title.en: Master physician Zhang Zhongjing of Nanyang compiles Treatise on Cold Damage and Miscellaneous Diseases

title.zh: 卫尉石崇于洛阳金谷涧筑园雅集二十四友，与王恺斗富传世
title.en: Magnate Shi Chong hosts literati at Golden Valley Garden in Luoyang, vying in lavish wealth

site.zh: 洛阳金谷园（今河南洛阳）

title.zh: 江东才子陆机兵败遇害，临终浩叹“华亭鹤唳，岂可复闻乎”
title.en: Poet-general Lu Ji laments never again hearing the cranes of Huating in Songjiang before execution

title.zh: 南唐画家顾闳中奉李煜命夜窥韩府，绘成传世名画《韩熙载夜宴图》
title.en: Court painter Gu Hongzhong paints Night Revels of Han Xizai in Jinling for ruler Li Yu

title.zh: 宋师灭后蜀孟昶降，花蕊夫人赋“十四万人齐解甲，更无一个是男儿”
title.en: Later Shu surrenders to Song at Chengdu as Consort Huarui laments 140,000 troops laying down arms

title.zh: 二十二岁的辛弃疾于历城聚两千义军投耿京起兵抗金，掌书记印
title.en: Aged twenty-two, Xin Qiji raises two thousand volunteers in Jinan to join resistance against Jin

title.zh: 朱熹知南康军重兴庐山白鹿洞书院，手订《白鹿洞书院揭示》垂范学林
title.en: Neo-Confucian master Zhu Xi revives White Deer Grotto Academy at Mt. Lu and drafts academy rules

site.zh: 南康白鹿洞书院（今江西九江庐山）
site.en: White Deer Grotto Academy, Mt. Lu

title.zh: 辛弃疾知潭州兼湖南安抚使，创建精锐“飞虎军”雄镇荆湖
title.en: Governor Xin Qiji founds the elite Flying Tiger Army in Changsha, securing the middle Yangtze

title.zh: 提点刑狱宋慈总结检验经验，撰成世界首部法医学专著《洗冤集录》
title.en: Judicial commissioner Song Ci completes Collected Cases of Injustice Rectified, founding forensic medicine

site.zh: 潭州提刑司（今湖南长沙）

title.zh: 二十岁的文天祥于临安殿试对策万言，宋理宗亲拔为第一状元
title.en: Aged twenty, Wen Tianxiang tops the palace examination in Hangzhou as Imperially Ranked First Scholar

site.zh: 临安集英殿（今浙江杭州）

title.zh: 文天祥使元营慷慨抗辞被扣，押赴北上途中于京口乘夜脱险南归
title.en: Detained while parleying in the Yuan camp, Wen Tianxiang escapes under cover of night at Zhenjiang

title.zh: 元曲大家关汉卿于大都创作杂剧代表作《感天动地窦娥冤》流传千古
title.en: Playwright Guan Hanqing composes the masterpiece tragedy The Injustice to Dou E in Yuan Dadu

title.zh: 黄道婆归故里松江乌泥泾传授捍弹纺织新法，松江布遂“衣被天下”
title.en: Huang Daopo returns to Songjiang in Shanghai to innovate cotton spinning and weaving technology

site.zh: 松江乌泥泾（今上海徐汇华泾）

title.zh: 八十二岁的“元四家”之首黄公望结庐富春江，绘成旷世《富春山居图》
title.en: Aged eighty-two, master painter Huang Gongwang completes Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains scroll

site.zh: 富春江（今浙江杭州富阳）

title.zh: 杜甫困居叛军所陷长安赋《春望》“国破山河在”，夏潜奔凤翔
title.en: Trapped in rebel-held Chang'an, Du Fu writes “Spring View”, then escapes to Fengxiang

title.zh: 杜甫途经新安石壕作“三吏”“三别”，秋弃官携家客居秦州
title.en: Du Fu writes the “Three Officials” and “Three Partings”, then resigns and moves his family to Qinzhou

title.zh: 杜甫客居梓州闻官军收复河南河北，狂喜赋“便下襄阳向洛阳”
title.en: In Zizhou, Du Fu hears the imperial army has retaken Henan and Hebei and writes his most joyous poem

title.zh: 关羽斩颜良报曹，尽封所赐拜书告辞，北奔袁营寻故主
title.en: Having repaid Cao Cao by slaying Yan Liang, Guan Yu seals away Cao's gifts and leaves to rejoin Liu Bei

title.zh: 鲁肃邀关羽于益阳“单刀俱会”争荆州，旋孙刘以湘水为界
title.en: At Yiyang, Lu Su meets Guan Yu “each bearing only a sword”; Jing is then split along the Xiang River

title.zh: 张飞溯江破江州，生擒严颜，感其“断头将军”之节释为宾客
title.en: Zhang Fei captures Jiangzhou and its governor Yan Yan, then frees him, moved by his refusal to yield

title.zh: 张飞将率万人自阆中东伐孙吴，临发为帐下张达、范强所害
title.en: About to lead 10,000 troops from Langzhong against Wu, Zhang Fei is murdered by his own officers

title.zh: 周瑜率兵资粮迎孙策于历阳，助其渡江连克秣陵、曲阿
title.en: Zhou Yu brings troops and grain to Sun Ce at Liyang, helping him cross the Yangtze and take Moling and Qu'e

title.zh: 周瑜随孙策攻克皖城，孙策纳大乔、周瑜纳小乔
title.en: Zhou Yu and Sun Ce capture Wancheng; Sun Ce weds the elder Qiao sister and Zhou Yu the younger

title.zh: 张良匿居下邳，于圯桥为老父三度纳履，得授《太公兵法》
title.en: Hiding in Xiapi, Zhang Liang fetches an old man's shoe on a bridge and receives a book of strategy

title.zh: 张良送刘邦入汉中，劝烧绝所过栈道以示无东归之意
title.en: Seeing Liu Bang into Hanzhong, Zhang Liang urges him to burn the plank roads to reassure Xiang Yu

title.zh: 司马迁为降匈奴的李陵辩护获罪，受腐刑后发愤续撰《史记》
title.en: Sima Qian defends the defeated general Li Ling, suffers castration, and resolves to finish his history

title.zh: 韩愈贬潮州刺史作《祭鳄鱼文》、释奴兴学，潮人名山水曰韩山韩江
title.en: Exiled to Chaozhou, Han Yu writes “Address to the Crocodiles”; locals name the Han River after him

title.zh: 夔州刺史刘禹锡采巴渝民歌作《竹枝词》“东边日出西边雨”
title.en: As prefect of Kuizhou, Liu Yuxi turns Ba folk tunes into his “Bamboo Branch Songs”

title.zh: 李清照于汴京嫁赵明诚，夫妇典衣购碑、共治金石，词名初动京师
title.en: Li Qingzhao marries Zhao Mingcheng in Kaifeng; the couple pawn clothes to buy rubbings and antiquities

title.zh: 宁锦大捷：袁崇焕坐镇宁远、赵率教守锦州，击退皇太极
title.en: Ningyuan–Jinzhou victory: Yuan Chonghuan and Zhao Shuaijiao repel Hong Taiji's assault

title.zh: 十九岁的寇准进士及第知巴东，赋“野水无人渡，孤舟尽日横”
title.en: Newly a jinshi at nineteen, Kou Zhun governs Badong and writes “a lone boat drifts all day long”

title.zh: 中郎将苏武持汉节出使匈奴，护送扣留的匈奴使者北归
title.en: Palace general Su Wu sets out from Chang'an bearing the Han tally as envoy to the Xiongnu

title.zh: 苏武持节十九载白发归长安，拜典属国，汉节旄尽落
title.en: After nineteen years in captivity, a white-haired Su Wu returns to Chang'an, his envoy's tally bare

title.zh: 魏征投瓦岗军首领李密，任元帅府文学参军掌记室
title.en: Wei Zheng joins the Wagang rebel leader Li Mi at Luokou as his secretary

title.zh: 玄武门之变后李世民责问魏征，魏征从容直对，获擢为詹事主簿
title.en: After the Xuanwu Gate coup, Wei Zheng answers Li Shimin's rebuke with candor and is promoted

title.zh: 魏征病逝长安，唐太宗叹“以人为镜，可以明得失”，痛失一镜
title.en: Wei Zheng dies; Emperor Taizong mourns that he has lost the “mirror” that showed his faults

title.zh: 大理丞狄仁杰一年断决积案一万七千人，无一冤诉
title.en: As judge of the Court of Revision, Di Renjie clears 17,000 backlogged cases in a year without complaint

title.zh: 狄仁杰遭来俊臣诬陷下狱，以帛书申冤得免，贬彭泽令
title.en: Framed by Lai Junchen, Di Renjie smuggles out a plea on silk, escapes death and is demoted to Pengze

title.zh: 魏州刺史狄仁杰撤守归农安民，契丹闻风退去，百姓立生祠
title.en: Prefect Di Renjie calms Weizhou as the Khitans retreat; grateful locals build him a living shrine

title.zh: 狄仁杰卒于神都，生前荐张柬之、姚崇等，武则天叹“朝堂空矣”
title.en: Di Renjie dies in Luoyang after recommending Zhang Jianzhi; Empress Wu weeps that “the court is empty”

title.zh: 包拯知天长县，以“宰牛引告”之计智破割牛舌案
title.en: Magistrate Bao Zheng of Tianchang cleverly unmasks a culprit who cut out a farmer's ox tongue

title.zh: 包拯知端州，端砚岁贡之外不多取，任满“不持一砚归”
title.en: Governing Duanzhou, home of famed inkstones, Bao Zheng leaves office without taking a single one

title.zh: 秦下逐客令，李斯上《谏逐客书》“泰山不让土壤”，秦王收回成命
title.en: When Qin expels foreign advisers, Li Si's memorial persuades the King to revoke the order

title.zh: 李斯遭赵高诬陷腰斩咸阳，临刑叹“牵黄犬出上蔡东门”不可得
title.en: Framed by Zhao Gao, Li Si is executed in Xianyang, longing to hunt hares with his son once more

title.zh: 徐霞客游天台山写下游记开篇，首日五月十九日今为中国旅游日
title.en: Xu Xiake explores Mount Tiantai and opens his travel diaries; that May 19 is now China Tourism Day

title.zh: 徐霞客再游黄山，攀登天都、莲花二峰，作《游黄山日后记》
title.en: On his second Huangshan trip, Xu Xiake scales Tiandu and Lotus peaks and records the climb

title.zh: 徐霞客万里遐征西抵腾越，考察打鹰山火山与热泉
title.en: Xu Xiake's great southwest journey reaches Tengyue, where he documents volcanic rock and hot springs

title.zh: 徐霞客病足归江阴故里而卒，遗游记六十余万字
title.en: Crippled by illness, Xu Xiake dies at home in Jiangyin, leaving over 600,000 characters of travel notes

title.zh: 包拯权知开封府，开正门许百姓直诉，京师号“关节不到，有阎罗包老”
title.en: As prefect of Kaifeng, Bao Zheng opens the gates to direct petitions and becomes a byword for integrity

note.en: Central Zhejiang hub where Taiping Prince Shi (Li Shixian) built his residence

note.zh: 金衢严道治所，闽浙赣皖四省边际军事重镇
note.en: Seat of the Jin-Qu-Yan Circuit guarding the four-province borderland

note.zh: 浙南山林矿冶与青田石雕、龙泉剑瓷名邦
note.en: Southern Zhejiang prefecture famed for Qingtian stone carving and Longquan swords and celadon

note.zh: 涡河航运商埠，建山陕会馆（花戏楼）汇集南北药商
note.en: Guo River commercial port where Shanxi-Shaanxi merchants built the Huaxilou Guildhall

note.zh: 雍正十三年升颍州为府，统摄皖西北六县一州
note.en: Elevated to Yingzhou Prefecture in 1735 CE governing six counties and one subprefecture in northwestern Anhui

note.zh: 雍正二年升海州直隶州，淮北纲盐集散中枢
note.en: Elevated to Haizhou Directly-Governed Zhou in 1724 CE, hub of the Huaibei salt trade

note.zh: 淮安府属产盐大县，苏北水网重镇
note.en: Major salt-producing county of Huai'an Prefecture in the northern Jiangsu water network

note.zh: 江南四大米市之首，清末荣氏家族兴办近代面粉纺织工业
note.en: Foremost of Jiangnan's Four Great Rice Markets and cradle of the Rong family's modern flour and textile mills

note.zh: 顺治至康熙初四川巡抚、提督驻地，建川北贡院开科取士
note.en: Early Qing seat of the Sichuan Governor and Provincial Examination Hall at Langzhong

note.zh: 川南永宁道重镇，金沙江铜运与川茶集散大埠
note.en: Major port of southern Sichuan for Jinsha River copper transport and Sichuan tea

note.zh: 雍正十二年复升嘉定州为府，五通桥盐业与夹江手工竹纸繁盛
note.en: Elevated to Jiading Prefecture in 1734 CE, famed for Wutongqiao well salt and Jiajiang bamboo paper

note.zh: 川南永宁道治所，川盐济楚与酿酒名城
note.en: Seat of the Yongning Circuit in southern Sichuan, renowned for salt transport and liquor

note.zh: 赣东粮赋与临川才子文教大府
note.en: Major grain-tax and scholarly prefecture of eastern Jiangxi

note.zh: 赣西入湘咽喉，产夏布与宜春脱胎漆器
note.en: Western Jiangxi gateway to Hunan, famed for ramie cloth and lacquerware

note.zh: 闽中沿海文教名府，湄洲妈祖信俗远播南洋与台湾
note.en: Coastal Fujian prefecture whence the Meizhou Mazu maritime belief spread across Taiwan and Southeast Asia

note.zh: 乾隆五十六年升荆门直隶州，领当阳、远安二县
note.en: Elevated to Jingmen Directly-Governed Zhou in 1791 CE governing Dangyang and Yuan'an

note.zh: 德安府属州，鄂北粮棉重镇
note.en: Subprefecture of De'an Prefecture and grain-cotton hub of northern Hubei

note.zh: 襄阳府属州，控扼汉水与武当山
note.en: Subprefecture of Xiangyang Prefecture commanding the Han River and Mount Wudang

note.zh: 控扼汉江上游川陕鄂交界咽喉，设郧阳总兵镇守
note.en: Commanded the strategic upper Han River borderland at the junction of Sichuan, Shaanxi, and Hubei

note.zh: 湖南郴州直隶州，湘粤古道与铅铜矿政重镇
note.en: Directly-governed prefecture in southern Hunan on the Guangdong post road

note.zh: 高雷阳道重镇，1899年法军强租府境东海湾辟广州湾
note.en: Strategic prefecture of western Guangdong where France leased Guangzhouwan in 1899

note.zh: 高雷阳道治所，粤西文教与军政首府
note.en: Seat of the Gao-Lei-Yang Circuit and administrative center of western Guangdong

note.zh: 西江航运总汇，光绪二十三年辟梧州为通商口岸

note.zh: 光绪三十一年升崖州直隶州，统领海南岛南部四县
note.en: Elevated to Yazhou Directly-Governed Zhou in 1905 CE governing southern Hainan Island

note.zh: 甘省东路重镇，左宗棠西征平定陕甘回乱驻节于此
note.en: Eastern Gansu stronghold where Zuo Zongtang headquartered his northwest campaign

note.zh: 陇东粮仓与边防要冲
note.en: Granary and strategic frontier prefecture of eastern Gansu

note.zh: 迤西道重镇，滇缅商道咽喉
note.en: Major prefecture of the Yixi Circuit commanding the Yunnan-Burma trade route

note.zh: 滇南首府，个旧锡矿兴起与滇越铁路支线枢纽
note.en: Premier prefecture of southern Yunnan, hub for Gejiu tin mining and the Yunnan-Vietnam Railway branch

note.zh: 清驻藏大臣巡查山南诸宗要地
note.en: Key inspection center for the Qing Imperial Resident in Tibet across the Shannan districts

note.zh: 西藏噶厦设噶本二员驻噶大克统管阿里三围
note.en: Seat of the two Garpon governors at Gartok administering the Three Circuits of Ngari

note.zh: 乾隆年间安置旧土尔扈特部游牧于额济纳河流域
note.en: Pastoral homeland along the Ejin River settled by the Old Torghut Mongols under Emperor Qianlong

note.zh: 1861年烟台（芝罘）开埠，1876年于此签订中英《烟台条约》
note.en: Opened as a treaty port in 1861 (Chefoo); site of the 1876 Sino-British Chefoo Convention

note.zh: 雍正十二年（1734年）升龙岩县为福建省直隶州，领漳平、宁洋二县
note.en: Elevated in 1734 under Emperor Yongzheng to Longyan Directly Governed Zhou overseeing Zhangping and Ningyang

note.en: International Silk Road hub of the Northwest

note.en: Where the New Fourth Army rebuilt its headquarters in 1941 following the Southern Anhui Incident

note.en: Site of the August 1945 Zhijiang surrender ceremony ending Japanese hostilities in China

note.en: Jiaozhou Bay recovered by China in 1922; major municipal port and naval base of the Republic

note.zh: 胶东北方门户商埠，张裕酿酒与近代民族工业重镇
note.en: Northern Jiaodong commercial port and cradle of Changyu wine and modern Chinese industry
