title.zh: 秦始皇一统六国行迹
title.en: Qin Shi Huang's Unification Campaigns

span.zh: 前238年 — 前221年（秦王政九年至二十六年）
span.en: 238 BCE – 221 BCE (Reign of King Zheng of Qin)

title.zh: 亲政平乱 · 蓄势东出
title.en: Assuming Personal Rule & Grand Strategy

desc.zh: 二十二岁的秦王政在故都雍城蕲年宫行冠礼亲政，旋即发兵平定长信侯嫪毐之乱，次年罢免相邦吕不韦。随后采纳大梁人尉缭、楚人李斯「远交近攻、先弱后强、各个击破」之策，倾关中与巴蜀之力，蓄势东出函谷关。
desc.en: At age 22, King Zheng of Qin assumed personal rule, crushed Lao Ai’s rebellion, dismissed Chancellor Lü Buwei, and adopted Li Si and Wei Liao’s grand strategy to annex the six eastern states one by one.

quote.zh: 「秦王为人，蜂准，长目，挚鸟膺，豺声，少恩而虎狼之心……诚得志于天下，天下皆为虏矣。」——《史记·秦始皇本纪》引尉缭语
quote.en: “The King of Qin is a man with a prominent nose, elongated eyes, the breast of a bird of prey, and the voice of a jackal; he possesses little kindness and the heart of a tiger or wolf... If he truly achieves his ambitions in the realm, all under Heaven will become his captives.” — Records of the Grand Historian (Shiji)

title.zh: 攻赵取邺 · 灭国序幕
title.en: Capture of Ye — Opening the Unification Wars

desc.zh: 趁赵燕交兵、赵军主力北上攻燕之际，秦王政命王翦、桓齮、杨端和三路大军东出伐赵，连拔邺城、阏与等九城。此役夺取赵国南部漳水门户，正式拉开秦灭六国十年统一战争的序幕。
desc.en: Exploiting a war between Zhao and Yan, Qin generals Wang Jian, Huan Yi, and Yang Duanhe marched east and captured nine Zhao cities including Ye and Yanyu, opening the unification wars.

quote.zh: 「十一年，王翦、桓齮、杨端和攻邺，取九城。」——《史记·秦始皇本纪》
quote.en: “In the 11th year, Wang Jian, Huan Yi, and Yang Duanhe attacked Ye and took nine cities.” — Shiji

title.zh: 内史腾灭韩 · 六国首灭
title.en: Conquest of Han — First of the Six States to Fall

desc.zh: 韩国扼守函谷关外，为秦东进首冲。秦内史腾率军渡河急袭韩都新郑，一举俘虏韩王安，尽收其地设立颍川郡（治阳翟）。韩国成为战国七雄中第一个覆灭的诸侯国，秦军由此牢牢扼住中原腹心。
desc.en: Commandery Governor Teng marched on the Han capital Xinzheng, captured King An of Han, and established Yingchuan Commandery. Han became the first of the six states to fall.

quote.zh: 「十七年，内史腾攻韩，得韩王安，尽纳其地，以其地为郡，命曰颍川。」——《史记·秦始皇本纪》
quote.en: “In the 17th year, Governor Teng attacked Han, captured King An, and made his territory Yingchuan Commandery.” — Shiji

title.zh: 王翦克邯郸 · 破灭赵国
title.en: Fall of Handan — Conquest of Zhao

desc.zh: 赵国名将李牧屡挫秦军。秦军重金行反间计于赵王宠臣郭开，赵王迁自毁长城冤杀李牧、废司马尚。王翦遂猛攻大破赵军，于前228年攻克赵都邯郸，俘赵王迁；秦王政亲赴邯郸尽坑昔日母家仇人。赵公子嘉率宗族北奔代郡称代王。
desc.en: After a Qin espionage plot induced King Qian of Zhao to execute his brilliant general Li Mu, Wang Jian shattered the Zhao army and captured Handan. Prince Jia fled north to establish the rump state of Dai.

quote.zh: 「赵葱死，颜聚亡，后三月，王翦因急击，大破赵，杀赵葱，虏赵王迁及其将颜聚，遂灭赵。」——《战国策》及《史记》
quote.en: “Wang Jian pressed the attack, shattered the Zhao forces, and captured King Qian, extinguishing Zhao.” — Shiji

title.zh: 图穷匕见与易水破燕 · 攻拔蓟城
title.en: Battle of Yi River & Capture of Jicheng

desc.zh: 秦军饮马易水，燕太子丹于前227年遣荆轲歌「风萧萧兮易水寒」入咸阳献督亢地图刺秦，图穷匕见未果。秦王政震怒，命王翦、辛胜率主力北伐，于易水之西大破燕代联军，前226年十月攻拔燕都蓟城。燕王喜斩太子丹首级献秦求和未果，退保辽东襄平。
desc.en: After Jing Ke’s failed assassination attempt in Xianyang (227 BCE), Wang Jian crushed the Yan-Dai army west of the Yi River and captured the Yan capital Jicheng in 226 BCE. King Xi of Yan fled east to Liaodong.

quote.zh: 「风萧萧兮易水寒，壮士一去兮不复还！」——《战国策·燕策三》
quote.en: “The wind blows shrill and the Yi River is cold; once the hero departs, he shall never return!” — Intrigues of the Warring States

title.zh: 王贲水灌大梁 · 荡平魏国
title.en: Flooding of Daliang — Conquest of Wei

desc.zh: 魏都大梁城垣坚厚、护城河深广，易守难攻。王翦之子王贲率军南下攻魏，掘开黄河与鸿沟水渠引水灌城。浸灌三月，大梁城墙崩坏，魏王假出降被杀，秦尽收魏地设砀郡，三晋至此尽入于秦。
desc.en: Facing the heavily fortified Wei capital of Daliang, Wang Ben diverted the Yellow River and Honggou Canal to flood the city for three months until its walls collapsed. King Jia surrendered, ending the state of Wei.

quote.zh: 「二十二年，王贲攻魏，引河沟灌大梁，大梁城坏，其王请降，尽取其地。」——《史记·秦始皇本纪》
quote.en: “In the 22nd year, Wang Ben attacked Wei, channeled the Yellow River to flood Daliang, and took all its land.” — Shiji

title.zh: 王翦六十万破楚 · 攻克寿春
title.en: Six Hundred Thousand Troops — Conquest of Chu

desc.zh: 李信率二十万秦军伐楚先胜后败，为项燕所乘。秦王政亲赴频阳向老将王翦谢过，倾全国六十万大军托付王翦、蒙武。王翦坚壁不出以老楚师，待楚军东撤之际大举追击，于蕲南击杀项燕，攻克楚都寿春，俘楚王负刍，广袤楚地尽归于秦。
desc.en: After Li Xin’s setback, King Zheng entrusted 600,000 troops to veteran general Wang Jian. Wearing down the Chu forces before striking decisively, Wang Jian captured Shouchun and King Fuchu, conquering Chu.

quote.zh: 「王翦果代李信击荆……荆数挑战而秦不出。乃引而东。翦因举兵追之，令壮士击，大破荆军。」——《史记·白起王翦列传》
quote.en: “Chu repeatedly challenged Qin to battle, yet Wang Jian held firm inside his ramparts until Chu retreated east, then struck with full force and routed them.” — Shiji

title.zh: 远征辽东 · 灭燕平代定江南
title.en: Liaodong Campaign — Extinguishing Yan & Dai

desc.zh: 王贲、李信挥师东北远征辽东，攻破襄平，俘燕王喜，燕国彻底灭亡；旋即回师北击代郡，俘代王嘉，赵氏余脉亦绝。同年南线王翦大军渡江平定楚国江南旧地，降服越君，置会稽郡。天下六国仅余东海之滨的齐国孤悬。
desc.en: Wang Ben and Li Xin marched into Liaodong to capture King Xi of Yan at Xiangping, then turned west to capture King Jia of Dai, while Wang Jian pacified Jiangnan and established Kuaiji Commandery.

quote.zh: 「二十五年，大兴兵，使王贲将，攻燕辽东，得燕王喜。还攻代，虏代王嘉。王翦遂定荆江南地。」——《史记·秦始皇本纪》
quote.en: “In the 25th year, Wang Ben attacked Liaodong, captured King Xi of Yan, and returned to capture King Jia of Dai, while Wang Jian pacified Jiangnan.” — Shiji

title.zh: 六王毕 · 四海一（齐降天下一统）
title.en: Surrender of Qi at Linzi — Empire Unified

desc.zh: 齐相后胜受秦重金贿赂，劝齐王建不修战备、不援五国，仅于西界屯兵防秦。前221年，王贲、李信、蒙恬自燕地南下避开齐军西境主力，径直突入齐都临淄，齐王建不战出降。秦王政遂完成统一大业，定尊号「始皇帝」，废分封、设三十六郡，开创中国两千年大一统格局。
desc.en: Bypassing Qi’s western border defenses, Wang Ben, Li Xin, and Meng Tian plunged south from Yan straight into Linzi. King Jian of Qi surrendered without a battle, completing the unification of China under the First Emperor.

quote.zh: 「六王毕，四海一。」——杜牧《阿房宫赋》 · 「秦初并天下……法令由一统。」——《史记·秦始皇本纪》
quote.en: “The six kings met their end, and the four seas became one.” — Du Mu, Rhapsody on Epang Palace

title.zh: 张骞凿空西域行迹
title.en: Zhang Qian's Mission to the Western Regions

span.zh: 前138年 — 前126年（西汉建元三年至元朔三年）

title.zh: 奉诏募使·发自长安
title.en: Imperial Commission at Chang'an

desc.zh: 汉武帝欲联合大月氏共击匈奴，张骞以郎应募，与堂邑氏胡奴甘父率百余人自长安出发西行。
desc.en: Emperor Wu of Han sought an alliance with the Great Yuezhi against the Xiongnu; Zhang Qian volunteered and departed Chang'an with over a hundred men.

quote.zh: 《史记·大宛列传》：“骞以郎应募，使月氏，与堂邑氏胡奴甘父俱出陇西。”
quote.en: Records of the Grand Historian: "Zhang Qian volunteered as a palace attendant to go as envoy to the Yuezhi, departing Longxi with Ganfu."

title.zh: 出陇西塞·踏入绝域
title.en: Crossing the Longxi Frontier

desc.zh: 自陇西郡出塞西渡黄河，踏入匈奴右贤王与浑邪王控扼的河西之地，由此西去万里皆属未知绝域。
desc.en: Crossing the Han frontier at Longxi Commandery into the Xiongnu-held Hexi Corridor toward the uncharted Western Regions.

quote.zh: 《汉书·张骞传》：“出陇西，径匈奴，匈奴得之。”
quote.en: Book of Han: "Departing Longxi, he passed through Xiongnu territory and was captured."

title.zh: 羁留匈奴·持节十载
title.en: Detained by the Xiongnu for a Decade

desc.zh: 途经河西走廊为匈奴骑兵截获，押送单于王庭。单于予妻生子，然张骞始终“持汉节不失”，羁留十余载待机西奔。
desc.en: Captured in the Hexi Corridor and held for over ten years by the Xiongnu Chanyu, yet Zhang Qian never relinquished his Han imperial tally.

quote.zh: 《史记·大宛列传》：“留骞十余岁，予妻，有子，然骞持汉节不失。”
quote.en: Records of the Grand Historian: "Detained over ten years and given a wife and son, yet Zhang Qian kept his Han imperial staff unblemished."

title.zh: 乘隙脱走·疾驰西域北道
title.en: Escape Along the Northern Tarim Oasis Route

desc.zh: 匈奴监管渐宽，张骞与甘父乘隙逃脱，循天山南麓绿洲昼夜西驰数十日，穿越车师、焉耆、龟兹诸国。
desc.en: Seizing a moment of lax guard, Zhang Qian and Ganfu escaped westward for dozens of days along the northern Tarim oases at the foot of the Tian Shan.

quote.zh: 《史记·大宛列传》：“居匈奴中，益宽，骞因与其属亡乡月氏，西走数十日。”
quote.en: Records of the Grand Historian: "When surveillance eased, Zhang Qian fled with his men toward the Yuezhi, riding west for dozens of days."

title.zh: 越葱岭抵大宛·得发导译
title.en: Crossing the Pamirs to Dayuan (Fergana)

desc.zh: 翻越帕米尔高原（葱岭）抵达盛产汗血宝马的大宛国。大宛王久闻汉朝饶财欲通而不得，见张骞大喜，特派向导译员护送赴康居。
desc.en: Crossing the Pamir Mountains into Fergana (Dayuan), whose king welcomed Zhang Qian warmly and provided guides and interpreters.

quote.zh: 《史记·大宛列传》：“大宛闻汉之饶财，欲通不得，见骞，喜……为发导驿抵康居。”
quote.en: Records of the Grand Historian: "Dayuan had heard of Han wealth and rejoiced at meeting Zhang Qian, dispatching post-guides to escort him to Kangju."

title.zh: 经康居传致大月氏
title.en: Relay Through Kangju to the Oxus

desc.zh: 由大宛导驿护送至康居国，再由康居王庭遣骑护送南下妫水（阿姆河）流域的大月氏王庭。
desc.en: Escorted through Kangju between the Syr Darya and Zeravshan rivers, and relayed southward toward the Amu Darya (Oxus).

quote.zh: 《史记·大宛列传》：“抵康居，康居传致大月氏。”
quote.en: Records of the Grand Historian: "Reaching Kangju, he was relayed onward to the Great Yuezhi."

title.zh: 驻节大月氏与大夏·考索诸国
title.en: Court of the Great Yuezhi & Bactria

desc.zh: 抵阿姆河流域，大月氏已臣服大夏（巴克特里亚），土地肥美安乐，无意东还复仇。张骞驻留岁余，详考大夏、安息、身毒及蜀布竹杖商路。
desc.en: In fertile Bactria, the Yuezhi no longer wished to return east against the Xiongnu. Staying over a year, Zhang Qian documented Parthia, India, and Sichuan trade goods.

quote.zh: 《史记·大宛列传》：“留岁余，还，并南山，欲从羌中归。”
quote.en: Records of the Grand Historian: "After staying over a year, he headed back along the Southern Mountains to return through Qiang lands."

title.zh: 循昆仑南道东归·复陷匈奴
title.en: Return via the Southern Tarim Route

desc.zh: 为避匈奴控制的天山北道，返程改循昆仑山北麓西域南道，经莎车、于阗、楼兰，欲从羌中归汉，不意复为匈奴游骑所得。
desc.en: To avoid Xiongnu patrols on the northern route, Zhang Qian returned along the Kunlun foothills via Yarkand and Khotan, but was captured again by Xiongnu horsemen.

quote.zh: 《史记·大宛列传》：“并南山，欲从羌中归，复为匈奴所得。”
quote.en: Records of the Grand Historian: "Skirting the Southern Mountains to return via Qiang territory, he was captured once more by the Xiongnu."

title.zh: 持节归朝·丝路凿空
title.en: Return to Chang'an — Opening the Silk Road

desc.zh: 元朔三年军臣单于死、匈奴内乱，张骞与胡妻及甘父逃归长安。出使十三载，百余人唯二人得还，封博望侯，史称“凿空”。
desc.en: Amid Xiongnu succession turmoil in 126 BCE, Zhang Qian escaped back to Chang'an with Ganfu—only two survivors of the original hundred—opening the Silk Road.

quote.zh: 《史记·大宛列传》：“初行时百余人，去十三岁，唯二人得还。”
quote.en: Records of the Grand Historian: "Of over a hundred men who set out, after thirteen years only two returned."

title.zh: 诸葛亮出山北伐行迹
title.en: Zhuge Liang's Southern & Northern Campaigns

span.zh: 207年 — 234年（东汉建安十二年至蜀汉建兴十二年）
span.en: 207 CE – 234 CE (Late Eastern Han to Three Kingdoms)

title.zh: 三顾茅庐·隆中决策
title.en: Three Visits to the Thatched Cottage — The Longzhong Plan

desc.zh: 刘备驻新野，三诣襄阳城西二十里隆中草庐访诸葛亮。年二十七的孔明纵论天下大势，提出跨有荆益、保其岩阻、西和诸戎、南抚夷越、内修政理、待天下有变则命一上将将荆州之军向宛洛而身率益州之众出秦川的“隆中对”宏图。
desc.en: At age twenty-seven in his cottage at Longzhong west of Xiangyang, Zhuge Liang received Liu Bei on his third visit and unveiled the Longzhong Plan: secure Jing and Yi provinces, ally with Eastern Wu, pacify the southern tribes, and launch a two-pronged northern offensive to restore the Han.

quote.zh: 诸葛亮《出师表》：“臣本布衣，躬耕于南阳，苟全性命于乱世，不求闻达于诸侯。先帝不以臣卑鄙，猥自枉屈，三顾臣于草庐之中。”
quote.en: Zhuge Liang, Former Chu Shi Biao: "I was originally a commoner, tilling the fields in Nanyang... Yet the Late Emperor did not disdain my humble station and deigned to visit me thrice in my thatched cottage."

modern.zh: 江西九江 / 湖北赤壁

title.zh: 奉使柴桑·联吴破曹
title.en: Diplomatic Mission to Chaisang & Victory at Red Cliffs

desc.zh: 曹操南下荆州、刘备败走当阳长坂，诸葛亮临危请命顺江东下柴桑说孙权，剖析曹军远来疲弊、北人不习水战之弊，促成孙刘同盟；旋于赤壁大破曹军，奠定三分天下之基。
desc.en: As Cao Cao swept south through Jing Province, Zhuge Liang sailed down the Yangtze to Chaisang to persuade Sun Quan into an alliance; the allied forces burned Cao Cao’s fleet at the Red Cliffs, forging the tripartite balance.

quote.zh: 《三国志·诸葛亮传》：“权大悦，即遣周瑜、程普、鲁肃等水军三万，随亮诣先主，并力拒曹公。”
quote.en: Records of the Three Kingdoms: "Sun Quan was greatly pleased and immediately dispatched Zhou Yu, Cheng Pu, and Lu Su with thirty thousand naval troops to join Liu Bei against Cao Cao."

title.zh: 溯江入蜀·会师成都
title.en: Ascending the Yangtze into Shu & Taking Chengdu

desc.zh: 刘备入蜀受阻于雒城，诸葛亮与张飞、赵云自荆州率军溯长江西上，分定江州、江阳、犍为诸郡，与刘备合围成都；刘璋出降，亮署左将军府事，修订《蜀科》，宽严相济治理巴蜀。
desc.en: Leading reinforcements up the Yangtze Three Gorges with Zhang Fei and Zhao Yun, Zhuge Liang converged on Chengdu with Liu Bei, securing Yi Province and codifying the legal code of Shu.

quote.zh: 《三国志·诸葛亮传》：“亮与张飞、赵云等率众泝江，分定郡县，与先主共围成都。成都平，以亮为军师将军。”
quote.en: Records of the Three Kingdoms: "Zhuge Liang, Zhang Fei, and Zhao Yun led forces up the Yangtze, pacifying commanderies and counties before joining Liu Bei to encircle Chengdu."

title.zh: 劝进昭烈·开府拜相
title.en: Founding of Shu Han & Appointment as Imperial Chancellor

desc.zh: 曹丕篡汉自立，诸葛亮与群臣劝进刘备于成都武担山之南即皇帝位，延续汉室正统；诸葛亮拜丞相、录尚书事、假节，总摄蜀汉朝政与盐铁锦官经济。
desc.en: Following Cao Pi’s usurpation of the Han throne, Zhuge Liang advised Liu Bei to proclaim the continuation of Han in Chengdu, becoming Imperial Chancellor of Shu Han.

quote.zh: 册丞相诏：“朕遭家不造，奉承大统，兢兢业业，不敢康宁，思靖百姓，惧未能绥。於戏！丞相亮其悉朕意。”
quote.en: Imperial Edict of 221 CE: "Having inherited the Great Succession in troubled times, I rely wholeheartedly upon Chancellor Liang to bring peace to the realm."

title.zh: 白帝托孤·受命危难
title.en: Entrustment of the Orphan Emperor at Baidicheng

desc.zh: 夷陵之战后刘备病笃永安白帝城，自成都召诸葛亮赴行宫托孤，嘱以“嗣子可辅，辅之；如其不才，君可自取”。亮涕泣死节，回朝后开府治事、遣邓芝修好东吴，稳固危局。
desc.en: Summoned to the dying Emperor Liu Bei’s bedside at Baidicheng, Zhuge Liang accepted the regency in tears, pledging unyielding loyalty until death and restoring the Wu alliance.

quote.zh: 诸葛亮《出师表》：“受任于败军之际，奉命于危难之间，尔来二十有一年矣。”
quote.en: Zhuge Liang, Former Chu Shi Biao: "I received my appointment in the hour of defeat and accepted my mandate in the midst of peril—twenty-one years have passed since then."

title.zh: 渡泸南征·七擒孟获
title.en: Southern Campaign Across the Lu River — Pacifying Nanzhong

desc.zh: 为解除北伐后顾之忧，诸葛亮率军自安上水路入越巂，五月渡泸水（金沙江），采马谡“攻心为上”之策，七擒七纵孟获，平定益州、永昌、牂牁、越巂四郡，皆即其渠帅而用之，终亮之世南方不复反。
desc.en: Marching south across the Jinsha (Lu) River in summer 225 CE, Zhuge Liang adopted the strategy of "winning hearts above all," capturing and releasing Meng Huo seven times to secure the southern frontier.

quote.zh: 《汉晋春秋》：“亮笑，纵使更战，七纵七禽，而亮犹遣获。获止不去，曰：‘公，天威也，南人不复反矣。’”
quote.en: Annals of Han and Jin: "Captured and released seven times, Meng Huo bowed and refused to leave, saying: 'Your Excellency possesses the majesty of Heaven; the south will never rebel again.'"

title.zh: 进驻汉中·上出师表
title.en: Garrisoning Hanzhong & Presenting the Chu Shi Biao

desc.zh: 南中既定，诸葛亮率诸军北驻汉中沔阳，临发向后主刘禅奏呈千古名篇《出师表》，勉以亲贤臣远小人、兴复汉室还于旧都，以汉中为北伐大本营经略关陇。
desc.en: Establishing his forward headquarters at Hanzhong, Zhuge Liang submitted his immortal Memorial on Deploying the Troops (Chu Shi Biao) to Emperor Liu Shan before marching north.

quote.zh: 诸葛亮《出师表》：“今南方已定，兵甲已足，当奖率三军，北定中原，庶竭驽钝，攘除奸凶，兴复汉室，还于旧都。”
quote.en: Zhuge Liang, Former Chu Shi Biao: "Now the south is pacified and our armor is sufficient; I ought to lead the Three Armies to secure the Central Plains and restore the House of Han."

title.zh: 一出祁山·收姜维失街亭
title.en: First Expedition from Mount Qi — Recruiting Jiang Wei

desc.zh: 声东击西由箕谷设疑兵、亲率大军攻祁山，戎阵整齐，南安、天水、安定三郡叛魏应亮，关中震响，收天水俊杰姜维；惜马谡违亮节度于街亭依山不下城，为张郃绝水道所破，亮拔西县千余家还汉中并自贬三等。
desc.en: Debouching from Mount Qi in disciplined array, Zhuge Liang won over three Wei commanderies—shaking all Guanzhong and recruiting Jiang Wei—before Ma Su’s defeat at Jieting forced an orderly withdrawal.

quote.zh: 《三国志·诸葛亮传》：“亮身率诸军攻祁山，戎阵整齐，赏罚肃而号令明，南安、天水、安定三郡叛魏应亮，关中响震。”
quote.en: Records of the Three Kingdoms: "Zhuge Liang led the armies in person to attack Mount Qi in disciplined ranks; Nan'an, Tianshui, and Anding commanderies defected from Wei to join him, shaking all Guanzhong."

modern.zh: 甘肃礼县 / 天水秦州

title.zh: 木牛流马·木门道射杀张郃
title.en: Fourth Expedition — Victory at Lucheng & Mumen Ambush

desc.zh: 始以木牛运粮四出祁山，于卤城大破司马懿主力，获甲首三千级、玄铠五千领；夏六月粮尽退军，司马懿遣名将张郃追至木门道，亮乘高布伏万弩齐发，射杀张郃。
desc.en: Using wooden-ox transport on his fourth northern campaign, Zhuge Liang routed Sima Yi outside Lucheng and ambushed the pursuing Wei general Zhang He with massed crossbows in Mumen Gorge.

quote.zh: 《三国志·诸葛亮传》：“亮粮尽退军，司马宣王遣张郃追之，郃进至木门，与亮军交战，飞矢中郃右膝，薨。”
quote.en: Records of the Three Kingdoms: "When Zhuge Liang withdrew for lack of grain, Sima Yi sent Zhang He in pursuit; at Mumen Trail, a flying bolt struck Zhang He in the right knee, and he perished."

title.zh: 出斜谷屯五丈原·秋风星落
title.en: Final Stand on the Wuzhang Plains

desc.zh: 春二月悉大众十万由褒斜道出斜谷，以流马运粮，据武功五丈原与司马懿对峙于渭水之南，分兵屯田久驻之基，百姓安堵军无私焉；相持百余日，八月积劳病逝于军中，年五十四，杨仪、姜维整军从容退入斜谷，留“死诸葛走生仲达”之谚。
desc.en: Leading 100,000 troops through the Xie Valley to the Wuzhang Plains south of the Wei River, Zhuge Liang established military-agricultural colonies and held off Sima Yi for over a hundred days before passing away in camp at age fifty-four.

quote.zh: 杜甫《蜀相》：“三顾频烦天下计，两朝开济老臣心。出师未捷身先死，长使英雄泪满襟。”
quote.en: Du Fu, The Chancellor of Shu: "Three visits sought his counsel for the realm; through two reigns the old minister’s heart sustained the state. Before the campaign triumphed he died in the field, forever filling heroes’ robes with tears."

title.zh: 玄奘西行求法行迹
title.en: Xuanzang's Pilgrimage to the Western Regions

span.zh: 627年 — 645年（唐贞观元年至贞观十九年）

title.zh: 发足长安·孤身西迈
title.en: Departing Chang'an for the West

desc.zh: 为求《瑜伽师地论》梵本真义以释诸家纷歧，年二十八的玄奘大师自长安混迹灾民西出秦陇，立誓“不至天竺，终不东归一步”。
desc.en: Seeking original Sanskrit texts of the Yogacara-bhumi-sastra, Master Xuanzang departed Chang'an alone, vowing never to take a step back eastward before reaching India.

quote.zh: 《大慈恩寺三藏法师传》：“遂发足西行，自尔孑然孤游。”
quote.en: Biography of the Tripitaka Master: "Thus he set foot westward, traveling onward in solitary resolve."

title.zh: 凉州开讲·昼伏夜行
title.en: Preaching in Liangzhou & Night Crossing

desc.zh: 抵河西都会凉州，受众僧礼请开讲《涅槃》《摄大乘论》月余，名震葱岭以东；因朝廷严禁私度边关，由慧威法师遣徒护送昼伏夜行西赴瓜州。
desc.en: In Liangzhou, Xuanzang lectured for over a month to great acclaim; evading border bans, he traveled by night and hid by day toward Guazhou.

quote.zh: 《大慈恩寺三藏法师传》：“凉州为河西都会，僧徒既多，请留开讲。”
quote.en: Biography of the Tripitaka Master: "Liangzhou was the metropolis of Hexi; its many monks entreated him to stay and lecture."

title.zh: 夜渡葫芦河·闯莫贺延碛
title.en: Crossing the Gobi of Moheyan

desc.zh: 州吏李昌感其诚而暗撕通缉牒文。玄奘夜渡葫芦河、独闯五烽，于八百里莫贺延碛失手覆水，四夜五日滴水未进，绝处逢生终抵伊吾。
desc.en: Crossing the Hulu River by night past five watchtowers, Xuanzang survived five days and four nights without water in the 800-li Moheyan Desert.

quote.zh: 《大慈恩寺三藏法师传》：“莫贺延碛长八百余里，古曰沙河，上无飞鸟，下无走兽。”
quote.en: Biography of the Tripitaka Master: "The Moheyan Desert stretches over 800 li—no birds above, no beasts below."

title.zh: 高昌结义·修书通西域
title.en: Sworn Brotherhood with the King of Gaochang

desc.zh: 高昌王麴文泰虔礼挽留，玄奘水浆不涉三日以明西求大法之志；麴文泰感泣结为兄弟，修二十四封国书、备黄金百两与三十匹马护送西行。
desc.en: Moved by Xuanzang’s three-day fast, King Qu Wentai became his sworn brother and provided 24 diplomatic letters and provisions for the Western Regions.

quote.zh: 《大慈恩寺三藏法师传》：“任师西迈，乞垂早食……遂共结为兄弟。”
quote.en: Biography of the Tripitaka Master: "The King pledged to support his westward journey and swore brotherhood with him."

title.zh: 驻锡龟兹·翻越凌山雪岭
title.en: Kucha Oasis & Crossing the Icy Tian Shan

desc.zh: 在龟兹与高僧木叉毱多论辩经义，因大雪封山逗留六十余日；开春后翻越积雪千尺的凌山（天山木扎尔特达坂），历经雪崩严寒出天山北麓。
desc.en: Delayed two months in Kucha by winter snows, Xuanzang then scaled the glacial Muzart Pass of the Tian Shan.

quote.zh: 《大唐西域记》：“山谷积雪，春夏合冻，虽时消泮，寻复结冰。”
quote.en: Great Tang Records on the Western Regions: "The mountain valleys are piled with snow, frozen through spring and summer."

modern.zh: 吉尔吉斯斯坦托克马克

title.zh: 过大清池·会西突厥叶护可汗
title.en: Audience with the Western Turkic Khagan at Suyab

desc.zh: 循大清池（伊塞克湖）西北行至碎叶城，恰逢西突厥统叶护可汗游猎。可汗设宴礼敬，命通解汉言及诸国语的摩咄达官率骑护送至迦毕试国境。
desc.en: Passing Lake Issyk-Kul to Suyab, Xuanzang met Tong Yabghu Khagan of the Western Turks, who assigned a multilingual envoy to escort him south.

quote.zh: 《大唐西域记》：“清池西北行五百余里至素叶水城，逢突厥叶护可汗方事畋游。”
quote.en: Great Tang Records: "Traveling 500 li northwest from the Clear Lake to Suyab, he met the Turkic Yabghu Khagan on a hunt."

title.zh: 过铁门关·参礼小王舍城
title.en: Through the Iron Gate to Balkh

desc.zh: 经赭时（塔什干）、飒秣建（撒马尔罕），穿险峻铁门关，渡缚刍河（阿姆河）抵号称“小王舍城”的缚喝国，与般若羯罗法师切磋毗婆沙论。
desc.en: Passing Samarkand and the Iron Gate Pass across the Oxus to Balkh ("Little Rajagrha"), studying Abhidharma texts at Nava Vihara.

quote.zh: 《大唐西域记》：“缚喝国，伽蓝百有余所，僧徒三千余人。”
quote.en: Great Tang Records: "The Kingdom of Balkh has over a hundred monasteries and more than three thousand monks."

title.zh: 越雪山礼大佛·入天竺求法
title.en: Crossing the Hindu Kush into Gandhara & India

desc.zh: 翻越大雪山（兴都库什山）、瞻礼梵衍那（巴米扬）石佛，入北天竺健驮逻故地；由此深游五印十余载，于那烂陀寺师从戒贤论师，并在曲女城十八国王大会立“真唯识量”。
desc.en: Crossing the Hindu Kush past Bamiyan into Gandhara, beginning over a decade across India culminating at Nalanda Monastery and the Grand Assembly of Kanauj.

quote.zh: 《大唐西域记》：“自古大圣贤，多生此国，作论诸师，亦多出此。”
quote.en: Great Tang Records: "Since antiquity, great sages and treatise-masters have arisen in this land of Gandhara."

title.zh: 越葱岭载经东归·奉表唐廷
title.en: Return via Khotan & Memorial to Emperor Taizong

desc.zh: 载梵本经论越帕米尔高原东归至于阗，遣使向唐太宗奉表陈情；此时大唐已平定高昌、设安西都护府，太宗降敕欣慰迎归，命沿途州县护送。
desc.en: Returning across the Pamirs to Khotan with Sanskrit scriptures, Xuanzang sent a memorial to Emperor Taizong, who issued an imperial edict welcoming him home.

quote.zh: 《进西域记表》：“冒越宪章，私往天竺……历览周游，一十七载。”
quote.en: Memorial to the Throne: "Having ventured beyond the border laws to India, I traveled and observed for seventeen years."

title.zh: 归至京师·开场译经撰记
title.en: Triumphal Return to Chang'an & Translation Bureau

desc.zh: 贞观十九年正月返抵长安，朱雀街数十万人瞻礼迎奉六百五十七部梵经；后于弘福寺、大慈恩寺主持译场十九载，译经七十五部，撰成《大唐西域记》十二卷。
desc.en: Returning to Chang'an in 645 CE with 657 Sanskrit texts, Xuanzang led the imperial translation bureau for 19 years and compiled the Great Tang Records on the Western Regions.

quote.zh: 《旧唐书·玄奘传》：“贞观十九年，归至京师，太宗见之大悦，与之谈论。”
quote.en: Old Book of Tang: "In the 19th year of Zhenguan he returned to the capital; Emperor Taizong met him with great joy."

title.zh: 李白仗剑壮游行迹
title.en: Li Bai's Grand Travels Across Tang China

span.zh: 701年 — 762年（武周长安元年至唐宝应元年）

modern.zh: 吉尔吉斯斯坦托克马克

title.zh: 诞于西域·安西碎叶
title.en: Birth at Suyab in the Western Regions

desc.zh: 长安元年（701年），李白诞于唐安西都护府碎叶城（今楚河流域托克马克附近），幼承丝路胡汉交融之风，五岁随父李客东迁入蜀。
desc.en: Born in 701 CE at Suyab—one of the Four Garrisons of Anxi in the Chu River valley—Li Bai spent his earliest childhood on the Silk Road frontier before migrating with his family to Sichuan at age five.

quote.zh: 范传正《唐左拾遗翰林学士李公新墓碑》：“隋末多难，一房被窜于碎叶，流离散落，隐易姓名。”
quote.en: Fan Chuanzheng, New Tomb Inscription for Li Bai: "Amid the turmoil at the end of Sui, his branch of the clan was exiled to Suyab, living incognito until returning to Shu in the Shenlong era."

title.zh: 卜居青莲·大匡山读书
title.en: Youth in Qinglian & Studying on Mount Dakuang

desc.zh: 随父客居剑南道绵州昌隆县青莲乡（自号“青莲居士”）。少时博学广览、好剑术任侠，隐大匡山读书，后游成都、登峨眉，受道士司马承祯赞为“有仙风道骨，可与神游八极之表”，作《大鹏遇希有鸟赋》。
desc.en: Settling in Qinglian in Mianzhou (whence his sobriquet "Layman of Blue Lotus"), young Li Bai practiced swordsmanship, studied on Mount Dakuang, climbed Mount Emei, and was praised by Taoist master Sima Chengzhen as having "immortal bones."

quote.zh: 李白《上安州裴长史书》：“五岁诵六甲，十岁观百家……十五观奇书，作赋凌相如。”
quote.en: Li Bai, Letter to Administrator Pei of Anzhou: "At five I recited the calendar classics; at ten I read the Hundred Schools; at fifteen I composed rhapsodies rivaling Sima Xiangru."

title.zh: 仗剑去国·辞亲出三峡
title.en: Leaving Shu with Sword in Hand Through the Three Gorges

desc.zh: 年二十四的李白怀济世远志“仗剑去国，辞亲远游”，自成都乘舟顺岷江下渝州，穿巫峡、出荆门，初见江汉平原天地壮阔，写下《峨眉山月歌》与《渡荆门送别》。
desc.en: At twenty-four, Li Bai bade farewell to Sichuan and sailed down the Three Gorges past Jingmen into the vast Jianghan Plain, beginning his lifelong travels across the Tang Empire.

quote.zh: 李白《渡荆门送别》：“山随平野尽，江入大荒流。月下飞天镜，云生结海楼。”
quote.en: Li Bai, Farewell at Jingmen: "Mountains vanish into the level plain; the Great River rolls into the boundless wild. Beneath the moon a celestial mirror flies; rising clouds weave ocean pavilions."

title.zh: 漫游吴越·散金三十万
title.en: Grand Tour of Wu-Yue & Spending 300,000 Cash in Yangzhou

desc.zh: 顺江东下，登庐山望瀑布、游金陵怀古，转赴繁华甲天下的淮南都会扬州与吴越诸郡，豪爽济困，“不逾一年，散金三十余万”，写就《望庐山瀑布》《静夜思》等千古绝唱。
desc.en: Sailing down the lower Yangtze past Mount Lu and Jinling to prosperous Yangzhou, Li Bai generously aided destitute scholars—giving away over 300,000 coins within a year—and composed Quiet Night Thought.

quote.zh: 李白《上安州裴长史书》：“曩昔东游维扬，不逾一年，散金三十余万，有落魄公子，悉皆济之。”
quote.en: Li Bai: "Formerly traveling east to Yangzhou, in less than a year I scattered more than three hundred thousand in gold, coming to the aid of every stranded gentleman."

title.zh: 酒隐安陆·登临黄鹤楼
title.en: Ten Years in Anlu & Farewell at Yellow Crane Tower

desc.zh: 西归荆楚，赘于安陆故相许圉师孙女家，隐居白兆山桃花岩所谓“酒隐安陆，蹉跎十年”；其间频游江夏与襄阳，结交孟浩然，于黄鹤楼赋诗送其东下广陵。
desc.en: Marrying into the family of former Chancellor Xu Yushi in Anlu, Li Bai made Mount Baizhao his home base for a decade, befriending Meng Haoran and seeing him off at the Yellow Crane Tower.

quote.zh: 李白《黄鹤楼送孟浩然之广陵》：“故人西辞黄鹤楼，烟花三月下扬州。孤帆远影碧空尽，唯见长江天际流。”
quote.en: Li Bai, Seeing Off Meng Haoran at Yellow Crane Tower: "My old friend bids farewell to the west at Yellow Crane Tower, sailing down to Yangzhou in the misty blossoms of March."

title.zh: 奉诏入京·翰林待诏
title.en: Summoned to Chang'an — Imperial Hanlin Academy

desc.zh: 因道士吴筠及玉真公主举荐，唐玄宗降诏征召入京。李白高歌“仰天大笑出门去，我辈岂是蓬蒿人”西入长安，贺知章读《蜀道难》惊呼“谪仙人”，玄宗降辇步迎、供奉翰林，赋《清平调》三章。
desc.en: Summoned to Chang’an by Emperor Xuanzong, Li Bai was hailed by He Zhizhang as a "Banished Immortal" upon reading The Hard Roads of Shu, and served in the Imperial Hanlin Academy.

quote.zh: 李白《南陵别儿童入京》：“仰天大笑出门去，我辈岂是蓬蒿人！”
quote.en: Li Bai, Parting from My Children at Nanling for the Capital: "Throwing back my head with a great laugh I stride out the gate—how could men like us remain forever amid the mugwort?"

modern.zh: 河南洛阳 / 商丘开封

title.zh: 赐金放还·洛阳逢杜甫
title.en: Leaving Court & Historic Meeting with Du Fu in Luoyang

desc.zh: 因傲岸不羁遭权贵谗毁，玄宗“赐金放还”。李白东出长安至东都洛阳，与年三十三的杜甫初遇定交，复邀高适同游梁宋（开封、商丘），登吹台、猎孟诸，淋漓尽致展现盛唐双子星风采。
desc.en: Granted gold to leave court in 744 CE, Li Bai traveled east to Luoyang where he met the younger Du Fu—a meeting hailed as the twin peaks of Tang poetry—and roamed the Liang-Song plains with Gao Shi.

quote.zh: 杜甫《寄李十二白二十韵》：“乞归优诏许，遇我宿心亲。醉舞梁园夜，行歌泗水春。”
quote.en: Du Fu, Twenty Rhymes Sent to Li Bai: "Your plea to retire was granted by gracious edict; meeting me, our kindred hearts grew close—dancing drunk in Liang Garden by night, singing along the Si River in spring."

title.zh: 东游齐鲁·梦游天姥
title.en: Sojourn in Qilu & Dreaming of Mount Tianmu

desc.zh: 寄家山东兖州任城，与杜甫携手同游齐鲁，访范十隐居、登泰山徂徕，于紫极宫受道箓；临别东鲁南游越中时赋《梦游天姥吟留别》，喊出“安能摧眉折腰事权贵，使我不得开心颜”之千古强音。
desc.en: Making his family home in Rencheng (Shandong) and roaming Qilu with Du Fu, Li Bai composed Dreaming of Mount Tianmu: A Farewell Song before heading south.

quote.zh: 李白《梦游天姥吟留别》：“安能摧眉折腰事权贵，使我不得开心颜！”
quote.en: Li Bai, Dreaming of Mount Tianmu: "How can I bow my brow and bend my waist to serve the powerful, denying myself a joyful heart and open brow?"

title.zh: 长流夜郎·白帝遇赦还江陵
title.en: Exile to Yelang & Imperial Pardon at Baidicheng

desc.zh: 安史之乱起，李白怀平胡复国之志入永王李璘幕府，兵败后系浔阳狱，坐长流夜郎（黔中）；乾元二年春溯江行至巫山白帝城，忽逢关内大旱朝廷大赦天下，惊喜放舟东下江陵，写下《早发白帝城》。
desc.en: Implicated in Prince Lin of Yong’s campaign during the An Lushan Rebellion, Li Bai was banished toward distant Yelang; reaching Baidicheng in spring 759 CE, he received an imperial amnesty and raced downstream to Jiangling.

quote.zh: 李白《早发白帝城》：“朝辞白帝彩云间，千里江陵一日还。两岸猿声啼不住，轻舟已过万重山。”
quote.en: Li Bai, Departing Baidicheng at Dawn: "At dawn I leave Baidicheng amid rainbow clouds; a thousand li to Jiangling I return in a single day. While gibbons on both banks cry without cease, my light skiff has already shot past ten thousand mountains."

title.zh: 赋临路歌·终老当涂青山
title.en: Final Song at Dangtu & Resting by Mount Qing

desc.zh: 晚年漂泊金陵、宣城、秋浦之间，闻太尉李光弼统军讨史朝义，六十一岁仍请缨从军，行至金陵因病折返，依族叔当涂令李阳冰；宝应元年十一月赋《临路歌》绝笔，病逝于当涂，终葬谢朓曾游之青山。
desc.en: After attempting at sixty-one to join Li Guangbi’s army against the rebels, an ailing Li Bai stayed with his kinsman Li Yangbing in Dangtu, composing his final Song Before the Road and passing away in late 762 CE.

quote.zh: 李白《临路歌》：“大鹏飞兮振八裔，中天摧兮力不济。馀风激兮万世，游扶桑兮挂石袂。”
quote.en: Li Bai, Song Before the Road: "The Great Peng soared and shook the eight horizons; broken in mid-heaven, its strength gave out—yet its lingering wind stirs ten thousand generations."

title.zh: 苏轼宦海贬谪行迹
title.en: Su Shi's Literary Exile Across Song China

span.zh: 1056年 — 1101年（北宋嘉祐元年至建中靖国元年）

title.zh: 弱冠出蜀·仗剑远游
title.en: Leaving Meizhou for the Imperial Capital

desc.zh: 年二十一的苏轼与弟苏辙随父苏洵自蜀中眉州启程，乘舟循岷江入长江，复由褒斜道越秦岭赴东京汴梁应试。
desc.en: At age twenty-one, Su Shi set out from Meizhou in Sichuan with his father Su Xun and brother Su Zhe to take the imperial examinations in Kaifeng.

quote.zh: 苏轼《初发嘉州》：“朝发鼓阗阗，西风猎画旃。故乡飘已远，往意浩无边。”
quote.en: Su Shi, Departing Jiazhou: "Morning drums thunder as the west wind snaps our painted banner; home drifts far behind, our aspirations boundless."

title.zh: 金榜题名·名动京师
title.en: Triumph at the Kaifeng Imperial Court

desc.zh: 嘉祐二年春闱，主考官欧阳修读苏轼《刑赏忠厚之至论》惊喜击节，苏氏兄弟同科进士及第，文名震动汴京。
desc.en: Chief examiner Ouyang Xiu marveled at Su Shi’s essay in the 1057 examination, proclaiming that the older generation must make way for this rising genius.

quote.zh: 欧阳修《与梅圣俞书》：“读轼书，不觉汗出，快哉快哉！老夫当避路，放他出一头地也。”
quote.en: Ouyang Xiu: "Reading Su Shi’s essay brought beads of sweat in sheer delight—this old man must step aside and let him stand a head above!"

title.zh: 初仕关中·签判凤翔
title.en: First Official Post in Fengxiang

desc.zh: 制科入第三等，授大理评事、签书凤翔府判官。初历地方吏治，兴修东湖、革除衙前弊政，作《喜雨亭记》《石鼓歌》。
desc.en: Appointed magistrate-assessor in Fengxiang in Guanzhong, where he reformed corvée transport and composed Pavilion of Joyful Rain.

quote.zh: 苏轼《喜雨亭记》：“使天而雨珠，寒者不得以为襦；使天而雨玉，饥者不得以为粟。”
quote.en: Su Shi, Pavilion of Joyful Rain: "Were Heaven to rain pearls, the cold could not wear them as coats; were it to rain jade, the hungry could not eat it as grain."

title.zh: 外放通判·寄情西湖
title.en: Vice-Prefect of Hangzhou & West Lake

desc.zh: 因上书直陈王安石新法之弊，自请外放任杭州通判（后于元祐四年再知杭州浚湖筑苏堤），巡行属县、赈济灾荒，留下无数西湖诗篇。
desc.en: Opposing Wang Anshi’s New Policies, Su Shi requested provincial assignment as Vice-Prefect of Hangzhou, immortalizing West Lake in verse.

quote.zh: 苏轼《饮湖上初晴后雨》：“欲把西湖比西子，淡妆浓抹总相宜。”
quote.en: Su Shi: "If I may compare West Lake to Lady Xishi, in light makeup or rich adornment she is equally peerless."

title.zh: 知密州·超然豪放
title.en: Governor of Mizhou — Birth of the Heroic Style

desc.zh: 主动求调密州知州，抗旱捕蝗、收养弃婴；于超然台思念胞弟苏辙，写就《水调歌头·明月几时有》与《江城子·密州出猎》，开宋词豪放一派。
desc.en: As Governor of Mizhou in Shandong, Su Shi pioneered the heroic ci-poetry style with "When Will the Bright Moon Be" and "Hunting at Mizhou."

quote.zh: 苏轼《水调歌头》：“人有悲欢离合，月有阴晴圆缺，此事古难全。但愿人长久，千里共婵娟。”
quote.en: Su Shi, Prelude to Water Melody: "Men have sorrow and joy, parting and reunion; the moon has clouds and clear skies, waxing and waning."

title.zh: 徐州抗洪·乌台诗案
title.en: Flood Defense at Xuzhou & the Crow Terrace Case

desc.zh: 知徐州时黄河决口迫城，苏轼布衣草履率禁军筑堤死守保住全城；元丰二年调知湖州，旋因诗文遭御史台弹劾逮赴汴京诏狱，史称“乌台诗案”。
desc.en: After saving Xuzhou from Yellow River floods, Su Shi was arrested in 1079 over alleged satire in his poems and imprisoned in the Imperial Censorate ("Crow Terrace Case").

quote.zh: 苏轼《狱中寄子由》：“是处青山可埋骨，他年夜雨独伤神。与君世世为兄弟，更结来生未了因。”
quote.en: Su Shi, From Prison to Ziyou: "Anywhere the green hills may bury my bones; in future years you will grieve alone in the night rain."

title.zh: 贬谪黄州·东坡赤壁
title.en: Exile in Huangzhou — Dongpo & the Red Cliffs

desc.zh: 出狱后责授检校水部员外郎、黄州团练副使。躬耕城东荒坡自号“东坡居士”，于困顿中完成了精神蜕变，写出《定风波》《念奴娇·赤壁怀古》、前后《赤壁赋》与《寒食帖》。
desc.en: Banished to Huangzhou on the Yangtze, he farmed the "Eastern Slope" (taking the name Dongpo) and composed his greatest masterpieces at the Red Cliffs.

quote.zh: 苏轼《定风波》：“竹杖芒鞋轻胜马，谁怕？一蓑烟雨任平生。”
quote.en: Su Shi, Calming the Waves: "Bamboo staff and straw sandals lighter than a steed—who fears? One straw cloak in misty rain for a lifetime."

title.zh: 再贬岭南·寓居惠州
title.en: Banished South of the Nanling to Huizhou

desc.zh: 元祐更化曾召还翰林学士、知杭州颍州扬州定州；绍圣元年哲宗亲政后新党复起，年近六旬的苏轼远贬岭南惠州安置，捐犀带助修东新桥、西新桥。
desc.en: Following political reversals in 1094, the nearly sixty-year-old Su Shi was banished across the Nanling Mountains to Huizhou in Guangdong.

quote.zh: 苏轼《食荔枝》：“日啖荔枝三百颗，不辞长作岭南人。”
quote.en: Su Shi, Eating Lychees: "Feasting on three hundred lychees a day, I would gladly remain a man of Lingnan forever."

title.zh: 渡海琼州·敷文儋耳
title.en: Across the Sea to Danzhou (Hainan Island)

desc.zh: 六十二岁再贬琼州别驾、昌化军（儋州）安置。跨海抵天涯绝岛，居桄榔庵、食芋饮水、讲学授徒，开启琼州文教之风，培养出海南首位举人姜唐佐。
desc.en: At sixty-two, banished across the Qiongzhou Strait to Hainan Island, where he lived in a palm-thatched hut and mentored Hainan’s first provincial graduate.

quote.zh: 苏轼《六月二十日夜渡海》：“九死南荒吾不恨，兹游奇绝冠平生。”
quote.en: Su Shi, Crossing the Sea at Night: "Nine deaths in the southern wilds leave me no regret—this wondrous journey crowns my entire life."

title.zh: 遇赦北归·终老毗陵
title.en: Pardoned Return North & Final Rest in Changzhou

desc.zh: 元符三年徽宗即位大赦北归，渡海经廉州、永州沿赣江北上；建中靖国元年七月廿八日病逝于常州顾塘桥孙氏馆，享年六十六岁。
desc.en: Pardoned in 1100, Su Shi traveled north by boat and passed away in Changzhou in August 1101 at age sixty-six, summing up his life in a final self-portrait poem.

quote.zh: 苏轼《自题金山画像》：“心似已灰之木，身如不系之舟。问汝平生功业，黄州惠州儋州。”
quote.en: Su Shi, Inscription on My Portrait at Jinshan: "My heart like ashen wood, my body an unmoored boat. Ask of my life’s achievements: Huangzhou, Huizhou, Danzhou."

title.zh: 王阳明知行悟道行迹
title.en: Wang Yangming's Unity of Knowledge & Action

span.zh: 1472年 — 1529年（明成化八年至嘉靖七年）

title.zh: 降生瑞云·志在圣贤
title.en: Birth at Ruiyun Tower & Aspiration for Sagehood

desc.zh: 王守仁诞生于浙江绍兴府余姚县瑞云楼，父王华次年高中状元。十一岁随祖父北上京师塾读，问塾师「何为第一等事」，师答「惟读书登第耳」，守仁昂然对曰：「登第恐未为第一等事，或读书学圣贤耳。」自幼立下成圣之志。
desc.en: Born at Ruiyun Tower in Yuyao, Wang Shouren asked his tutor at age eleven what the highest pursuit in life was. Told it was passing the imperial exams, he replied: "Passing exams is surely not the highest pursuit; learning to become a sage is."

quote.zh: 王阳明少时语：“登第恐未为第一等事，或读书学圣贤耳。”——《王阳明先生年谱》
quote.en: Young Wang Yangming: "Passing the imperial examination is hardly the highest undertaking; reading to become a sage is."

title.zh: 谒娄一斋·始闻格物
title.en: Meeting Lou Liang at Guangxin & Inquiring into Gewu

desc.zh: 十八岁自南昌迎妇归余姚，舟次江西广信（今上饶），特往拜谒崇仁学派大儒娄谅（娄一斋）。娄谅向其阐发宋儒格物穷理之旨，语以「圣人必可学而至」，守仁深相契合，自此笃志圣学，归后遍读考亭朱子遗书。
desc.en: Returning from Nanchang at age eighteen, Wang visited Neo-Confucian master Lou Liang at Guangxin, who assured him that sagehood could truly be attained through learning and inquiry.

quote.zh: 《明史·王守仁传》：“过广信，谒娄谅，语以圣人可学而至，遂深契之。”
quote.en: History of Ming: "Passing through Guangxin, he visited Lou Liang, who taught that sagehood can be learned, striking a deep chord in him."

title.zh: 格竹致疾·进士及第
title.en: Investigating Bamboo & Passing the Metropolitan Exam

desc.zh: 在京师欲依朱熹「即物穷理」之法穷究草木之理，与钱友同坐亭前面竹「格竹」七日七夜，理未得而劳神成疾，始疑外求之弊。弘治十二年（1499）赐进士及第，历任工部、刑部主事，究心兵法韬略与经世之学。
desc.en: In Beijing, Wang meditated before bamboo for seven days trying to grasp its Neo-Confucian principle, falling ill and doubting externalism. In 1499 he passed the palace exam and served in the Ministries of Works and Justice.

quote.zh: 《传习录》：“众人只说格物要依晦翁，何曾把他的说去用？我着实曾用来。”
quote.en: Instructions for Practical Living: "People say we must follow Zhu Xi in investigating things, yet who has truly practiced it? I genuinely tried for seven days."

title.zh: 廷杖下狱·投江脱险
title.en: Flogged in Court & Escaping Assassins at Qiantang

desc.zh: 正德元年，司礼监权宦刘瑾擅权，逮捕南京给事中戴铣等二十余人。守仁抗疏力救，触怒刘瑾，被廷杖四十下诏狱，谪贵州龙场驿丞。南下途经杭州钱塘江，刘瑾遣刺客尾随欲加害，守仁夜掷衣冠于江中留绝命诗诈死，乘海舟脱险。
desc.en: For defending upright officials against eunuch dictator Liu Jin, Wang was flogged forty strokes, imprisoned, and banished to Guizhou. Pursued by Liu Jin’s assassins at Qiantang River, he faked his drowning at night to escape.

quote.zh: 王阳明《泛海》：“险夷原不滞胸中，何异浮云过太空！夜静海涛三万里，月明飞锡下天风。”
quote.en: Wang Yangming, Sailing the Sea: "Danger and safety leave no trace in my breast, like floating clouds across the vast sky!"

title.zh: 龙场大悟·创立心学
title.en: Longchang Enlightenment & Philosophy of Mind

desc.zh: 抵达贵州万山丛棘、瘴疠横行之龙场驿。居东洞石棺之中，日夜端居澄默，自问「圣人处此更有何道」。正德三年中夜忽然大悟格物致知之旨，彻见「圣人之道，吾性自足，向之求理于事物者误也」，继而倡「知行合一」，开五百年阳明心学。
desc.en: Living in a stone cave in remote Guizhou, Wang meditated day and night on life and death. One midnight in 1508 he achieved sudden enlightenment: "The Way of the Sages is complete within my own nature; seeking principles in external things was mistaken."

quote.zh: 《王阳明年谱》：“圣人之道，吾性自足，向之求理于事物者误也。”
quote.en: Chronicle of Wang Yangming: "The Way of the Sages is self-sufficient within our own mind-nature; seeking principle outside in external things was an error."

title.zh: 知县庐陵·兴教善政
title.en: Magistrate of Luling — Benevolent Governance

desc.zh: 刘瑾伏诛前夕，守仁升任江西吉安府庐陵县知县。视事七月，不以威刑而重告谕，均徭役、息词讼、立十家牌保甲法，选里老敦厚者劝诫乡民，庐陵风俗翕然丕变，为日后经略江西奠定深厚民心。
desc.en: Appointed magistrate of Luling County in Jiangxi, Wang governed through moral persuasion rather than harsh punishment, equalizing corvée labor and establishing community compacts.

quote.zh: 王阳明《告谕庐陵父老》：“一念之善，即吉神佑之；一念之恶，即厉鬼随之。”
quote.en: Proclamation to the Elders of Luling: "A single good thought brings auspicious blessings; a single evil thought invites calamity."

title.zh: 巡抚南赣·破山中贼
title.en: Governor of Southern Gan — Quelling Mountain Bandits

desc.zh: 受兵部尚书王琼力荐，以左佥都御史巡抚南赣汀漳。自编选练民兵，严明赏罚，两年内连破詹师富、大帽山、横水、桶冈、浰头诸巢，荡平盘踞赣闽粤湘边界数十年之巨寇；继而颁《南赣乡约》、设崇义县，兴立社学教化百姓。
desc.en: As Governor of Southern Gan, Wang trained local militias and eradicated decades-old bandit strongholds across the Jiangxi–Fujian–Guangdong border, then instituted the Southern Gan Community Compact.

quote.zh: 王阳明《与杨仕德薛尚谦书》：“破山中贼易，破心中贼难。”
quote.en: Letter to Yang Shide: "It is easy to vanquish the bandits in the mountains, but hard to vanquish the bandits in the mind."

title.zh: 平宁王乱·奇兵定难
title.en: Crushing Prince of Ning's Rebellion in 35 Days

desc.zh: 六月，宁王朱宸濠于南昌起兵十万反叛，顺江东下围安庆、逼南京。守仁在丰城闻变，退保吉安特征集义军，施反间疑兵计迟滞叛军，随即乘虚直捣南昌老巢。宁王回救，两军决战于鄱阳湖黄家渡，守仁火攻大破叛军，仅三十五日生擒朱宸濠。
desc.en: When Prince Zhu Chenhao rebelled with 100,000 troops, Wang rallied local forces in Ji’an, used deception to stall the rebels, stormed their base at Nanchang, and captured the prince after a fire-ship battle on Poyang Lake in just 35 days.

quote.zh: 王阳明《擒获宸濠捷音疏》：“臣等仰仗天威，一鼓而克其巢穴，再战而擒其渠魁。”
quote.en: Victory Memorial on Capturing Chenhao: "With one drumbeat we stormed his lair; in the second battle we captured the rebel chief alive."

title.zh: 致良知教·天泉证道
title.en: Doctrine of Liangzhi & Tianquan Bridge Discourse

desc.zh: 明世宗即位，封守仁新建伯，守仁归越城绍兴，于稽山书院、阳明洞聚徒讲学，正式揭出「致良知」三字教法，四方学者云集。嘉靖六年（1527）奉诏出征两广前夕，于天泉桥与大弟子钱德洪、王畿印证心学「四句教」，成心学传世纲领。
desc.en: Enfeoffed as Earl of Xinjian, Wang lectured at Shaoxing and proclaimed the doctrine of "Extending Innate Moral Knowledge" (Zhi Liangzhi). On the eve of his Guangxi campaign in 1527, he delivered the Four-Sentence Teaching at Tianquan Bridge.

quote.zh: 《天泉证道·四句教》：“无善无恶心之体，有善有恶意之动。知善知恶是良知，为善去恶是格物。”
quote.en: Four-Sentence Teaching: "Neither good nor evil is the substance of the mind; good and evil arise with the movement of intention. Knowing good and evil is innate knowledge; doing good and removing evil is the investigation of things."

title.zh: 此心光明·亦复何言
title.en: Radiant Mind — Final Passing at Qinglongpu

desc.zh: 嘉靖六年总督两广，不费一兵一卒招抚思恩、田州卢苏王受七万众，继以奇兵荡平断藤峡八寨瑶乱。次年冬肺疾加剧上疏乞归，十一月二十九日（公历1529年1月）舟次江西南安府大余县青龙铺。门人周积问遗言，先生微笑曰：「此心光明，亦复何言！」遂瞑目而逝。
desc.en: After pacifying Guangxi’s Si’en, Tianzhou, and Rattan Gorge rebellions, Wang fell gravely ill on his journey home. Passing away on a boat at Qinglongpu in Nan’an, he spoke his final words: "This mind is luminous; what more is there to say?"

quote.zh: 王阳明临终遗言：“此心光明，亦复何言！”——《王阳明先生年谱》
quote.en: Wang Yangming’s last words: "This mind is luminous—what more is there to say!"

name.zh: 战国长城（秦·赵·燕北长城）
name.en: Warring States Great Walls (Qin · Zhao · Yan)

summary.zh: 战国中后期秦昭襄王、赵武灵王、燕昭王分别于陇西北地、阴山河套、燕山辽东修筑北长城以拒匈奴、林胡、楼烦与东胡，后为秦始皇万里长城之前身。
summary.en: Northern frontier walls built by Qin, Zhao (under King Wuling), and Yan (under King Zhao) against the Xiongnu and Donghu, later linked into the Qin Great Wall.

summary.zh: 蒙恬北逐匈奴后，连接秦、赵、燕旧长城，西起临洮，东至辽东。
summary.en: Linked by Meng Tian from previous Qin, Zhao, and Yan walls, stretching from Lintao in the west to Liaodong.

summary.zh: 武帝夺河西后，沿秦长城并向西延筑，经河西四郡直抵玉门关、盐泽（罗布泊）。
summary.en: Extended westward under Emperor Wu through the Hexi Corridor to Yumenguan and Lop Nur.

summary.zh: 明代二百余年陆续修筑的九边长城，西起嘉峪关，东至山海关，今存墙体多为此期遗存。
summary.en: Brick-and-stone Nine Garrisons wall built across two centuries from Jiayuguan to Shanhai Pass.

summary.zh: 秦始皇命蒙恬所修的军用快道，自咸阳北直抵九原（今包头），全长约 700 公里。
summary.en: 700 km military highway built by Meng Tian from Xianyang north to Jiuyuan (Baotou).

summary.zh: 自长安出发，沿渭河、河西走廊西行至敦煌，为陆上丝路主干。
summary.en: Mainland trunk route from Chang'an through the Hexi Corridor to Dunhuang.

summary.zh: 大业元年开通济渠，自洛阳引黄河水经汴州、宋州、宿州入淮，再接邗沟、江南河直通余杭。
summary.en: Opened in 605 CE to link Luoyang with the Huai River, connecting onward to Yangzhou and Hangzhou.

summary.zh: 元代开会通河、通惠河，运河改走山东直通大都，全线约 1800 公里。
summary.en: Re-routed straight through Shandong under Kublai Khan to Dadu (~1,800 km).

summary.zh: 自广州、泉州出海，经占城、马六甲通往印度洋与阿拉伯，唐宋时广州设市舶使。
summary.en: From Quanzhou and Guangzhou via Champa and Malacca into the Indian Ocean.

summary.zh: 永乐三年起七下西洋，自南京龙江关出发，驻泊刘家港、长乐太平港，远达东非。
summary.en: Seven expeditions (1405–1433) from Nanjing and Taicang across the Indian Ocean to East Africa.
